TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_01_BAD_.text: Anzu... Are you sure this is edible?
Spit it out! Don't swallow any more!
... You shouldn't be eating things like this, Kaede.

Nom nom... Ew, urgh! ...
I don't think this is a real bakery, Anzu!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_01_GOOD.text:
... Huhu, Kaede.
You can have as much as you want.

B-but...
This is your share, Anzu... Growl...

The ingredients go well together.
This recipe tastes like happiness!

Nom nom... I like the chewy savory bits!
Hee hee, thank you for the delicious meal!

This is so yummy!
Anzu, can I have one more? Come on, let's order another one!

I've never eaten such delicious bread before in my life.
... Should we stand in line one more time to make another purchase?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_01_ORDE.text:
Anzu! It smells so sweet!
I'm hungry all of a sudden!
Then let's see if we can find an autumn dessert.

Oh, Kaede.
They're selling bread with your favorite fruit!
You're right! Let's order that one, Anzu!

Oh, dear.
Could you give us something sweet and preferably simple?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_01_SOSO.text:
Hmm... It's almost... leathery in texture.
And a little bitter.

I'm sorry, Anzu!
I shouldn't have insisted on standing in line...
I thought long lines were a guarantee of good food in human culture.

How strange. It's... edible, at least,
but I must say that it's very bland.

Anzu, what kind of food is this?
It doesn't taste like anything!
This tastes weird. Is it just me?

It is rather bland.
I'm sorry, but this recipe doesn't seem to be our cup of tea.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_02_BAD_.text:
I ‘spose I had a terrible misunderstanding…
I thought this place was a bakery, but now I see it’s an armory!
What I thought was supposed to be ‘bread’
turns out to be a more terrifying weapon than even the tteok bullets
I saw in the kingdom of Han one time!
How do you use this ‘bread’ of yours?
It seems too large to be used as bullets…
Are they meant to be thrown like daggers? Well, at any rate,
I won’t be able to use them to their full potential,
as I tend to fight with my fists! I’ll give another customer the opportunity
to wield this fine weapon. What do you mean, this isn’t a weapon?

… The belief that whatever doesn’t kill you only makes you stronger 
has its limits. You shouldn’t abuse your body for nothing!
That reminds me, I once met a young fellow who foolishly believed
that he would develop immunity to germs if he continued to eat
only junk food and contaminated water. He would get sick every day, 
but I couldn’t persuade him to put an end to his ‘training’!
You won’t be able to guess how sorry I felt for him! 
These are the dangers of misguided beliefs when training. 
Later the fellow started collecting
all kinds of poison from around the world
because he wanted to become immune to them. 
You can guess what happened after he injected
diluted poison into his veins… There was no saving him… 
All his lustrous hair fell out and he turned completely bald! 
Oh, you thought he died! No, nothing so tragic, 
but the image of his completely bald scalp is still seared into my memory 
as a tragic reminder that you should value your own body. 
From that day on, I vowed to myself that I’d never let another youngster
voluntarily harm themselves with their own idiocy.
That is why I can’t let you continue cooking such dangerous food!
This bread will irreversibly damage my insides with a single bite.
Now, let me instead tell you a story
that might teach you a safer way to train.
I can remember it as clear as crystal -
thirty-five years ago on this very day...

So you call this 'bread'!
Ah, I've learned another lesson - for my entire life I've been under
the foolish impression that only the bread that you can eat
can be called 'bread.' What is bread? Or rather the better question is,
what can be regarded as bread? How would you answer that question?
Usually, people will answer that bread is a type of food
made by grinding grains into flour, using that flour to make dough,
then baking the dough. But this 'bread' doesn't seem like
it's made of grains. Then the question arises, what are grains?
What is food? Isn't food defined by its quality of being edible?
Isn't food meant to be consumed by humans for nutrition?
How can your 'bread' be considered food under this definition?
I see I still have a lot to learn!  Thank you for using the simple everyday 
activity of baking and buying bread to shed light on a question 
that I've never had the freedom of considering before!
You're certainly opening new horizons for me!
I'll take this loaf and think over the question carefully!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_02_GOOD.text:
Oh, this divine flavor…!
It tastes exactly like the magical fruit I ate in my youth during my training!
Have I ever told you that story? I remember it as clear as crystal.
That day, the fog spread far like the sea and erased the boundary
between heaven and earth. As I looked out to the hills,
a single dark golden ray pierced the thick fog and dazzled my eyes... 
And at the end of the line, there was a small fruit tree gleaming 
like the sun. I followed the light to the tree and picked the single fruit
that hung from the branches. I bit in – and everything felt different!
The first awakened all my taste buds and all my senses tingled
and reverberated with the very earth itself! I thought to myself,
well, Shuwen, this must be the food of the Ethereals!
I hadn’t eaten anything like that divine fruit ever since – until today!
I must tell everyone this happy news!

Incredible…! The only word I can use to describe
this divine loaf of bread: just incredible!
The old teachings of the Ethereals
state that enlightenment can be found everywhere,
and that you can reach the truth of the world
by dedicating yourself to whatever it is that you have chosen to do.
Old as I may be, I hadn't realized that these words can be
applied to baking as well! You continue to enlighten me, old friend,
and I wish to thank y-… Ah, that reminds me, did you ever meet an otter
who goes by the epithet ‘Enlightened Otter’?
I crossed paths with him on the way here to Hero Town
and I think you two would have much in comm-
Ah! Yes, I do see the line of customers behind me,
and I s’pose it’s time to order…
Unfortunate that you’re so busy that you can’t spare a moment
to hear my praises for your wonderful bread!
I’ll come back soon, I promise!

I thought I had lived too many years to be moved to tears by food,
but I was wrong. Before the work of a prominent artisan like you,
everyone is bound to feel like a child who has caught a butterfly
for the very first time! And so do I.
Am I the butterfly, or is the butterfly the man I recognize as myself?
That is the question the great philosopher asked
after dreaming his ancient dream, but I now ask:
am I the bread that I eat? Is that the reason I am filled with such delight
as the philosopher was filled with nostalgia for his lingering dreams?
Ah, I’m curious as to what secrets your bakery holds
for you to bake such delicious bread, but secrets must remain secrets.
With this meal, I feel as if I could break through my limits
and elevate myself to a higher level of understanding the truth
of the universe! A new door thus unexpectedly opens in foreign lands,
leading me on a new road! Ah, what a beautiful day!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_02_ORDE.text:
Patience, patience – I’ll make my order in good time!
But first, my dear friend, we have much to talk about –
I have had many adventures since our last meeting!
Where to start, where to start… As you know,
I retreated to the mountains to devote myself to my training.
That was a strange day indeed! A strange gust of wind came carrying – 
what? I need to make my order because
there are too many customers waiting behind me? That’s too bad!
I could spend the entire day talking to an old friend, but… 
Well, as the saying goes, “a journey of a thousand miles
starts with a single hearty meal.” What do you recommend
if I want a filling, healthy meal of meat and vegetables?

Seeing all those excited customers before the store
fills my heart with happiness! It also reminds me of one particular day
that I remember as clear as crystal
when I traveled to the kingdom of Han and came across
a tteok dessert shop… People were waiting in line
even before the shop had opened! Some even had tents and blankets!
That caught my attention, of course, and I was curious enough
to also join the line and see what the fuss was about.
Turns out that the ‘tteok shop’ did not sell edible tteok
but lethal tteok bullets famous for their power!
It was my fault that I’d been caught by surprise:
I’d been so narrow-minded as to think that tteok bullet artisans
could not exist in this world! Wondering how tteok could act as bullets,
I put one in my mouth out of curiosity…
and it tasted like a rock in my mouth!
I still wonder to this day how you can make tteok that hard and durable.
How strange and wondrous the world can be!
However, this bakery seems to be selling ordinary, edible bread.
I’d like to order bread with balanced amounts of meat and vegetables.

It has been said since ancient times
that harmony is the essential truth of the universe.
I may be an old man, but I still repeat
the words of our ancestors in reverence; the more you think about it,
the more you realize the deep truth behind their words!
Look at the tree, for instance. Without achieving harmony
with its surroundings, it cannot grow to its full potential
and may even be cut down before it unfolds the leaves of its first spring.
Like nature, some truths remain unchanged,
regardless of time and place.
So is the bread that I want to order from this bakery:
bread that has achieved full harmony of its ingredients.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_02_SOSO.text:
Hmm… It’s not bad, but it’s lacking.
As I chewed the thought crossed my mind that perhaps –
just perhaps you did not try your best?
When I served the kingdom as one of the Five Tiger Generals,
I strove to do my best even for the most trivial of tasks.
I’m suddenly reminded of one crisp autumn day
when a little bird flew into the imperial palace.
How poor it looked, perched on a pillar and trembling
as it looked desperately for a way out!
I can still remember its nervous chirps…
We Tiger Generals and the other courtiers spent the entire day
running around the palace and trying to catch the little bird
so that we could set it free, and…

Ah, this bread reminds me of a youth
who has just set out on his first journey
and has yet to prove himself to the world.
Like that youth you are as a baker: fresh and raw.
I’m unsure why there are so many customers wishing
to taste your wares… Keep an open mind to other ways of life
that you may come across on your path.
The current one you walk could be challenging,
but others could prove more worthwhile…

I sense no harmony between the dough and filling of this bun.
Each part may have been good individually,
but there is no unity among the components.
But this is no reason to worry! Failure is the mother of success,
and with every try you will grow closer and closer
to that moment of peace and awareness. Trust me,
I have a genuine feeling that you are not too far
from that new level of insight and personal growth.
I expect great things for your baking in the days to come.
Well, years, at the very least.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_03_BAD_.text:
W-were you an assassin all along?
What did you add to my food...?!

Ugh, my stomach...
And you have the nerve to be paid for this waste?
What is the world coming to?

Ack! I-I taste poison!
You vile wretch, by what guile did you bypass my eye?
I require more training!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_03_GOOD.text:
Only one of these delicacies is not enough.
Is it possible to order another?
No? A pity.

As much as I'd like to try your other recipes,
I can't perform my best on a full stomach.
I'll come back tomorrow.

I have never tasted anything like this before.
Well done. You are a culinary artisan.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_03_ORDE.text:
I want something fresh,
preferably not doughy.

Will you bake me bread with no meat?
Ah, those chestnuts seem of fine quality.

A simple snack should do for now.
Perhaps baked with vegetables -
I have a long day before me.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_03_SOSO.text:
Tsk...
Did I not ask for food that is easily digestible?

... What did you put in here?
There is no harmony among the ingredients.

How... disappointing.
This does not explain
the lengthy line in front of the shop.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_04_BAD_.text:
You cruel, cruel human!
A young cub can't stomach poison!

It's been a rough journey - for nothing.
I shouldn't have made my cub suffer on the road...
I'm sorry Daddy's not good enough
to fix your eating habits and raise you into a fine, big, healthy bear...

Oh, don't cry, my sweet dumpling!
I wouldn't feed you anything that could harm you!
... You, human, are going to have to answer to me.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_04_GOOD.text:
Ah, I see what you did there -
hide an assortment of healthy ingredients under the meat!
Thank you! My cub might eat this!

What abundance of flavor! I'll add another order -
Hmm? They're limited to only one per person?
... Can you make an exception for pandas?

By the divine pandas!
My cub is actually showing interest in food other than meat!
Human, you are by far the best baker I have ever seen
on my travels throughout the continent. 
I thank you from the bottom of my heart
for helping my cub recover his strength...!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_04_ORDE.text:
I want to share a loaf with my young son,
so I'd like bread that could make for a nutritious meal.
The little one refuses to eat anything other than meat, however.

I'd like a meat bun, please.
Perhaps hiding some other healthy ingredients
here and there...

What do you recommend for my young cub
who is picky about what he eats, especially vegetables?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_04_SOSO.text:
Hmm... Can bread smell like nothing?
Are you sure you remembered to put in the meat?
I'm not sure whether my cub will be interested in eating this...

I must have overestimated you, baker.
Well, I thank you for your effort.

Did you remember to use fresh ingredients?
This isn't bad, but it hardly falls under the category of good.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_05_BAD_.text:
I don't think you can call this 'bread' -
more like food waste!
I'll see myself out.

You're an insult to the culinary arts.
How can you call yourself a baker?

... Ugh! This is shockingly bad!
On the other hand, I could use it
as a weapon to fend off monsters from my restaurant...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_05_GOOD.text:
Oh, wow! I never knew these ingredients would go so well together!
I was expecting that combination to result in food waste.
Thank you for teaching me a lesson in baking!

The delicate balance between the savory and the sweet
is exquisitely executed! Is this a new horizon for the future of baking?
Amazing!

Delightful!
Your bakery puts me back on my toes.
Will you enter my next cooking competition?
We could be a good influence for each other!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_05_ORDE.text:
Show me a unique recipe that can't be found anywhere else!
I want to explore new horizons of baking!

Wow, look at all these customers!
Popular shops are popular for a reason.
One chestnut bun, please -
but surprise me with the toppings!

Let's see... I want fruit toppings on my bread.
Also, could you make it sweet AND savory at the same time?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_05_SOSO.text:
What ingredients did you use to get this glop?
They don't mix well at all.
Hmm... Well, this is disappointing.

I asked for 'unique,' not 'icky.'
You must have misheard me.

All those rumors of a 'mind-blowing culinary experience'
were misleading. What a waste of my time!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_06_BAD_.text:
Cough, cough!
E-erm, this is certainly... edible - I think.
I definitely did not compare this loaf of bread
to a lump of coal in my mouth as I bit down on it.

... Ahahaha... This looks delicious!
Almost too delicious to eat right away!
I'll just change my order to takeaway
and enjoy my bread in solitude...
N-no, you're mistaken. I'm not acting weird at all.

... Is Chocolat still angry at me?
I'm beginning to think she never forgave me.
... Never mind.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_06_GOOD.text:
...! This is delicious!
Can you keep this menu even after the event?
It's better than any other bread I've had in my life.

As expected of you, Chocolat!
I knew you could do it!
I'll come back again to try another one!

It's a shame you can order only one loaf at a time.
Flavorful, fresh, fulfilling - 
I don't know what more I can ask for.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_06_ORDE.text:
Business seems to be booming.
I'm looking to have a simple meal
with both meat and vegetables.

... I know how disappointed Chocolat was
when she found me eating the loaf of bread I bought
from that other bakery. That's why I want to order...
the same kind of bread that I'd been eating. Is that okay?

I knew Chocolat could overcome her problems.
She's a strong person.
I have a sudden craving for the sandwich I ate a few days ago.
Can I have one Chocolat's Bakery special sandwich?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_06_SOSO.text:
Huh...
... Oh, it's nothing. It's... delicious.
... Erm... I can think of many good qualities of this bread!
Like it's full of ingredients... and...

... Can I ask what ingredients went into baking this bread?
O-oh, no, it's not that I don't find it delicious...

... I may have come down with a cold, because I'm not tasting anything.
... Oh, I didn't mean for you to hear that.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_07_BAD_.text:
Isn't this place supposed to be a bakery?
And isn't a bakery supposed to sell bread that is actually edible?

Did you even get my order? I'm confused as to why
all these people are wasting their time standing in line.
... I don't want to eat this.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_07_GOOD.text:
Mmmmmm~! What a harmonious combination!
What kind of sauce did you use?
I especially love the subtle sweetness!

Ooh, what are the nutty bits in the middle?
...! That's a fascinating combination!
You know what? A recipe for a new potion just came to mind!
Thanks for inspiring me. Better run to jot down my ideas!

Sweet and fresh with a distinctively delightful aftertaste!
It's a perfect combination, even by an alchemist's standards!
Thank you for inspiring me
with this special combination.
My mind is racing with so many different ideas!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_07_ORDE.text:
Show me a creative recipe
that will inspire a new potion in me!

Hmm~ I decided on the vegetable topping,
but I don't want anything too plain.
I definitely want savory bread, though.

One cheese bun, please -
topped with authentic, fresh ingredients!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_07_SOSO.text:
A little mushy and... tangy?
Hmm. I don't care for this at all.

You created... THE THING!
This in itself is an accomplishment,
although not a culinary one...

Well... It's... rubbery.
I think you may have accidentally invented
a new type of material.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_08_BAD_.text:
Huh, you're just like me, hon.
You use food as lethal weaponry.

This looks scarier
than Malsook's rock-hard tteok!

Don't put that in your mouth!
Why do you insist on putting everything in your mouth?
Spit it out! Spit it out!

THIS is the equivalent of tteok in this country?
Am I experiencing what people call 'cultural differences'?

Sob... I thought this shop sold tasty bread,
but I now see I was mistaken... It was another armory.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_08_GOOD.text:
Looks like I still have a thing or two to learn.
This savory and salty yet deep flavor... What ingredients did you use?

This is almost as good as your tteok, Malsook!
Nom nom... Can I have a couple more, pleeeease?
Nom... Nom nom nom... Yum... Yummy!!!

Chew before you swallow!
There's plenty left!

Mmmmm~! This bread fills me with joy; thank you! Hee hee...
What do you think? I told you it would be delicious!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_08_ORDE.text:
Look, Malsook! This is it!
The famous Chocolat's Bakery!

I want a bun that is soft and flavorful.
This tiger here likes sweet desserts, so you should consider that as well.

Huh, so this is the equivalent of tteok
in this country...

I'd like to hold an autumn-themed tea ceremony,
so mildly sweet buns, slightly salted, would be nice.

Ah, chestnuts!
Roasted chestnuts are my favorite! I want chestnuts in my bread!

How will that be any different from my chestnut tteok?
Hmm... Maybe you should show me the answer
with a special recipe, hon.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_08_SOSO.text:
What a strange culture.
People stand in line for hours on end
to buy bland loaves of bread.
Hmmmmm... I think I prefer the familiar taste of tteok.
I never knew Western bread could be so... slimy.

Oh, don't stuff your mouth with food you don't even like!
I'm sorry, hon, but your bread just isn't to our tastes.

I know you tried, hon, but this just isn't up to par.
A waste of food if I ever saw one.

Malsook, do you have any leftover tteok with you?
I'd like to forget the lingering aftertaste as soon as possible.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_09_BAD_.text:
This is...! My innocent childhood... The darker years that followed...
My life is flashing before my eyes...!
Can this be... the true taste of the abyss?

Your life flashing before your eyes is NOT a good sign!
Spit it out!

What are you going to do? All your strange talk of 'darkness' and 'abyss'
scared the baker into brewing poison!
... What crimes have I committed to receive such an abomination?

Oh, it's burnt black - just the color you love.
Why don't you have some more?
You seem almost pleased with your own wit, Arona.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_09_GOOD.text: ... To slay the darkness within, I mu-

Shh! We promised no talk of 'darkness' outside, remember?
... Oh, don't mind him.
You must believe me when I say
that he means it as a compliment.

What a beautiful color.
Almost as dark as the black sesame tteok back home...

Huhu, I guess we should apologize for our ridiculous order,
but you've outdone yourself. Thank you, it's delicious.

His silence indicates that he's satisfied.
Sweet, dark-colored, and even beautiful in its harmony...
Thank you for the delicious meal.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_09_ORDE.text:
Show me bread that is the embodiment of abysmal darkness,
so that I may reflect on the unfading wounds of my soul...

He means 'bread that is dark in color.'
As for me, I don't like bitter flavors,
so perhaps our order should be sweet black bread?

Everything looks delicious.
Have you decided on what you want to order?

... Only black sesame tteok can reach the dark abyss within me.
Show me... the gaping maw of the darkness hiding within your bread...

... Yes, I have decided.
I saw another customer leaving earlier...
firmly clutching darkness in their hands... You know what I speak of.

... That bread was burnt, and you know it, Sworden.
We can't eat a lump of coal for lunch.
Hmm... Do you have bread that is sweet but also dark in color?
And preferably containing chestnuts?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_09_SOSO.text:
I prefer black sesame tteok.
Let us visit my favorite tavern on the way home.

... This is not the darkness I requested.
Take it away.

It isn't tasty by any means, but at least they tried -
that has to count for something, don't you think?
... I find myself at a loss for words.

That's because you stubbornly refused to order normal bread!
Who asks for 'darkness' at a bakery?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_10_BAD_.text:
As I thought, people around these parts simply can't understand me.
Tsk. I blame myself for trying.

What is this that you are selling?
That student must have pointed me in the wrong direction.
A complete waste of my time.

Why didn't you tell me that you misheard my order?
I would have repeated it to you... but I doubt that you would have
understood it even then. Never mind! I lost my appetite.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_10_GOOD.text:
Yes, this is it!
... Brings back old memories.
I always ate breakfast no matter how late I was for school:
a glass of milk and a slice of buttered bread... Ah, those were the days.

I never expected to relive the memories of my school days
through the bread of this bakery.
Thank you. You don't know how much this means to me.

Ah, tastes like home... I've been missing this.
The foods around here are usually too different for my tastes.
Thank you. I'll pay you another visit when I can.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_10_ORDE.text:
Ah, finally my turn, is it? Before I began walking the martial path,
I used to spend much of my allowance money on sweet buns.
I miss the taste.

Do - you - understand - what - I - am - saying - to - you?
... Tsk, people around here usually don't.
I'll have a red bean bun if it isn't too much trouble to you.

One dessert I used to eat all the time back home comes to mind.
You should have something similar here as well - although I'm unsure
what you call it... It contains sweet, blackish red paste. Do you know it?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_10_SOSO.text:
It's similar, but not quite...
Something important seems missing.
Well, it's okay, lacking as it is.

I suppose the past must remain in the past,
and old memories must stay what they are - memories. Ah, well.

This bread is too dry.
A pity, as it could have been close to the taste of my childhood...
I hope you do better next time.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_11_BAD_.text:
What is this?
Do you think I lack common sense because I cannot fluently speak
the Common Language? Give me something I can eat!

Woompaya roompapa!! Woopapa!
... Ahem! I want a refund-woompa!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_11_GOOD.text:
Woom... Nom nom... Nom...
Woompurum... Nom nom...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_11_ORDE.text: Woopapa woomparoom? Woompa woomparedbean! Paveggies roompapa!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_12_BAD_.text:
... I knew it.
The Goddesses of Fate led me on this path of labor
so that I can break through my limits and level up.
Ha, nothing surprises me anymore. Just as I planned!
O cursed bun of the devil! I'll defeat you here and now!
... What do you mean, I have to eat it?
I don't have to do anything I don't want to do.

THIS is what I ordered?
... Hahaha, hahahahahaha! You're funny.
Though you could fool an experienced guy like me
into eating poison? You're more stupid than I thought!

Y-you created bread out of the very essence of darkness?
... Huh. That's pretty good, I gotta admit.
But it's not enough! This darkness is shallow and WAY below my level!
There's no way I'll be satisfied with this, so try again!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_12_GOOD.text:
This...
This tastes like home.
I knew it - I'm the chosen one!
I was led by the Goddess of Fate on this journey
so that I can finally have the flashbacks crucial to my storyline.

Oooooh, can I have some more? ... Ahem, I mean...
This bread has reached the level of perfection 
with its beautifully baked crust and complex flavor.
Oi oi, are you the
'god' of baking in this world?
Huhuhu... I thought there was a distinctive aura about you.

Huhu... I underestimated you before.
You're much more skilled than I thought.
I will allow you to call me 'Haruki-kun'
without all the other otherworld formalities.
... What do you mean, 'I refuse'?!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_12_ORDE.text:
Are you prepared to pay for making me wait this long?
Oi oi, NOTHING has succeeded in satisfying me 
since I arrived in this otherworld.
For instance, why is there no pizza here?
The food of this world bores me, but I'll give you a chance to change
my mind. I, Haruki, 'Agent of the Goddess,' will judge this bakery!
... Oh, my order?
Erm... Muhahaha, I'd like one 'dark' loaf of bread 
that resembles an endless black hole like the one in my soul!!!

The dark - erm, dark darkness that endlessly swirls around my soul...
led me to this place in a course of destiny. 
Huhu... It's almost a cruel burden
to be loved this much by the Goddesses...
The fate of all the worlds in the universe
is a burden I must carry alone on my shoulders.
... What do you mean, 'I don't understand what you're saying'?
Huhu, an ordinary human like you wouldn't understand.
Anyway, I don't have to explain anything to you.
What's important is WHY the Goddess showed me this prophecy.
And it looks like you're the key, so show me a valid answer.

... Oh, but I don't really like salad, so no vegetables for me.
But put lots and lots of cheese. Lots of it.

Huhuhu... Hahahahahahaha!!!
... Yes, yes... Out of your entire menu, only this recipe calls out to me...
I can feel its beastly soul captured in your kitchen
calling out for its rightful owner... ME!
The deep flavor and pure darkness
of this great and terrible beauty is only meant for me, I know it...
I am ready! Give it to me!
Unleash the monster of my destiny!!!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_12_SOSO.text:
Ha... Just as I thought.
Oi oi, it's a hundred years too early
for anyone to bake bread that can satisfy ME.

This mediocre bread is below me!
My cursed demon eye can calculate the power level
and analyze the components of any object in the universe!
And this time is no exception!
Let me see... E.
Your bread is 'Rank E'!

Did you really think you could satisfy me
with such low-quality food? You chose the wrong person to mess with.
Well, I can be forgiving,
but I can't say the same thing for my left eye,
the 'Infinite Darkness' with its 'Divine Authority.'
Even I can't control its rampage... Huhuhu...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_13_BAD_.text:
You should apologize to the farmers who provided you
with the produce you used to bake this loaf of bread!
No, you should beg for forgiveness to the very earth itself!

All those beautiful, beautiful crops, wasted for nothing...
The farmers would weep to see the crimes being committed
in your bakery.

Blegh!
Are you sure this is edible?
At least you haven't used any pumpkins in baking this monstrosity.
Otherwise, I'd never have forgiven you!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_13_GOOD.text:
I never knew food other than pumpkins could taste so good.
What did you call this again?

Yes, I can taste the hard work of the farmers
who grew the ingredients that went into your bread.
I have to admit, I can appreciate your respect for
not only the food you make but also the earth and its gifts.

... Huh, this is tastier than I expected. I guess I should eat something other than pumpkins every once in a while. Who's the farmer who provides you with the produce? I'd like to take a tour of their farm.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_13_ORDE.text:
Do you have pumpkin pie?
Or anything pumpkin-flavored?
... Nothing? Tsk...
Then give me something sweet with a slight nutty flavor.

If you don't have any pumpkins on hand,
I'd like anything that tastes similar
and is smeared in sweet cream.

I'd like to order something
that is healthy and sweet, just like pumpkins!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_13_SOSO.text:
As I thought,
everything is worse without pumpkins.

Bland, bland, bland!
I should have gone to that bakery with pumpkin pie
in that other neighborhood.

What am I supposed to be tasting?
I can't even bite into this.
How disappointing.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_14_ORDE.text:
Oh... Judging by that stare, it seems like
they have an unhealthy obsession with sausages.

Chestnuts, walnuts...
and some meat topping as well? Okie dokie, order received!

The triple combination of
nuts... meat... AND fruit? You know what you're talking about!
I'll be right back with your order!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_15_BAD_.text:
I asked for bread that dogs would ALSO like,
not dog food, nya! I think you misheard my order!

This trap will fool no one, nya!
I came all the way here for nothing, nya!

... You're Dox's accomplice, aren't you, nya?!
That's why you're torturing a poor cute kitty cat like me, nya!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_15_GOOD.text:
Ooh, what a mouth-watering smell, nya!
Hee hee hee... With this tra- ... I mean, loaf of bread,
I'll finally give that dog what he deserves, nya!

It smells so nice, nya...
I want to eat it myself, nya...
Gulp! I need to get a hold of myself, nya!
This is exactly what I needed! It's the cat's meow, nya!

All the dogs in the neighborhood will die for this loaf of bread, nya!
Huhu, thank you, nya!
I'll come back again, nya!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_15_ORDE.text:
Let's see~ Is there anything that puppies like, nya~?
Add lots and lots of nuts, nya!

I'd like a meat bun
that will tempt all the dogs in the neighborhood, nya!
Oh, but with walnuts, nya!

One cheese bun
that smells good enough
to captivate the nose of any dog in the continent, nya!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_15_SOSO.text:
Hmm... I'm unsure whether this bread will be enough, nya...
I guess I could grind in some dog treats, nya.

Are you sure you put meat in this bun, nya?
Because I can't smell any, nya.
My plans have been foiled, nya!

I don't think this will be enough to lure that dog, nya!
This plan is a failure, nya.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_16_BAD_.text:
What peculiarly shaped bread.
And... rather pungent.

...
I-I just remembered that I had urgent business to attend to.
I must leave. At once.
Erm, please dispose of that bread as you see fit.

I'm a little scared to put this in my mouth...
... You worked hard to bake this, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I-I apologize. I should have known better
than to judge a book by its cover... or bread by its crust.
Well... here I go... Cough, cough!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_16_GOOD.text:
I... I don't know what to say.
I've never eaten such delicious bread before.
Did you bake it yourself?
... I sometimes wonder about how perfect you are,
{PLAYER_NAME}. Thank you for everything.

I never knew such delicious food existed in the world.
Have I been missing out on the delights of life?
I now understand why people will wait for hours on end
to eat at a particular restaurant -
like the customers of this bakery.

Am I even worthy of eating this masterpiece?
I feel that I haven't paid enough for this experience.
I know I'm not good at expressing myself,
but please know that I'm sincere when I thank you for the delicious meal.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_16_ORDE.text:
Ah, the bakery is still crowded with customers...
Everything looks delicious, so it's hard to choose just one.
Can I order savory bread with vegetables and nuts?

Hello, I came in for a quick meal.
What can I order for my daily intake of vegetables and protein?
No meat for me today, please.

Remember to take breaks in between and pace yourself.
My order? Oh, I'd like one with walnuts and cheese.
And maybe another surprise topping that's fresh?
What do you recommend?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_16_SOSO.text:
Is this meant to be hardtack?
... Oh? It's not?

Your baking is improving,
especially considering how recently you started working here.
I hope you keep up the good work.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_17_BAD_.text: Okay, let me tell you straight because you obviously don't understand what I'm saying. Shut this place down because your bread is a threat to all humankind!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_17_ORDE.text:
Oh, this? This is a dairy product called cheese!
Of course, I'll add lots of fruit, too!

Savory bread with piquant fruit?
I know just the recipe you'll like!

Black... circles...
And squishy yellow paper?
Did we stock such ingredients?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_18_BAD_.text:
... Is it my presence that is contaminating the objects around me?
I didn't know my symptoms had worsened.

Ugh. My stomach hurts just by looking at it.
Let's leave.

... We stood in line for THIS?
It resembles a deformed failure of an ethically questionable experiment.

I'm not sure if it's safe to eat.
There was a small shop nearby... Let's go try our luck there.
This bread reeks of dark magic.

That's what I think, too.
You've created a fragment of darkness deeper than my own.
Who are you...?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_18_GOOD.text:
... Huh.
I never knew vegetables could taste okay.

That's because the baker put much care into baking this delicious bread.
Huhu, thank you.

You seem to like your vegetables better
than you said you would!
... Whatever. It isn't as bad as I thought.

Frederick's usually picky about what he eats,
but he seems to like the bread from this bakery.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_18_ORDE.text: Ugh, this has olives. I hate olives.

Don't be a picky eater, Frederick.
Add everything healthy to our order, please.

One loaf of bread, please, that is both savory and sweet.
... Oh, with vegetables, of course.
... Do we really need to include vegetables?

... I'd like soft, fluffy bread with cheese, please.
... I don't need vegetables. Or olives.
Especially olives.

You need to eat your vegetables, Frederick.
A healthy, nutritious diet is important for kids your age,
and that includes vegetables.
... You know we're the same age, right?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_18_SOSO.text:
Ew. What did you put in here?
... I'm not eating this.

Frederick... Just one bite...?
... Well, you're right that this doesn't taste good at all.
There's no helping it, then.

I... I'm not sure what this is.
Um, is this supposed to taste like this?
You were the one who demanded adding vegetables. Olives are especially evil. Everyone knows that.
I guess the popularity of a store doesn't guarantee the quality of its wares. I was misled by the crowd... ... I'm sorry.

Why are you the one apologizing?
I didn't want to eat vegetables anyway.
Let's find another restaurant.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_19_BAD_.text:
I've had my fair share of being the butt of a joke,
but this, in my opinion, is one of the worst.
A 'bakery' shouldn't be handing out food waste to its customers!

This is a... rock.
I thought this place was a bakery.
Was I mistaken?

You - a baker, of all people - shouldn't be playing with your food!
I've had enough. I'm calling for a health inspector from the kingdom.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_19_GOOD.text:
Ah, this deep flavor with crisp notes of fresh produce...
It certainly relieves the weariness of the road!
Every bite holds a grand feast in my mouth!
The nutty tones in between add variety to both taste and texture
that otherwise might have been slightly monotonous!
Perfect! Full marks!

Can this be the legendary bread baked only once in a century
and is said to taste like paradise itself? 
This harmonious ensemble of meat, nuts, and vegetables...
It's beautiful both inside and out.
I'm only sad that I can purchase only one loaf at a time.
I'll certainly return for another!

Très bon! It is ridiculous that you are selling such divine bread
only in this small town! Trust my judgement when I say that you should
immediately expand your business and export across the continent -
I've traveled everywhere and have never eaten such a delicacy before.
Your bread must be decreed national treasure,
your bakery a holy site!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_19_ORDE.text:
I've been waiting all day to try your bread!
Let's see... Nothing is more important in food than the subtle nuance
that arises as a result of combining harmonious ingredients.
Show me what you can do with sausage, fruits, and vegetables.

Mmmm... The smell of freshly baked bread is one of the reasons
I fight to protect the peace. Those olives look of good quality...
I'd like to order a handful, and perhaps some fruit as well
for a loaf of bread that makes for a hearty meal.

Ah, my turn at last!
I'd like to see your specials, please, 
preferably with an assortment of ingredients
including meat and nuts,
as I've traveled a long way from home.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_19_SOSO.text:
... I've had better.
This is ordinary, at best.
I wonder why everyone was so excited about this bakery?

The culinary arts are an essential aspect of culture,
which I see hasn't developed much in this region of the Empire.
I'm rather disappointed. Nothing about this is special.

Hmm. I didn't dislike it,
but this is hardly worth the long journey.
I thank you for the meal anyway.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_21_ORDE.text:
This customer wants sausage bread
that is soft and fluffy!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_22_BAD_.text:
What evil did you summon with your oven?
This loaf of bread still has pieces of dough in it!
Ugh! I'll stop before I get carried away and crush the dreams of another
trainee in the food industry. Throw this away while I see myself out!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_22_GOOD.text:
It's amazing how perfectly you took my order!
Please stay safe, as rumors of 'too' delicious food
will sometimes lure monsters to your shop.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_22_ORDE.text: Hello! The townspeople introduced this bakery as the best in the neighborhood. Let's see... What combination has never been tried before, has meat, and maximizes the fluffy texture of bread?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_22_SOSO.text:
Hmm? I don't recognize this flavor...
and the texture isn't fluffy at all.
I'm surprised that you can run business like this!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_23_BAD_.text:
Critical error! Corrupted data!
Critical error! Corrupted data!
Critical error! Corrupted data!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_23_GOOD.text:
Analyzing nutritional data: 224g. 510 kcal.
Sugars 7%. Protein 34%. Carbohydrates 35%.
Saturated fat 13%. Sodium 11%.
Requested components confirmed.
Concluding request.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_23_ORDE.text:
Purchase request: bread.
Requesting components: processed fruit and vegetables, processed meat, dairy products, wheat flour.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_23_SOSO.text:
Analyzing nutritional data: 120g. 268 kcal.
Total fat 44%. Protein 11%. Carbohydrates 45%.
Lacking requested components. 
New request: refund.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_24_BAD_.text:
I hope you're playing a prank on me. Y-you're not?
B-but I'll be banished from Pumpkin City if I take THIS back!
Maybe I should go find another bakery...

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_24_GOOD.text:
Oh, everyone should like at least one ingredient in this loaf of bread!
Hee hee... You saved my day!
Thank you so very much!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_24_ORDE.text:
Hullo! I'd like to buy some bread...
Erm, w-what kind? Oh, no! I forgot to ask!
Erm... Maybe a little bit of everything -
everything that's tasty?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_24_SOSO.text:
Hmm... There must be a problem with your oven,
or you must have forgotten to add one of your ingredients.
Sigh... Could you wait a little while I return and check the order again?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_25_GOOD.text: Ta... Tatanyan? Ta-a-nyan! Nyanyan! Tanyanyan! Nyan~!!!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_25_ORDE.text:
Chestnuts... Cream...
I'm sorry, can you repeat that?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_26_GOOD.text: ...! Chirp! Chirp, chirp! Squeal! Kurururu... Chirp!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_26_ORDE.text:
Hmm... My Animal language skills are a bit rusty...
Did you say, 'veggie bread with cheese'?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_27_BAD_.text:
Squeak!
W-what a terrible smell!
... I've figured it out.
You're that cat thief's accomplice, aren't you!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_27_GOOD.text:
When you have eliminated the impossible...
whatever remains, however delicious, must be the truth!
She must have injected deadly poison in a loaf of bread,
not unlike this one. Thank you for your help!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_27_ORDE.text:
Sniff... Sniff, sniff... The cheese bread lying on the floor that day,
to the well-trained eye an obvious trap...
and this smell of meat wafting from this bakery.
The two seem to be undeniably connected - but how?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_27_SOSO.text:
Sniff, sniff... This isn't the scent I caught...
I've run into a dead end, woof!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_28_BAD_.text:
Does this contain any chestnuts at all?
Because I'm not tasting it.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_28_GOOD.text:
This is an unusual recipe. But...
It works! Thank you, it's delicious!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_28_ORDE.text:
Ooh, those chestnuts look delicious! Okay, I want those chestnuts...
And maybe some meat or dairy products. What do you recommend?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_28_SOSO.text:
Hmm... Mixing all those ingredients together
wasn't such a good idea.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_29_BAD_.text:
Erm, I... don't think you can call this... thing... 'bread.'
Never mind. I'll buy myself some chocolates from the shop next door.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_29_GOOD.text:
Ahem! Gimme one more! What do you mean, you can't?
Of course you can! Here, let me show you!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_29_ORDE.text:
I want chocolate bread~ Huh, you don't have any...?
Then... Give me bread that looks similar and tastes sweet, too...
And put in some chestnuts, too~!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_29_SOSO.text:
Hmm... Could have used more chocolate.
Still, thanks!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_30_ORDE.text: Nyanyanyang nyaranyang! Nyanyanyanyan nyanyarang nyannyarang nyannya~

Oh, sausage bread? Of course!
And I'll put in some healthy vegetables, too!
Huh? Are you curious about these red beans?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_31_BAD_.text:
... Do you think you can patronize me just because
I'm a backwater forest Elf who doesn't leave her forest very often?
I know what 'bread' looks like, and that's not it.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_31_GOOD.text:
And I thought all those people were exaggerating.
I can see now that they were speaking the truth. ... Thanks.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_31_ORDE.text:
Ugh. With all this light in my eyes, I can't see the menu properly...
I want savory bread baked with vegetables.
I rather not have any cream.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_31_SOSO.text:
Sigh... I should have known better than to believe those rumors.
This bread wasn't worth leaving my forest
for the cruel outside world!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_32_BAD_.text:
Blegh! I said I wanted to lose weight, not my life!
I'd rather be chubby than eat this rubbish!

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_32_GOOD.text:
Oh, this is divine. I could just continue eating and eating...
Who cares about calories when you can eat such a delicacy?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_32_ORDE.text:
I'm watching my weight these days.
I want vegetables and gluten-free flour.
You don't have gluten-free options? What kind of bakery is this?

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SPECIAL_BREAD_32_SOSO.text: A little bland... Well, at least it fills your stomach.

TEXT_EVENT_CHOCOLA_WALNUT_DESC.text:
Crunchy, savory walnuts.

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_1.text: What do you think of the new Library? Do you like it?

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_10.text: Woof! Don't come any closer, woof! What do you need?

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_11.text: I only know about stealing things, meow! Make Dox do it instead!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_12.text: Open up! I know a cat burglar just went in there! Open the door now!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_13.text: There's no one home, meow! I'll set a dog on you if you don't leave!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_14.text: Whew... That was close. Now that I think about it, you two aren't too safe, either.

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_15.text: Not at all, meow! Our copyrights have already expired and belong to the public domain, meow!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_16.text: Lupeow's right, woof! We're closer to 'original characters'! I'm not a consulting detective, I'm a private eye, woof!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_2.text: Ugh... What's this light? It's too - strong...!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_3.text: Follow the movement... You're feeling happy... Very, very happy...

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_4.text: Ahh... Sungmin... He's... He's a god...

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_5.text: Hrrmph. See what you've done? Are you happy now?

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_6.text: Yes, I'm happy now. I like all the different clothes.

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_7.text: ?!! What are you doing?! We don't have time for this, meow!

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_8.text: Woof... The decision of the Dimensions... is nearing... Woof...

TEXT_EVENT_FIFTH_LOBBY_9.text: So, here's everyone who stood in my way. What ending shall I give you, hmm?
