We've been walking all day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_02.text:
You have the experience!
We've been partners for quite some time now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_03.text:
Of course, there are other Death Messengers
who can guide the souls to the underworld...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_04.text:
... but I don't want to risk having that barbaric reaper from the
West dragging away spirits with no regard for their welfare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_05.text: Ugh... Just the thought of that idiot annoys me to no end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_06.text:
Anyway!
You're one of the few men I can trust, Bihyeongrang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_07.text: That's why I really need to ask this favor of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_08.text:
Please look over my district and see if
anyone is upsetting the balance of the realms

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_09.text:
or causing disruptions to the borders,
or if any souls have lost their way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_20_10.text: It shouldn't be too much trouble for you, I hope.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_02.text:
I still think that you should disentangle yourself from the
realm of spirits and keep away from ghosts, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_03.text:
... you're not planning on changing your mind
any time soon, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_21_05.text:
Ask as many times as you want, but I have no intentions
whatsoever of parting with my ghosts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_01.text:
Sigh... People these days can be so stubborn!
Then I'll just give you a piece of advice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_02.text:
I'm still uncomfortable
with leaving you behind like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_04.text:
You could accompany me to the Volcano
and help me with my tasks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_22_05.text:
Bihyeongrang too received his titles
in recognition of his contributions to my work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_23_02.text:
Oh, I can read you like an open book, Bihyeongrang!
I trust that you'll do fine. Just don't end up killing each other!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_23_03.text: Okie? Okie! Then I'll see myself off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_24_04.text: So... How should we go about doing this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_25_01.text:
It's a busy job, delivering souls to the underworld.
And I had no idea it was so... bureaucratic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_25_02.text:
I'm curious about this 'Great King Yama,' though.
I wonder if we can meet him someday?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_2_02.text:
Yes, you have indeed come a long way.
I apologize for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_01.text: ... Are you the one who sent the Vaisravana?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_02.text:
Yes. 'A child fathered by a ghost.'
Do you find the phrase familiar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_3_03.text: I am no stranger to your predicament. I wish to help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_02.text:
From my childhood, I have been able to sense the 
presence of spirits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_03.text:
Others were not so acceptable of that fact. I had to leave
my motherland to protect my family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_4_04.text:
You remind me of myself,
when I was young.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_5_01.text:
... I'm not sure whether to take that as a compliment,
seeing that it comes from a complete stranger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_5_02.text:
However - you still seem to order ghosts around
How do you mean to help me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_01.text: Ahem... I apologize if I seem intrusive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_02.text:
I received the title of Ghost King from the Great King Yama
and have used my powers for the two realms ever since:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_6_03.text:
guiding souls on their long journey to the afterlife,
helping those tortured by evil spirits...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_01.text:
Great King Yama?
... So he really does exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_02.text:
Yes, as someone who has been invited to his palace
in the Kingdom of Yama, I can confirm it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_03.text:
As I was saying, I have been watching you, and your
powers, uncontrolled as they are, harbor great potential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_7_04.text:
Should you find yourself too weary to linger any longer
in the realm of spirits, there is another path you can take: mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_01.text: ... And how do I know I can trust you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_02.text:
Vaisravana may answer to your call,
but why should I?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_03.text:
I did not receive my title
of the Ghost King for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_8_04.text:
... Look around you. Listen.
Do you not sense the difference in the air?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_01.text: ... I thought it was strangely quiet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_02.text:
So you were the reason the usually talkative ghosts
have been keeping their tongues.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_03.text:
I may have been underestimating you,
I have to admit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_18_9_04.text:
I have no intentions of harming the ghosts by your side.
You have no reason to fear me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_1_01.text:
This must be where Halla saw Hanee Baram last...
But where can she be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_01.text: Hanee Baram, I've been looking everywhere for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_05.text: The wind... carried the scent of a dear old friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_06.text:
It has been decades, and you still haven't forgotten me -
I am thankful for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_08.text: Where have you been? We've missed you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_10.text: I apologize for troubling you with my long absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_2_11.text: I have been atoning for my sins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_3_02.text:
The Eungaram I know...
would never do something so bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_3_03.text: But I did. And I have been regretting it ever since.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_02.text: I drove an innocent girl to her death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_04.text:
A rich human, coveting me for his collection of curiosities,
imprisoned me in his birdcage for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_05.text:
I was helpless, as I had lost my powers,
being so far away from my river.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_06.text:
The girl was a maid working at the rich man's mansion.
She was my beacon of hope in those dark times.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_07.text: She had beautiful hair, the color of calm and fresh water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_09.text:
She talked to me every day, even though
I was trapped in my bird form and could not reply.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_10.text:
For my sake she recounted the smallest details of her day,
the things that interested her in the outside world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_11.text:
Her little stories and smiles
became the only thing I awaited in the rich man's cage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_12.text: I could sing with pure joy before her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_13.text:
One day, the girl gave me a gift of rainbow-colored
pebble, saying that it reminded her of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_14.text:
As fate would have it, she had found it on the banks of my
river. Through the pebble, I recovered some of my magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_16.text: I should have been more careful then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_17.text:
I regained enough of my power to speak once more,
and so I beseeched the girl for my freedom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_18.text:
It was only with her help
that I could escape my cage and return to my river.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_19.text:
I went free. But my disappearance...
The girl had to pay a harsh price in my stead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_20.text: ... So that is why the girl...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_21.text: Yes. For saving my life, she lost hers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_23.text:
I realized too late the gravity of my decision. I asked myself
countless times: what if I had chosen not to leave?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_24.text:
What if I had chosen to stay with the girl a little longer,
respond to her great kindness with my own?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_25.text:
Why had I been so hasty to flee from my cage without so
much as asking the name of the one who had freed me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_26.text:
The girl was my only friend, the one person I lived for. 
Gave her up for freedom that now pales before her memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_28.text:
I isolated myself from everything for many years… Alone
in the cage of my own making, the cage of my heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_29.text:
... I can't bear to see you like this, Eungaram.
And neither would the girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_30.text: ... You have to let her go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_4_31.text: I cannot. Her image is engraved too clearly in my mind...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_6_01.text: I'm sorry. I was searching for someone...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_7_01.text:
Hair the color of water...
Could it be...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_7_03.text:
No...
I'm hoping for the impossible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_19_9_01.text: May I have the honor of knowing your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_01.text:
I have not been living under a rock; I'm simply reminding
you that only Guardian Spirits can enter this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_02.text: Weeellll... But... It's - it's Halla's birthday!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_03.text:
And it seems that you two hardly know each other. You
two must have met only a few days before, if not today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_04.text:
Don't you know that strangers are just friends we haven't
met before? We can become friends here at this party!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_05.text:
And do you not remember the tragedy that transpired
when outsiders last invaded our sacred grounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_06.text: Our few laws exist for a reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_10_07.text:
Those were the evil humans who wanted to cause harm in
the first place! Can't you see everyone here is a friend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_01.text: Erm... It is my birthday... Let's stop fighting, hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_02.text: Yeah, we can't waste our time arguing on a good day like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_03.text: And it's not like all humans are bad.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_04.text:
The ones who destroyed my forest and Halla's mountains
were humans, were they not?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_05.text:
Well... I don't have anything to say to THAT… Bu-ut! I
still think it's unfair to discriminate against all humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_06.text:
What about your special someone - the one who gave
you that pebble you carry around everywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_08.text:
That human girl... was different.
She was like no other human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_11.text:
And we outnumber humans! Even if - and that's a big 'if' -
she has an ulterior motive, she won't be able to do much.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_12_12.text:
And look at that face! Now that's the face of someone
who can truly enjoy parties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_13_01.text:
Well, then... I suppose it would be all right,
for this day and this day only.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_14_01.text: Happy birthday! Here's your birthday tteok!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_01.text:
I came without delay
as soon as they were out of the steam pot. Whew!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_02.text:
Gather around
and eat up while it's still hot, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_03.text:
Erm... She's my guest of honor. Everyone should be
already acquainted, except for Eungaram and Neulsolgil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_05.text: She may be a human, but she is an old friend of mine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_06.text:
When my mountains burned and my powers with them,
and I had nowhere to go,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_07.text:
it was only Malsook and her tteok
that helped me overcome my troubles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_08.text:
If I can't invite a good friend to my own party, what's
the point of living one more year having a party -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_15_10.text: I do think you all could be more careful, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_16_01.text:
There is... one more guest to arrive...
And I was the one who invited her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_17_02.text:
How is everyone?
I hope you all have been doing well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_01.text: And with Haerang's arrival, we can start the party.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_02.text:
Ooh, so nice to meet you! That energy flowing from you...
I'll be looking forward to your dance moves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_04.text:
Eungaram! It's not everyday we can gather like this. Stop
worrying and enjoy quality time with your friends!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_05.text: Come on, a single day of partying won't do anyone any harm! Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_06.text:
... I suppose that a few exceptions can be made,
as it is Halla's birthday party.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_18_08.text: Good! Now, as we've ironed out all the wrinkles...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_01.text:
Pant, pant! I seem to have - cough -
underestimated the energy of Guardian Spirits...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_02.text:
Who knew they could be literal party animals?
I've been playing for DAYS!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_03.text: Don't stop the music! Keep on playing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_19_04.text: I - ugh - need a break! Pant, pant...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_02.text:
Hee hee... Thank you for coming.
I'm happy that everyone could come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_03.text: And how old are you supposed to be, again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_1_04.text:
Hmm... I haven't kept count, but it's been about 200 years
since I held my first 'birthday' as a conscious Spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_01.text: What? You can't stop now! Get back up, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_04.text:
What an energetic Mountain Spirit. She doesn't get tired.
I've never recorded a Guardian Spirit's birthday before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_20_05.text:
I guess 'birthdays' don't mean much for them anymore,
except as an excuse for a long overdue gathering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_01.text:
Oh... I've been forgetting how old you were,
with your current physical form...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_02.text: Again? I thought you'd remember after the last time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_03.text: You too, Hanee Baram? Me, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_04.text:
I keep forgetting Halla is not the itty bitty tiger cub
he seems and is, in fact, much, much older than me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_05.text:
Please stay little like this, Halla!
I like you as you are right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_06.text: Oh, stop teasing me. Not on my birthday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_2_08.text:
Hmm... I agree with Neulsolgil.
You're so little and cute now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_3_01.text:
Anyway! As it is your birthday today, we invited over
some friends! They should be here any minute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_4_01.text: Thank you for inviting me. I am glad that I'm not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_5_01.text: Am I the last to arrive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_01.text: Who needs some music to jazz up this party~?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_03.text:
The HMA's shining champion - Jeomrye's in the house!
Give me a 'whoop, whoop'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_04.text: HMA? Do you know what those letters are supposed to mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_05.text: Nope, not a clue - but who cares? This is SO MUCH FUN!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_8_06.text:
By the time I'm done here, nobody will remain standing!
So get ready for a legendary night of hardcore rock!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_01.text: Yeee! Human music is so wild!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_02.text: And she's so good! I knew she wasn't famous for nothing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_03.text:
This is unacceptable. You cannot simply let humans
enter a sacred forest of a Guardian Spirit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_04.text: Oh, I wasn't aware there was going to be a problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_20_9_05.text:
Apparently, you've been living under a rock. This is THE
most popular haeguem player in all of Hasla right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_01.text:
You called yourself Schild, didn't you?
I can sense the power of a dragon from you, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_02.text:
Oh, me too, Mr. Dragon. Or should I say, Mr. Black Worm?
I can't be compared to such a primitive life form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_03.text:
... Me, THE incarnation of the Black Dragon, a 'Black
Worm'? I won't fall for your goading.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_04.text:
Oh, I don't mean to fight. I'm just putting into words
what I'm seeing right now with my own #eyes#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_06.text: Calm down, friend. She means no harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_07.text:
She is simply stating the fact that there is an overwhelming,
unassailable gulf of pure strength between us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_10_08.text:
You, too? Oh, for the sake of Hasla! What sins have I
committed that I must put up with this kind of treatment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_01.text:
Haha, look at him screaming in frustration.
I change my mind. He entertains me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_02.text: Pius, can I play with him instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_03.text:
... He is much bigger than those little creatures you've
been bothering, but take caution not to break him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_04.text: For the first time in my life, I want to go back to school.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_05.text:
As you've found your family or member of the same species
or whatever, I'll be seeing myself back to the Empi--

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_06.text:
Oh, hold up, Mr. Worm. I'm just getting started.
Let's see how durable you mortals are, hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_11_07.text: G-get away from me! Step back! I-I'm warning you -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_01.text:
Sigh... I've been worrying that this would happen for some
time, now. The #Children of the Stars#... have awoken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_02.text:
Be careful, {PLAYER_NAME}. They are strangers to this
dimension and the rules that uphold this dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_12_03.text:
The dangers that threaten to destroy Hasla are no longer
restricted to the war between light and darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_1_03.text:
The layers of time, sedimented in our physical bodies in
this lower dimension... are interfering with our thoughts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_1_04.text:
To return to the vast sea of stars...
I must make my choice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_01.text:
And he speaks, ladies and gentlemen!
What were you thinking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_02.text: ... Ah, it is nothing of consequence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_04.text:
You've been sitting there for eight hours straight
without even blinking! You scared me back there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_06.text:
It is still hard to adjust to this... constricted flow of
time that upholds your four-dimensional time-space.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_07.text:
Yet I too must adjust, if I am to remain confined within
the limits of this malleable body, stripped of memory -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_3_08.text:
Yeah, yeah. Let's save the physics lesson for later.
We've finally arrived.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_01.text: ... Yes. I can sense her nearby.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_02.text:
Hey, a 'thank you' would be nice. The #Peaks of Glory#
aren't the most welcoming of places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_03.text:
Not everyone can sneak past those Roman soldiers
while hiding a slowpoke like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_04.text:
You should thank your lucky stars that it was me
who found you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_05.text:
Yes, thank you, #Gangcheol#. I would have remained in
the hands of the white-steel-wielding humans, otherwise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_06.text:
I will repay your kindness. I swear it on my name -
and the skies of glory beyond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_07.text:
Hey, I was just messing with you. There's no need for
such a formal thank you between fellow #dragons#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_4_08.text: Dragons...? No, you are mistaken. My siblings and I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_5_01.text: Huh? Was that a kid just now? In these mountains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_5_02.text:
That could be #Schild#. She too should have lost her
memories and may be in danger. I must go to her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_01.text:
Let me go! How dare you touch my wings with your
slimy hands! Almael, shoot down this giant barbarian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_02.text: Delrien, I'm trapped too, in her other hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_03.text: Waaaah! Daddy, where are you? I need you, Daddy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_04.text:
Haha, what a funny little family! The dad and the
daughter are both helplessly at my mercy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_05.text:
Didn't you see what I did with your dear daddy? He won't
be returning from beyond those mountains any time soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_06.text:
I-I'll get you for this! The blue-haired human and the
Beast King will take revenge for this utter brutality!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_6_07.text:
Yeah, yeah. Bring on all your unicorn friends
and see if I blink an eye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_03.text: Oh? Pius! What are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_04.text:
Is it so strange to seek reunion with one's sole
remaining kinsman in an unfamiliar world?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_05.text:
However... What are you doing, Schild? You must be
more compassionate towards those little life forms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_06.text:
Ugh. I may have lost my memories, but I'll bet all my eyes
that you've always been an annoying, patronizing bore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_07.text:
And this inconvenient amnesia doesn't make me any less
smart or badass. Who says 'this' isn't the true me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_08.text:
It's not my fault that they're so tiny
and seem so fun to play with!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_7_09.text:
Restrain yourself. Remember that we too are 'tiny' compared
to our true form, and will remain so for some time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_01.text:
What are they talking about? None of what they're saying
has to do anything with me and I don't like it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_02.text:
Shh, Delrien! Keeping our mouths shut
is our best chance at escape!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_03.text: Escape? The Great Fairy Queen has to escape like a -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_8_05.text: Wow, those fairies are living in their own little world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_01.text: Oh, you take the fun out of everything. Thanks a lot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_02.text:
You there. I'll let you go this one time,
so scram while you have the chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_03.text: Hey! Who do you think you are, you shi---mmbbbubumm!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_001_21_9_04.text:
You idiot - I mean, Your Most Royal Highness!
We have to run while we can! Come ON!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_1_001.text:
So many valuable artifacts and records of our ancestors...
This excavation has also proved to be a success.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_1_002.text:
I know I must be happy,
but something does not feel right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_001.text: Lorelei, you seem worried. What is it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_002.text:
Osiris. You told me that your people
fell to ruin one hundred years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_003.text: Yes, that is the history we have inherited from our ancestors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_004.text:
Had the tragedy happened further in the past,
the descendants of our tribe would have been far fewer than now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_005.text:
And it was also a century ago that
the Goddesses and the Apostles fought the Great War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_2_006.text:
As the specifics of the War remain veiled to this day, 
I can't be too certain in posing my suspicions, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_001.text:
Isn't it strange? 
A whole kingdom disappeared only a century ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_002.text:
And yet nobody remembered even its existence
until we found it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_003.text:
The Temple of Illusions is not the only thing
veiled in shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_004.text:
I have traveled all over Hasla on many expeditions,
and have encountered these missing links before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_005.text:
Absences that should not be there.
Certain gaps and voids in people's memories... Forgotten and missing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_3_006.text: ... Almost as if they had been hidden by someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_4_001.text:
You mean to say that a particular person or faction
has hidden certain events in the past, deliberately?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_4_002.text:
And those events are centered on a single point in time: exactly
one hundred years ago. I would not have believed you some time ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_4_003.text:
...but now that I know the true history of our people,
I think your suspicions are justified.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_4_004.text:
Perhaps the 'Kalard'
that Jeraphim mentioned in the Temple is related to all this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_5_001.text: ... I do not know what to think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_5_002.text:
If someone really did attempt to erase history
for some ulterior motive that I cannot even begin to imagine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_5_003.text: ... Then what can I, a mere archaeologist, do in the face of such evil?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_6_001.text:
Try as they might, 
they can't hide the truth forever, Lorelei.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_6_002.text:
The previous generation will have left us some sign
so that we may discover and claim true history once more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_6_003.text:
…Like we've already done with our heritage of
the Rosetta Stone and the Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_6_004.text:
Lorelei, you must have faith in yourself.
You are the 'Seeker of Truth' after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_7_003.text:
Today is a good day - I should enjoy it more!
And if I give up now, I'd just be giving Set an excuse to complain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_7_004.text:
Because you're right,
I AM the Seeker of Truth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_7_005.text: Now, then! Shall we return to work?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_8_001.text:
Those two are hard at work
excavating the Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_4_8_002.text:
... And that Lorelei...
She shows true potential.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_10_01.text: Hee hee... So that's how you want to play it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_10_02.text:
The royal blood that courses through your veins...
will one day divide you three, each to a different future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_10_03.text:
I only wait for the day...
when I will stand by the Sun God once more...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_11_01.text:
The Millennial Kingdom of the Sun God...
Ah, the name brings back fond memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_1_01.text: Huh, they should be here by now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_01.text:
Ah, welcome.
I see you received the 'prophecy.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_02.text: Eek! Set! What do we do? She's really here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_03.text:
Dammit, there goes my last hope that everything was a coincidence.
Hey, you there. The one with the mask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_04.text:
Are you the one who sent Isis and me
the same dream for the last few nights?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_05.text:
That dream... Telling us in a creepy voice
to 'come find me at the Temple of Anubisis.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_06.text:
Okay, you don't need to reenact it. Sorry about the whole
'mysterious oracle' thing. I thought I'd need to scare you into action.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_2_07.text:
I am Nefer.
I am the last of the Millennial Kingdom remaining upon this earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_3_01.text:
What? 'The Millennial Kingdom'?
Sounds like a cult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_3_02.text:
Isis. This isn't worth our time.
Let's go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_3_04.text: Take one more step and I end everything here and now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_4_01.text:
Eek! What is that?
I knew she was a ghost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_4_02.text:
A body bound together by necromancy...
You don't belong to this time, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_4_03.text:
I can't say for sure.
I only know I died a long time ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_4_04.text:
Records would help me identify the circumstances of my death, 
but it looks as if even the ruins of the royal castle have disappeared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_01.text:
Ugh...
I just know I'm going to have another nightmare tonight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_02.text:
So, O Grand and Mighty Millennial One,
what business do you have with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_03.text:
Thought you could give some unnecessary advice
on the kingdom we're trying to rebuild?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_04.text: Hee hee... What would I know about rebuilding kingdoms?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_05.text:
But I do know who should rightfully sit on the throne
of this new kingdom of yours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_06.text:
We follow Osiris and only Osiris.
If you're trying to trick us into serving some soft-headed idiot -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_5_07.text:
The rightful heir to the throne is you.
The last of the holy bloodline... The Sun God's descendant, Set.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_6_02.text:
Oh, so you really don't know.
This is awkward, now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_6_03.text:
Didn't the spirits tell you the truth
after being freed from that Something-Temple?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_6_04.text:
You're the one who succeeded the necromantic arts of the Desert...
The sun's heir who eternally defies death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_7_01.text: What's important is our will to live in the present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_7_02.text: It was Osiris who first stood up for our people of the Desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_7_03.text:
If not for him, we would have continued to aimlessly roam the wilderness,
anchored to a bygone glory that can never be recovered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_7_04.text:
I won't let myself or anyone else
be so easily swayed by a ghost of the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_8_01.text:
Set, were you really thinking all these things?
I mean, I approve of this change, but it's very sudden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_8_02.text:
I never asked you to approve of me, so stop treating me like a brat.
I'm off. I've had enough for today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_5_9_01.text: Um, then I'll be going as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_10_1.text:
Huh?
Wait, is that you, Aramis?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_10_2.text: Aramis, where have you been all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_10_4.text:
It's been a while, I admit. What brings the whole lot of
you out here in the desert?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_10_5.text: Oh, we were pursuing King Ab-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_10_6.text:
Wait, darling. We don't want to divulge important
information to a potential spy who abandoned her post.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_1.text:
Rochefort!
A-Aramis. What he means is -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_2.text:
... It's alright, sweetie. I would have been suspicious
too, if it were the other way around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_3.text:
I'm rather relieved that our Captain's sarcasm hasn't
gone anywhere. It almost feels like a warm welcome.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_4.text:
Thank you for noticing. Then, Aramis. Let's hope
your reasons for vanishing are persuasive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_5.text: ... I had a confidential assignment on the side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_7.text:
His Majesty hasn't been in a state to issue any assignments
for years... Then it must have been Cardinal Orcus.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_8.text: But did you know that he is dead? And only quite recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_11_9.text:
What...?
Die? Him? Why? To whom? When?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_1.text:
You seem surprised. Perhaps you truly didn't know that
a civil war has only recently ravaged the kingdom?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_2.text:
Cardinal Orcus launched a coup d'etat,
the Forbidden Palace serving as his command post.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_3.text:
Fortunately, a Hero Captain by the name of {PLAYER_NAME}
helped us curtail the revolt, but the damage was done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_4.text:
We could not find the Cardinal's body,
but {PLAYER_NAME} confirmed his death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_5.text:
What about my sister... Matahari?
Is she alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_6.text:
She's a known accomplice of the Cardinal. We received
reports of her escape, but not her whereabouts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_7.text:
A known accomplice? I'm only here because she's his
prisoner, not his accomplice! That can't be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_12_8.text: The Cardinal must have put her up to this; I know he did!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_13_1.text:
I have to return and find her... Captain, do you have
any information on Matahari's whereabouts? Anything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_13_2.text:
Even if I did, why should I give that information
to a possible traitor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_1.text:
Calm down, Aramis.
Everyone here is convinced that you're innocent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_2.text:
Yeah. You may act like a rebel sometimes,
but you could never be a traitor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_3.text:
Knowing you, taunting you twice could cost me my
head... And I prefer it where it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_4.text: Will you please remove your gun from my head now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_5.text:
Taunt? I'm not lying, Captain. Will you please treat
this seriously?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_6.text:
You seemed tense. Well, all things considered,
we still have a serious predicament on our hands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_7.text:
... but that is no excuse to run away like a child
and try to solve everything on your own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_14_8.text:
It would serve you well to trust your comrades, once
in a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_15_1.text:
... Fine.
I'll admit that I was acting... impulsively.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_15_2.text:
However. I'm only checking myself because I don't want
our sweet younger comrades to feel any more awkward.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_15_3.text:
If you weren't our leader, I would have smashed in your
jaw. Watch your mouth before I run out of patience.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_15_5.text:
Oh, I'm 'taunting' you.
Lighten up, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_1.text:
Fine. Now will you please tell us
what led you all the way here to the wastelands?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_2.text:
I've been following Prince Cain's tracks
under the order of the Cardinal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_3.text:
I barely caught up to him… but he fled when we got
distracted with King Abel's appearance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_4.text:
That was whom we were pursuing.
King Abel has gone missing for several days now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_5.text:
First Cain, then Abel. The kingdom must be in chaos
if both successors are absent from the actual throne.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_6.text:
The circumstances
aren't as dire as they ought to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_7.text:
Princess Ibelin, the His Majesty and Prince Cain's
half-sister, has returned to Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_8.text:
She and Saintess Maria of the Order have established
an interim government and are managing the crisis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_16_9.text:
We have been chasing His Majesty
under Princess Ibelin's orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_17_1.text:
Princess Ibelin'?
There was a third descendant of the royal line?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_17_2.text:
A royal bastard, yes. I met her several times when she
was still young and lived hidden from public eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_17_3.text: Her existence was revealed to only a few people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_17_4.text:
But her return to the kingdom seems... too perfectly
timed. And together with a Saintess of the Order?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_17_5.text:
... It fits too well
with some very disturbing information I just heard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_18_1.text:
... I'll explain on the way.
We have little enough time as it is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_19_1.text: Prince Cain's story. Can it be true?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_19_2.text:
I wonder what will happen
when the four Musketeers return to Trista?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_1.text:
The First Prince...
So the rumors were true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_2.text:
You obtained forbidden powers
from the Demons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_3.text:
Ah, I thought I sensed a competent hound chasing
after me. Aramis of the Musketeers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_4.text:
I always knew Orcus was a very persistent man. So he
finally has the Musketeers in the palm of his hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_5.text:
... The Musketeers have nothing to do with my cooperating
to the Cardinal. This is a personal matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_6.text:
You may be the former Crown Prince of Trista, but I won't
allow you to dishonor the name of the Musketeers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_7.text:
Huh. Why are you so embarrassed of your affiliation with
the Cardinal? Your Captain also once worked for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_1_8.text:
Won't you join me by my side, instead of being
exploited by that silver-tongued serpent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_2_1.text:
Huhu... There's no need to shout.
I wasn't being serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_2_2.text: I'm sure you had your reasons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_2_3.text:
... Yes, more so than the monster
who sacrificed his own brother's soul to a demon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_3_2.text:
I am aware of my reputation as a degenerate.
I won't deny my wayward ways.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_3_3.text:
However, I haven't fallen so low
as to sell my own brother's soul to a demon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_1.text:
... I saw you attacking His Majesty at the coronation
with my own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_2.text:
The chaos that ravaged Trista afterwards isn't something
that can be explained away with a lie or two!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_3.text:
It's almost funny how ignorant people are of the truth -
to the extent that they believe its exact opposite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_4.text:
It was Abel who first drew his blade, not me. I was
only defending myself. As I didn't want to die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_6.text:
The man who attacked me at the ceremony wasn't my brother.
It was an empty body, a puppet that had lost its soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_7.text:
Tsk. Do you truly believe that Abel was sent to Neth to be 'revived'?
Don't make me laugh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_8.text: The powers that I acquired may be 'demonic' in nature...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_4_9.text:
but #Devran# doesn't desire something so fragile as a
human soul. The Order of the Goddess, however...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_5_2.text: Has that idiot brother of mine arrived already?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_5_3.text: He never gives me a moment's respite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_7_1.text:
I regret to cut our conversation short,
but I must go now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_7_2.text:
... Prince Cain.
If everything you said is true...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_7_3.text: Is our true enemy the Order of the Goddess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_8_1.text:
Aramis. Do you know how many government bonds the
Order has issued the kingdom, under their name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_8_2.text:
Or how many orphans Orcus sacrificed in the Forbidden
Palace, for some obscure cause?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_8_3.text:
I only sacrificed control over my body to a demon
in order to gain power...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_8_4.text:
... to prevent the atrocities being committed in the kingdom
by the damned Cardinal and the #young Saintess#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_8_5.text:
Think, Aramis, think!
You will understand me - you are capable enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_9_2.text:
Tsk. Can you not run faster?
We will lose him at this speed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_003_6_9_3.text:
Pant... Pant... Can't we take a break?
I... I'm at my limit here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_1_001.text:
This is Reporter of Hasla Monthly,
reporting from the joyous festival grounds of Pumpkin City!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_1_002.text:
Some time ago, three witches began a contest
to decide once and for all the representative for the Pumpkin Festivals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_1_003.text:
It seems that this, erm, friendly competition has drawn in more visitors,
and the festival is turning out more lively than ever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_1_004.text:
Many are especially excited about the "Great Pumpkin War,"
which seems to involve conquering each others' pumpkin fields.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_1_005.text: Oh, here comes the manager of the festival just now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_2_001.text:
Hello, this is Reporter from the Hasla Monthly!
How is the festival going at the moment?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_2_002.text:
There are more participants than we initially expected,
but everything is proceeding in an orderly fashion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_2_003.text: The only complaint I have is the sheer workload I have to deal with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_001.text:
I mean, those three witches - they've lived long enough!
They should know better and be more mature! ... Sigh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_002.text: ... Er, I see. Were there any accidents so far that you had to tackle?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_003.text:
Accidents? Not that I am aware of...
Excluding the usual idiocy among the three, that is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_004.text:
Oh, we're missing some batches of magic markers.
The numbers aren't too far off, however... I wouldn't worry about them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_005.text: Missing markers? This sounds like a real scoop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_006.text:
I really must go to see to the rest of the preparations.
Well then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_3_007.text:
Wait, Miss Arita! Let me go with you!
I want to ask more about these missing markers -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_4_001.text:
Whew! It seems Arita hasn't noticed the nature of my...
ahem, business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_4_002.text:
But that reporter... I should be careful around her. 
She has a keen eye, that one!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_5_001.text: Huh, there should be some around here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_5_002.text:
Maybe I should wait around until the contest reaches its peak...
There doesn't seem to be a lot of markers just yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_6_001.text:
Here they are! Huhuhu...
Now, if I wash off the dirt and apply a little polish...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_6_002.text:
This Marker is now mine, good as new!
I can do whatever I want with it! Muhahaha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_10_6_003.text: It seems the Reporter has missed her big scoop again, huh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_10_01.text: I see that we got carried away in the heat of the moment,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_10_02.text: but I assure you, we were simply trying to put on a good show.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_11_01.text: I don't know... That seemed too intense to be considered mere acting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_12_01.text:
Wellll... We always strive to do our best!
We do every rehearsal as if it were the actual performance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_12_02.text: In order to make a holly and jolly Christmas for everyone,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_12_03.text: we at the 'Christmas' corporation are practicing day and night!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_12_04.text: (What a scary person! Lying like that, straight off the bat!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_14_02.text: That fight back there was just... erm... what she told you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_15_01.text: Well, goodbye then. I have to go deliver more candy to children.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_15_02.text: See you at the next 'rehearsal'! See you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_17_02.text: Did I hear what I think I just heard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_17_03.text:
I don't understand! If it really was a rehearsal that you did...
Your clearly private comments don't make any sense!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_18_01.text:
That reporter... She has a keen sense and a dogged spirit,
but doesn't seem to have the best timing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_18_02.text: However... That may be the only thing protecting her from worse trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_1_01.text: The Christmas season is nearing its end!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_1_02.text: Yet spirit of the Christmas festival still lingers in the streets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_1_03.text: This street, renowned for its celebra-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_2_01.text:
Oh, no! A crying and pouting child on Christmas,
the one day when all children should be happy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_3_01.text: A nice stranger wanted to give me candy, so I followed her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_3_02.text:
When a hairy Santa suddenly jumped out of the bushes
and attacked the nice lady!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_3_03.text: She's in danger! I have to go find someone to help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_4_01.text:
Breaking news! We've just received a report from a civilian
that a violent riot has broken out on Christmas!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_4_03.text:
I have a duty to chase all leads
and provide the best news to you, our viewers! Let's go and see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_5_02.text: I'll put an end to your crimes today once and for all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_5_03.text: Crimes? Stop acting so high and mighty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_5_04.text: You don't attack a person when she's giving out candy to children!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_6_01.text: Did you really think your crimes would go unnoticed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_6_02.text: Stop with the disgusting hypocrisy! This is the end for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_6_03.text: I won't let you ruin Christmas! Everyone, prepare to fire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_7_01.text:
And here we seem to be looking at... A violent battle!
What does this mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_7_02.text: Why are Green Elves fighting on Christmas?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_7_03.text: Do you wish to explain yourselves to our viewers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_9_01.text: Fighting~? Oh, do you mean us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_9_02.text:
You're mistaken!
We were just rehearsing for the next Christmas concert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_11_9_04.text:
(We are NOT going to fight in front of the kids! What are you, crazy?
Now shut up and follow my lead!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_1_001.text:
This is Reporter of Hasla Monthly,
reporting from Pumpkin City!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_1_002.text:
Pumpkin City is as its name suggests: this city of witches 
is famous throughout Hasla for its bountiful pumpkin harvests.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_1_003.text:
This year, the Four Witches have specially joined forces
to grow four times the amount of the usual harvest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_1_004.text:
Needless to say, the annual Pumpkin Festival
is more bustling than ever! What a celebration!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_1_005.text:
Ah! Here come the three witches of Pumpkin City who made it all happen.
Hello! This is Reporter, reporting for the Hasla Monthly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_2_001.text:
To commemorate the success of the Pumpkin Festival,
I was hoping we could hold an interview for our viewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_2_002.text: Who should I address as the representative of Pumpkin City?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_3_002.text: Pumpkins need water to grow, in which case I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_3_004.text:
No you, Wolfram!
It's definitely me who should be doing the talking!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_3_005.text:
You? With your vicious temper?
As if you could ever represent the dignity and tradition of our city!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_3_006.text: Um, I'll just go onto the next question...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_4_001.text: Oh, you are SO getting it -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_4_005.text: Um, we don't have to really -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_5_001.text: Oh, you two are SO dead -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_5_002.text: Why am I even dealing with these -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_5_003.text: No, it is you two who must -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_5_004.text:
Hey hey hey - wait! 
This - this is dangerous...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_9_5_005.text: Hmm. I wonder where Arita had gone off to...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_1_001.text: Is this thing really that important?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_1_002.text: Hey! I thought I told you to keep it safe and hidden.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_1_004.text:
You know a lot of people are looking for that thing. Please
be more careful. It's our one chance for fame and glory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_2_003.text: W-what are you?! Get away from us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_3_003.text: I-I told you to stay away! STAY AWAY!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_4_001.text:
Hee hee! Good job, Toto!
That was the cat's meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_5_001.text: NO! You can't eat that, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_5_003.text:
Hey, keep your chin up, Toto.
We can SELL it to buy food that you CAN eat, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_6_001.text:
Okay, let's go sell this ticket!
A tasty dinner's waiting for us, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_10_7_001.text:
... So THAT's how Popo acquired all those tickets.
Interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_1_001.text: I'm sure it was around here, nyan...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_1_002.text: Hmm... it should be close by...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_2_001.text:
W-what! Nya! 
Who are you, nyan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_2_002.text:
Whoa! I should be asking that question!
Who are YOU?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_2_003.text:
Hmm... You've come after my precious book,
isn't that right, nya? You look like the type!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_3_001.text:
'My' precious book? You mean mine!
It's obvious you've come to steal it, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_3_002.text:
Hrrmph, nyan! Whatever Lupeow covets,
Lupeow owns! Haven't you heard of 'finders keepers'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_3_003.text:
Oh... So you're one of THOSE types, huh...
You know, with the whole invitation... spotlight... the drama...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_3_004.text: Hasn't anyone told you it's already gone out of fashion?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_4_001.text:
So a mere burglar dares to insult the trademark
of THE Phantom Cat Thief, yours truly, nyan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_4_002.text: Burglar? Did you just call me a mere 'burglar'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_5_001.text:
Catch me outside, nyan!
Your senior will teach you a lesson!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_5_002.text:
As if a kitty-cat could teach me anything about
the art of thieving! Bring it on, Kitty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_5_003.text:
Fine, nyan!
The book goes to the victor of this fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_6_001.text:
Argh... Why do we keep getting lost, Toto?
What is this place, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_7_001.text:
Wait. Do you hear something?
I thought I heard voices, meow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_8_001.text:
Toto! What did you eat, meow?!
I told you, you shouldn't eat things you find on the ground!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_8_003.text: You thought it had been thrown away, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_8_004.text:
Hmm... This book looks like
it had a very fancy cover, meow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_9_001.text:
What a waste, meow! We could have sold it.
Well, at least it's better than nothing. Let's go, Toto!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_8_9_003.text:
Am I the only one who thinks a valuable book lying on the ground,
with no owner in sight, extremely suspicious...? Hmm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_1_002.text: Hmm... This rock looks pretty interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_2_001.text: It looks like ordinary stone to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_2_002.text: R-really? Well, I thought it had a special glint to it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_2_003.text: Nope, this is just a plain old rock.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_2_005.text:
Hey, it's okay.
If we look harder, we'll be sure to find better things!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_2_006.text: Alright! Let's go in that direction this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_3_001.text:
Toto! Did you eat something off the ground again, meow?! 
How many times have I told you not to eat everything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_3_003.text:
What do you mean, meow?
This looks nothing like a potato!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_3_005.text: Sigh... Is there a time when you AREN'T hungry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_4_001.text: Toto! Is this the stone you were eating, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_4_003.text:
Okay, we're getting your vision checked, meow.
How could you have mistaken this red rock for a potato?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_4_005.text: Really? It wasn't red when you picked it up, meow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_4_007.text:
Interesting... I've never heard of stones like this before,
meow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_5_001.text: This is it!! This will be our jackpot to become so rich!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_5_003.text:
It's a stone that can be drawn to yield different results! 
People buy these sorts of things in hopes for a good draw!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_6_001.text: What are you doing, Toto! Pick them up, quickly! Meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_6_003.text:
You don't want to'?! Well, you're going without dinner if
you don't help me NOW, meow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_005_9_7_001.text: Well, I guess you call Popo a good merchant for a reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_1.text:
You know as well as I do, Twillie.
What 'justice' do you seek in fighting this war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_3.text:
Who shall answer to the suffering of the people,
who could only weep as your armies pillaged with no honor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_4.text:
Your lord, the Marquis of Tasitte... The "War of the Spring Garden"
was a chance to end the tyrant's wrongdoings. And yet you...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_6.text:
This war would have ended with dawn's breaking light if not for you.
Know that your foolishness brings only death and destruction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_7.text:
Once we return, I shall destroy the House of Tasitte once and for all.
The war is not over, Twillie. For spring has just begun to bloom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_29_8.text:
What do you think happened to those two?
Interesting, isn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_30_1.text:
Had I sought the wind as it crossed my path
and left the sunlight's gold gently in my hands,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_30_2.text:
Had I sought the stars as they slayed the night
and brought the dreams to a peaceful rest;

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_30_3.text:
And yet - the hour is late, 'tis too late
to seek the dawn's grace with its forgetful dew.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_30_4.text:
For over the hills the wind has gone - alas!
And left me dreaming for the bygone rills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_30_5.text:
I'm not sure what it means, but I'd like to talk to a little star.
Do you like poems, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_10_0001.text:
Oh, I'd just been researching the forgotten Kingdom myself! 
This was just the information I needed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_10_0002.text: So? What is this Temple? What is this history? How did -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_10_0003.text:
- We were getting to that. The Rosetta Stone said that only the
'Seeker of the Truth' could find the path to the 'Temple of Illusions.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_10_0004.text:
This is the reason we have come seeking you, Lorelei:
the most renowned explorer of Hasla. Will you help us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_11_0001.text:
Of course! It is just what I've been hoping for!
Let's start for the Anubisis Temple at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_11_0002.text: I must see this Rosetta Stone with my own eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_11_0003.text:
Wait. The so-called prophecy spoke of a 'Seeker of Truth.'
Not just any explorer, famous or not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_11_0005.text:
No... I understand. You're quite right. But...
On the other hand, if I DO find the 'Temple of Illusions'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_11_0006.text:
Wouldn't I be fulfilling your prophecy as the Seeker of Truth?
I'm quite serious, you know. You can trust me! I'll prove it to you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_12_0002.text: It seems you've met your match, Set!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_12_0003.text:
Why don't you give up? You know well that Miss Lorelei
has researched more about the Lost Kingdom than any other in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_12_0004.text:
In your mind, this prophecy has been fulfilled already, hasn't it?
You two never listen to what I say anyway. Do whatever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_12_0005.text:
It seems we have come to an agreement, then.
When can you start the journey?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_12_0006.text:
What do you mean, 'when'? Right now, of course!
There's no time to lose!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_13_0001.text:
W-wait, Miss Lorelei!
You do not know where you are going yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_13_0002.text:
'Seeker of the Truth,' huh?
Seems very flighty to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_13_0003.text:
Do you really think she could be the figure in the prophecy?
Aren't we wasting our trust on some mere -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_13_0004.text: I SAID, FOR THE LAST TIME, SET -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_13_0005.text: ... I trust you will both be quiet from now on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_14_0001.text:
Will these four ever find the true history of the Desert?
What do you think, {PLAYER_NAME}...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_1_0001.text:
This... This isn't enough.
It seems the lost Kingdom of the Desert seems intent on staying lost...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_2_0001.text: Are you Lorelei, the Seeker of the Truth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_3_0001.text:
Erm, I'm not sure about that grand title,
but yes, I am Lorelei. And you are...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_4_0001.text:
I am Osiris,
the remaining descendant of the lost Tribe of the Desert.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_4_0003.text:
Ugh, rude as always... Please excuse him,
he has never cared for manners. I am Isis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_5_0001.text:
The Tribe of the Desert?! Oh, wow...!
I have so many things to ask you! Where do I even start?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_6_0001.text:
There will be time to answer all your questions, 
but now there are more urgent matters at hand.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_6_0002.text:
Do you know anything of the Rosetta Stone
and the 'Temple of Illusions'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_7_0001.text:
Rosetta Stone? Temple of Illusions...?
Hmm... I'm afraid it's the first time I'm hearing about them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_7_0002.text:
You heard her, Osiris. This 'search of past' of yours is madness.
Let's head back. It's time we ended this long vacation of ours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_8_0001.text:
Stop it, Set. If you're so intent on not helping Osiris,
you can go back by yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_9_0001.text:
We are searching for the lost history of our tribe and its demise.
Our journey led to the 'Rosetta Stone' in the Anubisis Temple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_31_9_0002.text:
The Stone contained a prophecy: the forgotten history
of our tribe's destruction would be found in the 'Temple of Illusions.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_10_0002.text:
But Cronette... I beg you to think again.
I worry for you. Kaori does as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_10_0003.text:
Haha, I can't make promises, but... If you want, I'll try thinking it over.
I did notice a lot of people wanted to catch me these days...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_10_0004.text:
She's already made her choice...
She won't change her mind. I've never seen her this determined.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_10_0005.text: This isn't going to be our last meeting, right...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_10_0006.text: Don't even joke about never seeing each other!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_11_0001.text:
Thanks. I'll never forget your kindness, Hikari.
Nor Kaori's pigheadedness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_11_0002.text:
Sigh... Now who's going to get you out
when your big mouth gets you into trouble?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_11_0003.text:
Just... Promise me one thing, Cronette.
That you'll never become a bad person. A person who's not Cronette.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_11_0004.text:
Don't do anything too dangerous! 
And never get hurt! Okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_12_0001.text:
What will happen to Cronette now?
Who knows what adventures she will have...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_1_0002.text:
Congratulations, Cronette!
You really are a genius!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_1_0004.text:
I'm happy for you, but...
I'm still sad that you're leaving.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_2_0001.text:
Hikari, I told you we should be celebrating!
A warrior of Ryu must stay strong, even before parting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_2_0002.text:
Kaori's right.
It's not like we're never going to see each other again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_2_0003.text:
I'm sorry... You're right.
Today should be a day of celebration.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_2_0004.text:
Hey, there's nothing to be sorry about!
Thanks for caring about me, Hikari.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_3_0001.text:
Thank you for putting it that way, Cronette.
You truly are one of the nicest people I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_3_0002.text:
Niiiice? Did you just call Cronette NICE?
You've seen her study, Hikari. She's hardly nice when she competes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_3_0003.text: Kaori, that goes for everybody who tries their best at anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_3_0004.text:
Yeah, you of all people should know.
I've seen less scary ghosts than Kaori when she's practicing kendo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_3_0005.text:
WHAT! What do you mean, scary?
Is this why I was voted captain of the Kendo Club?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_4_0001.text:
Um, Kaori... The word we were looking for was...
'Charismatic.' Yes, that's it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_4_0002.text: Yeah. We could call it that. I guess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_4_0003.text:
Why am I hearing this for the first time?
Why has nobody told me this before? Grrr...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_5_0001.text:
Sigh... I guess my joke didn't work out as I planned.
I shouldn't have told Hikari to 'stay strong' when even I'm... just...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_5_0002.text:
It's okay. I'm sure we'll meet each other some day, wherever it may be.
I may be no prophet, but I have a certain feeling about this at least!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_5_0003.text:
I still do wish we had something left in common.
What are you planning to do after you go, Cronette?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_5_0004.text: Hmm... Since you are clever... Perhaps a teaching job?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_6_0001.text:
Ugh, no thanks. Boring jobs make me gag.
I actually have something in mind - something much more exciting!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_6_0002.text:
Exciting? Do you mean kendo? Nothing's more exciting than kendo.
But I don't think I've ever seen you exercise even once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_6_0003.text:
NO, muscle-brain. 
Hikari, sometimes I worry for your sister.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_7_0001.text:
Hey hey, calm down!
Who's going to take care of that hothead from now on, with me gone?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_7_0002.text: Get to the point and just tell us what you want to do, Cronette.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_7_0003.text:
Fine, fine. 
Hmm... Where to start...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_7_0004.text:
Truth be told, I didn't study for the sake of studying.
I just wanted to graduate. What I really like is - HACKING!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_7_0005.text:
It may come across as bragging, but I'm really good at it too.
I haven't failed at hacking a single file to this day!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_8_0002.text:
Erm... I have NOT been expecting this.
Am I talking to the same Cronette here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_9_0001.text: Haha, I guess everybody has their own secrets.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_9_0002.text:
But I'm serious about this.
Whenever I finish a job... It's the only time I feel truly alive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_9_0003.text:
But hacking is illegal, Cronette! A crime!
Why would you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_9_0004.text:
And why would you just tell this to us straight out of the blue?
What if we told somebody else? The police, for example?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_32_9_0005.text:
If you two were the type of people to snitch out a friend,
we wouldn't have been friends in the first place. Am I wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_10_001.text: Anzu... Her life up to now has been full of tragedy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_10_002.text:
I hope Kaede and the Forest of Eternal Fall
heal the wounds of her heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_1_002.text:
How did a human manage
to arrive at the 'Forest of Eternal Autumn'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_1_004.text:
So humans look like this from up close...!
Ooh! Curious, curious!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_1_005.text:
They're a little different from what I 
thought they looked like from a distance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_1_006.text:
Let's see, I'll change here a little...
And here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_2_001.text:
Okie, all done!
I'm glad I finally have a real human to refer to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_3_002.text:
W-wait a second! Is that... Blood?!
She's hurt! No wonder!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_4_001.text:
... Where am I?
The last time I was awake, I...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_4_003.text:
These bandages smell of healing herbs...
Did that person save my life...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_5_001.text:
Ahhh! Y-you surprised me!
W-when did you wake up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_5_002.text:
Who are you?
Why did you save me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_5_003.text:
Huh? What do you mean, why did I save you?
Of course you rescue hurt anim... I mean, humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_6_001.text:
My name's Kaede! I'm just an ordinary ninja
passing by, hee hee! What's your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_6_002.text:
... My mother always said 
that I mustn't talk to strangers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_6_003.text:
What! I didn't know humans had a rule like that!
B-but I told you my name! Hya, curious, curious!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_6_004.text: Wait, your ears and... tail - Cough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_7_001.text:
A-are you okay? Oh no, you're still sick!
I-I've never treated a real human before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_7_002.text:
Just wait for a teeny bit, okie? 
I'll bring back all the herbs I have! Hyaaa!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_8_001.text:
Sigh... I guess it's a little too late to tell her 
that I just had something in my throat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_8_002.text:
Anyway, I knew I wasn't mistaken. She had raccoon ears.
And her strange way of speaking...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_8_003.text:
Maybe she's an evil raccoon spirit
and is treating me so that she can eat me up later...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_8_004.text:
... Why am I so scared, anyway? I came to this forest 
so that I could die in peace and quiet, in the first place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_9_001.text: Kaede... She said her name was Kaede.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_9_002.text:
Haha... She's so clumsy,
and yet she keeps trying to help me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_9_003.text: ... I do get a warm feeling in my heart when I see her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_33_9_004.text:
Maybe... I can tell her my name
when she comes back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_1_001.text: Hmm... This should be the place...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_1_002.text:
The new Hero should have arrived by now...
Maybe he took a wrong turn on the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_1_003.text: Oh! Is that you, Mr. Valencian Knight?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_2_002.text: But why is everyone standing in line?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_2_003.text:
Huh! You don't know? This is the Hero Market!
A sort of an employment agency for us Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_2_005.text:
This is where we nameless Normal Heroes wait for a job.
We're never called for directly, and have to wait for a seat in the carriages.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_2_006.text: Oh. Haha. Of course I knew.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_3_001.text: Calling for one Archer, one Warrior!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_001.text:
Anyway! This must be the happiest day of my life.
I can't wait to devote myself to protecting the peace of Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_002.text:
I too was once like you... Motivated, eager, filled with dreams.
It's been long since I've been living from hand to mouth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_004.text:
With every passing day grows the number of aspiring Heroes.
Even if we Normal Heroes luckily receive a summon, we're soon retired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_005.text:
We'll still receive our daily pay if we manage to be called by a Captain.
That's why so many Heroes are aiming for temporary employment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_006.text:
But... But that's alright! If we keep true to our duty as Heroes,
I'm sure we can help the world become a better place!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_4_007.text:
Haha! Don't you ever forget what you just said!
You've inspired me to chase my dreams once more, newcomer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_5_002.text: Now, shall we go protect the peace of Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_5_003.text: Okay! Let's go, Mr. Valencian Knight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_6_001.text: U-ugh... I feel like I'm going to be sick...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_6_002.text:
H-hey! We waited all day for a carriage!
You could give us at least a day's worth of wages!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_7_001.text: ...Normal Heroes need love and attention as much as any other Hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_34_7_002.text:
Please keep in mind that there are many Heroes in  Hasla
who continue to work hard, even if unseen and underappreciated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_35_7_001.text:
Wow, what a speech.
I see Olga hasn't become Penqueen for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_35_7_002.text:
Rano also made a good retort,
considering that she was caught off guard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_35_7_003.text:
Huh? {PLAYER_NAME},
don't tell me you didn't understand what they said!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_10_2.text:
I, Delrien, Queen of the fairy folk, will fight you to the DEATH
for the freedom of Fairy Kingdom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_10_3.text:
... Fight? Death? Freedom?
... I don't remember taking away freedom from the fairies...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_10_4.text:
... But if my savior wants it... She'll have it.
Maybe I could grant you your 'freedom' in a document?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_11_1.text:
This fairy arrow...
I thought it belonged to one of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_11_2.text:
... I was fighting a dragon back there.
Your arrow saved my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_11_3.text: I came to express my gratitude.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_11_4.text: R-really? But that's the arrow Almael shot at m-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_11_5.text:
Hip, hip, hurrah! Hip, hip, hurrah!
You're the best, Queen Delrien!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_1.text: W-what is the meaning of this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_10.text:
Think of all the praises people will sing in your name when you return!
The same people who foolishly scorned you when you departed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_11.text:
T-that's right, I DID win freedom for the fairy folk without having to fight
the Beast King! I'm really good at this queen stuff!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_12.text: Yes! You're the best, Queen Delrien! Woohoo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_2.text:
Showing such mercy to your sworn enemy...
Hasla does not deserve such a kind-hearted, wise sovereign...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_3.text:
Your trusty knight Almael can hardly speak
with all the joy that overflows from her heart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_4.text: But... Didn't you shoot the arrow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_5.text:
Think about it, Your Highness. I am your loyal servant -
that means all the arrows I shoot belong to you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_7.text:
Of course! 
Would your trusty knight really have tried to shoot you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_8.text:
Hmm... I don't know... I could have sworn
that you were aiming right for the middle of my forehead...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_12_9.text:
A-and is that really important? What's important is the fact that you won
freedom for your kingdom without spilling a single drop of blood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_13_1.text: Sigh... At least she bought it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_13_2.text:
Good! Beast King! I was going to destroy you for the freedom of my
people, but I'll let you go this one time out of the goodness of my  heart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_13_4.text:
And you, human girl! Thanks for guiding us!
Come visit me in my kingdom and I'll reward you for your efforts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_13_6.text:
Now let's return to my kingdom, Almael!
I need to tell Daddy the good news right away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_1.text:
Ah... Today feels like a hundred years...
At least we're finally returning to the village...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_2.text:
Hee hee, I had a good time, too.
I hope you visit me in Roman someday, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_3.text:
Visit? Once I return home,
I am NEVER going out again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_4.text:
Hmm, I don't know about that... Queen Delrien did state otherwise.
She and I just made travel plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_5.text:
What! That means... Someone will have to keep
that bothersome princess from getting into trouble... AGAIN...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_14_6.text:
And that somebody... will probably be me...
What did I ever do to deserve this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_15_1.text:
... It seems she passed out from stress.
Almael did seem exhausted from taking care of Delrien...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_15_2.text: But it really is her own fault, if you think about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_15_3.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, don't try to take the easy road.
That often leads to unforeseen consequences.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_1.text:
Hey, you there! Human!
Are we there yet? Where's the Beast King?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_2.text:
We've been flying for some time now.
My royal wings are starting to hurt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_3.text: Yes, Your Highness~ We're almost there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_4.text:
Almost there, almost there... Hrrmph, I guess humans' version
of 'almost there' is different from that of fairies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_5.text:
After defeating the Beast King, I'm going to teach you humans
a thing or two! The proper fairy way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_7.text:
(W-why is that human agreeing with
every dumb thing that spoiled princess is blabbering?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_1_8.text:
(At this rate, the Beast King is going to wipe us all out.
I have to do something...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_1.text:
Your Highness... As you so wisely said just now,
we've been flying for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_10.text:
No! No 'but's! I hate 'but's! 'But's are the worst thing in the world!
I told you, I WANT TO DESTROY THE BEAST KING! TODAY!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_11.text:
If you're going to keep nagging at me,
you can go home! By yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_2.text:
Shouldn't you rest before your battle with the Beast King?
You'd want to be in your best condition, just in case.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_3.text:
What if we set up camp today,
and go looking for the Beast King tomorrow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_4.text:
Oh, my loyal servant Almael.
Thou... Um, thy? Thee? Um, you speak wisely!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_5.text:
But I cannot rest my wings when the rest of my people are suffering
this very moment, enslaved against their will by vile humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_6.text:
(... You "rested your wings" back in the capital
when you forced the human to buy you a cotton candy...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_7.text:
But... If trouble befell Your Highness,
your trusty servant Almael wouldn't be able to stand it -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_2_8.text: Don't worry, Almael! Fate will see to it that I defeat the Beast King!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_3_1.text: Hey, you two~ Friends shouldn't fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_3_2.text:
She's not my friend! Almael's my knight! Because I'm the QUEEN!
And knights listen to their queens! That's the rule!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_3_3.text: Hmm, I'm not sure if there really is such a rule...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_4_1.text: Okay... So nothing is going to persuade that brat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_4_2.text:
There's no helping it... I have to do it...
The greater good... for all of fairy folk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_4_3.text: What ARE you mumbling about? Alma-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_6_1.text:
Almael~? Why did you just shoot that arrow at me, hmm?
Did you think you could kill me and become the Fairy Queen yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_6_2.text:
Uh - um... You see... I... I just meant to... prick your wings a little...
The... greater good... the fate of the fairy folk... um...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_6_3.text:
Huh? Look!
In the sky! Is it a bird?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_7_2.text:
... Fairies? ... I see.
That would explain the size of the arrow...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_7_3.text:
Palor the Chimera...?
Then that human atop of him must be the Beast King!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_7_4.text:
Hey! Beast King!
I am Queen Delrien of the Fairy Kingdom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_8_1.text:
Queen?... Hmm. My grandfather did often talk of the fairy folk,
but he only spoke of a 'Chieftain' Oberon of the Fairy 'Village.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_8_2.text:
Yes! Yes, that's it! There is no kingdom!
Our village Chieftain is still Chief Oberon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_8_3.text:
And this here is just his daughter, not a princess!
Uh - ack! She just bit me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_36_9_1.text:
Almael... You traitor! I won't let you get away with this!
I'll see to your punishment AFTER I destroy the Beast King!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_1.text:
You cause me much trouble, Witch of the Forest.
Why would a high-ranking witch of Pumpkin City involve herself like this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_2.text: How... How do you know who I am?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_3.text:
As if the Neth Empire would have failed to identify a threat
such as one of the Four Great Witches of Pumpkin City!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_4.text:
And I even know that you are of noble blood...
The same that flows through the veins of the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_5.text:
Hmm... That is not information so easily known.
