Aha. You're not a mere soldier, are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_1_6.text: Hee hee hee... Of course I'm not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_1.text:
I am Doctor Ludovico, the Chief Research Officer of Road Industry.
These magically engineered beauties are my private soldiers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_2.text:
The public must not discover me here, so...
Please do excuse my attire tonight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_3.text:
Ludovico... I've heard that name before... The inventor
of magically engineered soldiers... Ludovico - the Slaughterer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_4.text:
I never did approve of that epithet...
I am but a curious mind seeking to contribute to the field of science.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_5.text:
And that little girl you have there is but a crucial steppingstone
to the advancement of the human world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_2_6.text:
I have nothing personal against her.
And I did pay her parents a hefty sum as compensation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_1.text:
So why don't you keep yourself from meaninglessly lashing out?
I may be a genius, but these beauties do take some time to perfect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_2.text:
If you do know about my past as you said,
you should also have known that you will never persuade me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_3.text:
This child... Arita.
I cannot hand her over to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_5.text:
If you would only give us the child and depart in peace!
We're not barbarians here - we would let you go without any more trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_6.text:
If you insist on stopping us, however - that would be a different matter.
You are alone, Loviatar. You will be easily defeated...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_3_7.text:
And that girl will fall into our hands.
Would it not be a meaningless sacrifice?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_1.text:
I spent all my mana...
On that magic I cast just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_2.text:
Even if I die,
my magic will remain and protect her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_3.text:
Now then, what will you do? Will you take me instead,
with my powers temporally diminished? You'll never catch me otherwise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_4.text:
Or will you fight me to the death
until one of us dies: a 'meaningless' endeavor, as you said?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_5.text:
I don't understand.
So you will sacrifice yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_4_6.text:
You, Loviatar. The famed Witch of the Forest...
One of the Four Great Witches?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_5_1.text:
But why? You only barely escaped from 'the experiment'
in your own childhood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_5_2.text:
Why would you return to the laboratory
for a child you hardly know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_5_3.text: I... I confess I don't know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_5_4.text:
... I always thought... things would have been different...
if someone, if anyone had fought for my sake, long ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_5_5.text:
And for this child...
I do not wish her to go through the same fear and pain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_1.text:
Hmm, how foolish...
Well, a deal is a deal. I will keep an eye on that girl, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_10.text:
You there!
Take this witch to the laboratory at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_2.text:
As for you, you will soon come to regret your decision.
For you will never see the rising sun again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_3.text:
I look forward to seeing your hypocritical mask
crack under pain and regret...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_4.text:
Haha... Hmm...
I'm not the one wearing a mask...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_6.text:
I remember now... Before I was banished from the Empire,
we met once... At a ball of the House of Nobles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_7.text:
You were kind, once...
It's a pity you changed as you are now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_8.text:
... Don't think that you'll get away
by mentioning bygones.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_6_9.text:
What is the innocence of childhood but dull naivety?
I have nothing more to say to you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_7_1.text:
I am sorry, Arita...
This is the only way I can protect you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_7_2.text:
But... If the magic of the earth has granted you immortality 
as it has for me... We will surely meet again, some day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_7_3.text:
I will wait here until that day comes.
Farewell...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_8_1.text:
The first Witch of the Forest, Loviatar...
So that's why she went missing for all those years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_37_8_2.text:
Now that she's freed from her cursed sleep,
how will she and Arita get along, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_10_2.text:
It's not so bad for those who must lead
to have some self-confidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_10_3.text: Who will become the greatest knight of Grancia, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_1.text:
This 'Glorious Knight Melee'...
It is rather sudden. I do not know what to make of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_2.text:
Even though he's my uncle and my king,
I sometimes wonder how a man can be so impulsive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_3.text:
Sigh... I only wish we could ignore his whims,
but as the funds of our Orders are at stake...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_4.text:
(A-are we really talking about the Emperor behind His Majesty's back?
I-is this okay? Do I have to say something?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_5.text:
He could have at least given us a warning.
But no - he always needs to startle us with these ridiculous ideas of his.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_6.text: He does seem rather fond of his 'surprise events.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_1_7.text:
Gwen. You've become a Captain quite recently, haven't you?
... How are you doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_2_1.text:
(Ughhhhh... I really don't want to be a part of this conversation...
How do I change the topic...?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_2_2.text: I-I think it'll be a good experience for everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_2_3.text:
It's a great opportunity to test one's skills and determine the best Order!
It's truly an honor to fight with you, Lady Victoria and Lady Joan!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_3_1.text:
I can't believe Uncle - I mean, His Majesty - 
needs to plan a whole tournament to choose the best Order...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_3_2.text: ... when it's obvious that the Central Knights are the best in the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_3_4.text:
...?
Isn't it obvious that the Central Order will be victorious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_3_7.text:
We have fought in countless rounds of War Games.
The Central Knights have the most combat experience in the Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_4_1.text: Then I must say: we are more advantageous in that right.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_4_3.text: We Steel Knights always train as if we are at war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_4_4.text:
Although we may not have partaken in as many War Games...
I doubt we will lose to anyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_5_1.text:
(E-erm...
Something feels a little off here...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_5_2.text: No training can compare to actual war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_5_3.text:
I don't know... The last time I saw them,
some of your knights seemed to be slipping in their posture.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_5_5.text:
You speak of experience, milady,
but what is experience if you do not even train properly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_5_6.text: It's still worthier than mere practice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_6_1.text:
(This... this is...
an actual fight between two of the highest Knight Captains in the Empire!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_6_2.text: (I... I can't breathe under all this pressure!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_6_3.text:
Lady Joan, I am sure you are aware of my respect for you.
That being said, I cannot tolerate your disdain for -my- Central Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_6_4.text: I will not tolerate any unmerited disdain towards my knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_6_5.text: I am not 'disdaining' anyone; I'm just stating the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_7_2.text: (... I... I should stop them, right?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_7_3.text:
(Ugh... O Goddess Elanuma,
spare me from this misery...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_7_4.text:
(Sigh... It's all or nothing.
Okay, Gwen, you can do this!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_8_4.text:
Er, w-we could just see who's the best knight
by competing fair and square. I-I'll do my best, too...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_38_9_2.text: What does everyone have against me...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_10_02.text:
W-wait...
S-stop ignoring me! I haven't finished talking...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_11_01.text:
The deep waters of the magical sea of Hasla...
Even I can't begin to imagine what goes on down there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_11_02.text:
That mermaid... She may seem a little dense,
but she holds a fearsome being within her soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_2_01.text:
Hey there, miss! Are you alright?
You don't look so fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_2_02.text: Huh? Stop bothering me and get lost, old geezer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_2_03.text:
Hmm... A rather rude young lady, not what I expected...
You see, miss, I was worried about you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_2_05.text:
That is - first of all...
Life is a precious thing, and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_3_01.text:
As if a mermaid would drown in water!
I was just complaining about the mess I got into!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_3_02.text:
Oh, great.
Now I have to deal with -this-. Everything's falling apart...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_4_01.text:
So you're not...? What a relief, haha!
It's still true that you looked terrible, as if you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_4_02.text:
If it's okay with you, let this old man hear your troubles.
Won't you tell me what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_4_03.text: You may find it surprisingly reassuring, miss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_4_04.text:
What's this, a pirate like you
cares about others' feelings?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_01.text:
Hmm. So you're a mermaid who's been guarding the sea for decades.
And you went to the Sea Witch to receive a potion...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_02.text:
... that makes you human so you could become
the Oracle of Water yourself...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_04.text:
Oh, dear. Lost her marbles, and at so young an age...
Tsk tsk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_05.text:
You... you old geezer!
I told you everything, and this is how you react?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_06.text:
Hahaha! I'm only jesting, miss. Well, a short time ago
I really would have regarded your tale as mere gibberish...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_07.text:
But I recently took aboard my ship
a lady... Very mysterious and elegant, like a spirit of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_08.text:
I thought to myself, well,
if someone like her exists in the world, why not the Oracle of Water?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_5_09.text:
Hrrmph, everyone's claiming they were selected by the Sacred Being
these days. The -real- Oracle of Water would be much more - ...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_6_02.text:
I can't believe it. Can it be the aura of the Blue Pearl?
Old geezer, the person you met could have been the real Oracle of Water!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_6_03.text: Is that so? Hoho, what a lucky coincidence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_6_04.text:
Where did you drop her off?
Lead the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_6_05.text:
Hmm? Didn't you just say that you were aiming to become the Oracle
yourself, miss? I don't know... You could be seeking to harm her and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_7_01.text:
Ack!! You've been guessing everything wrong since we've met!
It's nothing like that! Show me where she went!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_7_02.text: Fine, fine. Please stop shouting, miss.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_8_01.text:
Hee hee... Hee hee hee!
Maré, so you really did lose your fins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_8_02.text:
Do you remember me? From the deep waters of this sea...
Where even light fears to shine... I have come, your worst nightmare!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_8_03.text:
Oh, a real mermaid.
Is she your friend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_39_8_04.text:
No. I've never seen her before.
Who does she think she is, acting all so friendly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_01.text:
Oh, poor, poor pumpkins!
Who has committed such an atrocity?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_02.text:
I-is that a pumpkin talking?
What are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_03.text:
Can't you see?
I'm the Flaming Pumpkin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_04.text:
Well, I can see THAT.
I mean, who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_05.text:
That's none of your business.
Look at this mess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_06.text:
Being a teensy bit better with magic is no excuse to treat pumpkins like
this! Are you going to let them get away with this barbarity?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_07.text:
But - the ones who entrusted me with the task of looking after this
pumpkin farm were the Four Great Witches. I - I have no right to -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_2_08.text:
No, no, no! You don't get it! They're USING you for menial labor,
can't you see? You're a proper slave!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_3_01.text:
All your hard work - it's just a week's worth of stupidity to them!
Worth, what, some right to call each other names? You should be angry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_3_03.text:
Eye for an eye, no?
Make them feel the same pain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_3_04.text:
B-but I'm nothing compared to them.
I'm not powerful... I'm not even brave... All I do is grow some pumpkins...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_3_05.text:
Ugh, you really are a piece of work, aren't you?
Come closer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_4_01.text:
This powerful magic you're feeling... It was all milked from the markers
you see lying around. I'll give you all this power. What do you say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_4_02.text:
Eek... This magic...
It's evil - I should - escape -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_02.text:
What? What'd you just say?
Raise your voice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_03.text:
... Yes, revenge! Kyahahahaha!!
I'm thirsty for a bloody revenge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_04.text:
Ooh - yes, now we're talking!
Go and crush those witches just as they crushed your pumpkins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_05.text:
Kyahaha... No, I just thought of something MORE fun.
Wait, where did I put my chainsaw?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_06.text:
Yes, that's it!
I told you, didn't I? You can do anything if you put your mind to it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_5_07.text:
Aaaaand... To really get my proper serving of revenge,
I'll need a sidekick! Rise, Pumpking!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_01.text:
Yes, yes! That's a great idea!
A pumpkin's revenge is best served by a pumpkin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_02.text:
Your name is Pumpking from now on!
Now, wakey wakey! It's time to bash some witches!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_03.text:
Puu... What's re-venge?
Gimme fertilizer... Me hungry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_04.text:
... Okay, so you need a proper education first.
Pumpking, repeat after me. Re. Venge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_06.text:
Yes, that's it!
I'll teach you the rest on the way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_6_08.text:
Yes, you don't have a lot of time!
Smash them to pulp!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_7_01.text:
Crops must be treated with care.
Or they may start seeking revenge... as you saw just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_40_7_02.text:
Say, that flaming pumpkin looked oddly familiar.
Where have I seen him before, I wonder...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_01.text:
Grrr!!
Labelle... How dare she swindle me, right before my eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_02.text:
And those good-for-nothing idiots!
It's almost as if they wanted me to make a fool out of myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_03.text:
Two million Gold... That's the exact price
of the boron fishing rod set I've been dreaming of buying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_04.text:
That - thief!
''Visible only to those with a noble heart'?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_05.text:
I'll show her a 'noble heart'!
I'll show them all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_10_06.text: I'll make sure you pay for your impertinence, Labelle...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_11_01.text:
Morgan... When will he realize
that he is poisoning himself with his greed and malice, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_01.text: Is this the store of Labelle, the Imperial Seamstress?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_02.text: Yes, it is. ... Have you made a reservation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_03.text:
Don't you know who I am?
It is I, Morgan, Captain of the Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_04.text:
I need clothes to wear to an important banquet next week.
I hear you have some skill with the needle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_05.text:
I'm sorry. My books are full,
so I can't take any more orders at the moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_06.text: If you book today, next month I may be able to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_07.text:
I haven't come to make any reservations.
I need new clothes. Now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_1_08.text:
I apologize. My books are full
with reservations by other custo-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_2_02.text:
I hate saying the same thing twice. You don't want all these clothes
to be cut into rubbish, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_2_04.text:
I need to extract your mana first.
Please step closer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_2_05.text:
Hmm? Oh, were the rumors true?
You really do use mana to weave custom pieces for customers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_2_06.text:
Good. Remember what an honor it is
to work with the special mana of the Captain of the Cobalt Knights!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_3_02.text:
Heh, are my magical powers so beautiful
that you're at a loss for words?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_3_03.text:
Get to work right away.
I'll be looking forward to what you Hahahahahaha!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_4_01.text: Sigh... How can a knight be so horrible...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_4_02.text:
And this corrupt mana...
I won't be able to make anything with this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_4_03.text:
But I'm sure he'll make a scene when he returns and finds nothing.
What to do, what to do...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_5_01.text:
Who's this?
Our hoity-toity Imperial Seamstress.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_5_02.text:
...
I brought the clothes you ordered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_5_03.text:
Hrrmph, for all your fame, you work quite slow.
Tomorrow is the night of the banquet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_5_04.text:
If you hadn't come today,
I would have sent someone to retrieve my suit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_5_06.text: Then out with it already! The clothes woven from my noble mana!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_01.text: I hope you find it to your liking. I put my heart and soul into it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_02.text:
What are you doing....?
Waving your hands in the air like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_03.text: Oh, there's one thing I almost forgot to tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_04.text:
Since your mana is so elegant and ... special...
I succeeded in making a one-a-kind suit, the only one of its kind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_05.text: I present: a suit that is visible to only those with a noble heart.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_6_07.text:
What do you think of it?
Do you like it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_7_02.text:
Oh, what's the problem?
Can it be that... you don't see it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_7_03.text:
But that's impossible!
Who's more noble than Sir Morgan, Captain of the Cobalt Knights?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_01.text:
Ah... Hahaha! It's simply divine!
I've never laid my eyes on something so beautiful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_02.text:
Y-yes. 
It's such a lovely color - it brings out your eyes, Sir Morgan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_03.text:
Ah, as expected of Sir Morgan's closest advisers!
You do know something about fashion! And what about you, Sir Morgan?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_05.text:
I... see...
Now that I look at it properly, it's not too bad...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_06.text: Huhu, I just knew you would like it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_07.text:
I especially put much effort into this piece.
Please take good care of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_08.text:
Now... We must settle the bill.
The price is two million Gold.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_10.text: Oh, surely you don't think it's too expensive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_11.text:
For a high-quality suit like this,
it's not too high a price.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_8_12.text:
Grr... I never thought anything of the sort...
Take the money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_41_9_01.text:
Thank you for your purchase.
I'll see myself off, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_01.text:
Ugh, watch where you're going!
... Wait, an elf?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_03.text:
Well, I admit you surprised me a bit,
but a slight bump like that won't do any harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_04.text:
Wait... You're the Devil Overlord, aren't you?
The Absolute Devil, Vivian! I've been searching for you everywhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_05.text: Hmm? You were looking for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_06.text:
Oh, look at my manners.
Let me formally introduce myself: I'm Linné, botanist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_07.text:
At the moment, I'm chasing after rumors of a gigantic plant
that reportedly sprung up in Hell Island.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_08.text:
I tried to interview the villagers of the Island, but... everyone said 
that I should find you, since you were the one who chopped it down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_09.text: Oh~ That? Well, I did defeat it in battle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_10.text:
Oh, wow -
just as one would expect of the Absolute Devil!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_11.text:
Hey, you don't have to stuff me with compliments.
So, what do you want to know about that monster of a plant?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_12.text:
Anything and everything!
Even the smallest tidbit of information will be helpful...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_3_15.text:
Well, villain may be too strong a word.
We should still seek to press charges, though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_4_01.text:
Hold on, back up for a minute. Villain, press charges...
What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_4_02.text:
According to my research, the plant belongs to the Royal Bean species,
one that probably mutated from exposure to special mana.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_4_03.text:
And when I say 'special mana,' I mean extremely special mana,
from an extremely powerful demon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_4_04.text:
After hearing this, the representative of the Island urged me to help
them catch the said demon, so that they can sue for damages!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_03.text:
Erm, I didn't say anything!
Aaaanyway, did the Island villagers really say that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_04.text:
Yes, they certainly did!
Now... about that giant plant, you must tell me everything you know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_05.text:
G-giant plant?
I... I don't know anything about a giant plant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_06.text:
... Huh? But you just said that you defeated it in battle
only a few moments ago...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_07.text: I-I never said that. When did I say anything like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_08.text:
However... Hearing of this matter,
I... I must take action as the Absolute Devil of Hell Island!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_09.text:
Okay, I'll personally see to it that the demon is caught!
You should go research more... important stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_10.text:
More important stuff?
To a botanist, plants are the 'most important stuff.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_5_11.text:
No, no... If you think about it carefully,
I'm sure something will come to mind. Such as...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_6_02.text: Proving... whether a four-leaf clover really brings good luck...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_6_03.text:
Oh, Your Devilship.
You really do have a sense of humor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_6_04.text:
Orrrr... Maybe it wasn't a plant at all!
If it were, how would it move on its own and attack people like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_6_05.text: I'm sure it was an enormous animal. A new species of elephant, maybe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_6_06.text:
And that's why you, a botanist,
really shouldn't care about such petty things! Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_7_01.text:
Wait, it showed signs of voluntary movement? And it attacked people?
You really did witness it with your own eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_7_03.text: I-I know nothing about this mess! Nothing at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_8_01.text:
Wait! Your Devilship? Your Devilship!
Don't - run away - from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_42_9_01.text:
Vivian... She's always so busy cleaning up after Jack and Gordian.
When will she get the break she wants, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_10_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, quick...
Press the 'Skip' button when you have the chance...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_1_01.text: Hoho, it's been years, and this place remains the same as ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_2_01.text:
Stop there.
State your name, rank, and intention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_2_03.text:
Didn't you learn it's proper manners
to reveal your own status before demanding another's?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_2_04.text:
A fellow like you who works at His Majesty's palace
must know that courtesy comes from respect for the other person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_2_06.text:
And think about it, for me to have come through all the way here,
all the other gatekeepers would have known who I am, and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_3_01.text:
...You talk too much. Fine. Listen well:
I am Mengqi, one of His Majesty's Five Tiger Generals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_3_02.text:
I was not informed
that anyone would be seeking audience with His Majesty today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_3_03.text:
For what purpose do you seek His Majesty the Emperor?
A trivial affair and you will lose your life here and now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_4_01.text:
Oho, you're the lad everyone's been telling me about on the way here!
Mengqi, wasn't it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_4_02.text:
So young, and already a general!
I only hope your heart is as pure as your talent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_4_03.text:
Now then, in order to explain why I came all the way here,
I s'pose I should first explain the reason I gave up my place

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_4_04.text:
as a Five Tiger General, and in order to explain that,
I s'pose I should tell you about that day forty years ago, when -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_4_05.text: Stop... Stop! Simply state your business, not the story of your life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_01.text:
Ah, it's you, Master Hansheng!
And I've been meaning to pay a visit after my job was done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_02.text:
Oh, your hair has grown so white, Master Hansheng!
You should have been honorably discharged with medals by now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_03.text:
Your blind eyes see everything and I can see from your arms that you're
strong as ever, but His Majesty could appreciate you some more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_04.text:
Hoho, you never change, do you, Shuwen?
Now, as I have some urgent matter that I must -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_05.text:
Ah, Master Hansheng! Why the haste? We must savor meetings like this!
Are you not curious of the many adventures I had since I left?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_06.text:
You already know that I quit the Five Tiger Generals
and went into the mountains to continue my training...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_07.text:
So I should start with the day that I had my revelation.
That morning I had the strangest of feelings, stranger than anything

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_08.text:
I've ever felt in my life because of a dream I had the previous night,
which I'll describe after I tell you how I trained in the mountains, and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_09.text:
Wait, wait! Did you not come here for urgent business?
Why do we not talk later with leisure, over tea perhaps?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_10.text:
Ah, look at me! Always getting ahead of myself! I was so glad to see you
again that I almost forgot my audience with His Majesty!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_11.text:
I was just about to explain to Mengqi here
my rank and reason for coming to the palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_12.text:
Mengqi,
Master Hansheng here will vouch for my story.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_5_13.text:
As for how we know each other, Master Hansheng and me,
you see, we've been the best of friends ever since -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_6_02.text:
Mengqi, I can verify that this is Shuwen,
a former Tiger General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_6_03.text:
... You will see that it is best to let him pass without further questions.
As for myself... I have, ahem, other matters to tend to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_02.text:
Even if you served as a Tiger General in the past,
I cannot let you pass without His Majesty's permission!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_03.text: Come back when you have a scheduled audience with His Majesty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_04.text: Oho, you're more serious about your job than I deemed you to be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_05.text:
But let me introduce myself again: I was specially chosen by His Majesty
as a Five Tiger General, and afterwards we became great friends,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_06.text:
regardless of the difference in our ranks, for you realize that His Majesty
is a better man the better you get to know him, and we had many a tea;

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_07.text:
I could even say that he's my brother in spirit if it isn't too rude of me,
I'm sure that he'll welcome an old friend without all this procedure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_08.text:
So don't you worry and go tell His Majesty
that Shuwen has come to see him. There won't be any trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_09.text:
If this doesn't reassure you, let me give you a piece of advice.
In the past I faced a similar situation as you right now, but before that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_10.text:
I 'spose I have to tell you first about that time when His Majesty's
in-laws' cousin came to the palace and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_7_11.text:
Grr... Arrghh!
Okay, okay already! Just - just get out of here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_8_01.text:
Do you believe me now? Ah, that's good, that's good.
Just a few words and your colleagues understand you so well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_8_03.text:
Why don't you come as well when I pay a visit to Master Hansheng,
so that we can share tales of the hardships of a Tiger General?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_8_04.text:
As you well know, one's rank and surroundings can change a person
either for better or worse. Life is funny like that, you see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_8_05.text:
I may not seem it, but back in the days I had my fair share of
adventures as a General, and I could show you some -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_8_06.text: Please... Stop... You can stop now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_9_01.text:
Hmm? Are you falling asleep, lad?
Tsk, tsk, a young man like you shouldn't be lacking stamina!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_9_02.text:
If you ever feel down or need a quick pick-me-up, go seek Doctor Xu;
he's a skilled physician who lives in the town to the south.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_43_9_03.text:
We hail from the same village, childhood friends, can you believe it?
Now, let me tell you about that time when Doctor Xu first began his studies, I was there with him -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_1_01.text: Lord Magnus, have you been visiting the Silver Archers again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_01.text: H-how did you know that? Have you been spying on me, Vice-Captain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_02.text: What about your work? You're behind schedule, you know that, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_03.text:
I don't worry about such petty things as schedules
when I have a Vice-Captain like you, Aurea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_04.text: Are you dumping your work on me again, sir?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_05.text:
Such unrefined language. I'm merely making use of the aid
that is inherently offered to me by your position as my Vice-Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_2_06.text:
No! I can't do everything for you all the time, sir!
Don't you see that pile of documents you must sign within the week?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_3_02.text:
Oh, my fair S - ... I mean, Captain Sigruna.
What brings you so far from the headquarters of the Silver Archers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_3_03.text:
You left your bow at our training grounds.
I came by to deliver it to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_3_04.text:
Lord Magnus! Your bow is your most important possession
as the Captain of Golden Archers! Please come to your senses, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_4_01.text:
Oh... Such a long journey, all for my sake!
Thank you, my Sigr... Captain of the Silver Archers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_4_02.text:
Ahem, as I am indebted to you,
I must insist on treating you to dinner tonight.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_4_03.text:
No, no, no! You have too much to do, sir,
and certainly not enough time for a leisurely dinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_4_04.text:
You have a free slot in your schedule tomorr-... The day after tomorro-...
Well, someday, any day but today, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_01.text:
Oh, I see I came at an inconvenient time.
I'll see myself off, then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_02.text:
W-Wait! Sigruna, then would you care for some -
some bark chips before you leave...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_03.text: Oh, I never knew someone like you would care for bark chips?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_04.text:
... He doesn't. When I offered you some the other day,
did you not tell me to "get rid of that garbage," sir?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_05.text:
W-what are you saying, Vice-Captain?
I cannot live a day without those delicacies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_06.text:
Ah, I have a sudden craving for bark dipped in honey.
Sigruna! Come join me, I will go order some at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_5_07.text: Vice-Captain, authorize these documents in my stead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_6_01.text:
Lord Magnus! Don't you dare!
You are disobeying your own rules, sir!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_7_01.text:
The girl who used to sell me bark chips… She’s become a fine adult.
I won’t have to worry any more about her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_44_8_01.text:
Sigruna must be so proud.
When will Aurea realize that she's her long benefactor, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_10_02.text: So you wish to fight? I like your courage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_11_01.text:
I've forgotten how inconvenient it is to not speak the regional language...
Reminds me of the time I first arrived in Wulin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_12_01.text: Who are you, and why are you doing this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_12_02.text:
Hmm? Oh... A Japanese priestess!
'Ohayo'! Did I get that right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_12_03.text: How dare you invade the kingdom of Ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_12_04.text: Your behavior is unacceptable. Surrender right this moment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_13_01.text:
... Okay, that was all the Japanese I know.
Maybe I should have studied foreign languages before martial arts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_15_02.text:
What, do you know who I am?
No... This is another world; she can't possibly know me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_15_03.text:
Huhu... Well, I guess my good looks caught her attention.
It's not like it hasn't happened before. It's not impossible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_15_04.text:
Ooorr... One of my special passive abilities could have started working.
Like the 'Face of Devilish Charm'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_15_05.text:
This is a difficult problem.
On one hand, I dedicated myself to Himiko-chan. But on the other...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_16_02.text:
If you get any closer, I'll have to unleash my power
and I don't want to hur--

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_16_03.text:
You. You can understand me.
How are you talking in Korean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_16_04.text:
What? I'm speaking in Japanese... Could it be -
one of my powers of reincarnation: [Auto Translation]?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_17_01.text:
I understand what you're saying, but... I don't...
understand what you're saying... Anyway, I have a question for you, boy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_17_02.text:
Have you, by any chance, seen a... a human-like being around here?
A female being with the appearance of a Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_17_03.text: It... No, she has blue eyes and pink pigtails.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_18_01.text: Can you understand her at all, Susanoo?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_18_03.text:
Then how is Haruki conversating with her?
He too is speaking in Haslaean like the rest of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_19_01.text: (So that's how it is! I'm the only one who can speak with the enemy!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_19_02.text: (This is my chance to win Himiko-chan's heart!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_19_03.text: Ahem, ahem. I see... So that's the reason you invaded Ryu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_19_04.text: But invading another country's palace like this is not only rude, it's -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_1_02.text:
It isn't good, sir.
The enemy is pushing their way in.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_1_03.text:
Even when considering that we had withdrawn most of our troops,
I had not expected our line of defense to break so easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_1_04.text: What resentment could such a person have against us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_20_01.text: Eek. U-um, no. I haven't seen anyone like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_20_02.text: There's only me and Himiko-chan and the other guy here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_21_01.text: How strange... And yet I can still feel its presence - quite strongly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_21_02.text:
Well, I will take your word for it.
If you ever see her, tell me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_21_03.text: ... And tell them that I am sorry for causing trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_21_04.text: Should our paths cross again, I shall remember you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_22_01.text: Wait, we can't let her go like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_22_02.text: ... No, it's best that we let her go, Himiko-chan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_22_03.text:
That person... is a 'wild card' like me.
Meaning that she could do anything if we make her stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_22_04.text: Was that person someone you know, by any chance?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_22_05.text:
She was speaking in an unknown tongue.
How did you understand her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_23_02.text: If I put my mind to it... Nothing's impossible for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_23_03.text:
Since I persuaded her to leave peacefully,
I guess you could say I was the one who prevented another war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_24_01.text: Did I not tell you to address the Priestess with respect?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_24_02.text:
Sigh... Why are you so uptight about everything?
Are you so scared of your feelings that you can't even call her prop-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_26_01.text: ... I see much trouble ahead for those four.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_26_02.text:
Anyway... A 'being with the appearance of a Goddess'...
What can she have possibly meant by that, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_2_01.text: Send the palace guards to the outermost walls.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_2_02.text:
Susanoo, Haruki. This is no ordinary skirmish.
We must prepare for the worst.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_3_01.text: Do not address the Priestess with such frivolity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_3_02.text: I warned you before. Do not make me repeat myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_3_03.text: Hey, I'm only staying here for Himiko-chan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_3_04.text:
If it were Himiko-chan asking me, I'd have followed gladly.
But I don't have to do anything for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_4_02.text:
You forget that you were a prisoner captured in my territory,
and that I only took you in as my vassal out of pity!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_4_03.text:
Speak like that one more time,
and I will see to it that you will learn the consequences of your words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_5_01.text: (Eek, I didn't mean to really make him mad!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_5_03.text:
Do you know what will happen if I release the full power of my
'Demonic Eye'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_5_04.text:
T-the darkest abyss will swallow you,
and you'll be the one who will taste endless grief of death and despair!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_6_01.text: Please calm down, both of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_6_02.text:
However... I agree with Susanoo.
You cannot continue acting like this, Haruki.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_6_04.text: You should treat him with the respect that he deserves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_8_02.text: The rogue enemy fighter is at the door...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_45_9_02.text: This is strange... I know I defeated it, and yet...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_10_01.text: N-no, never mind. This is for the better...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_10_02.text: Sell me some of those tteok. I won't mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_10_03.text:
You don't understand.
They're as hard as rock - I cooked them that way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_10_04.text:
If you like your teeth, then I advise you not to take any chances
and leave while you still have your fangs intact!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_11_02.text:
Stop looking so glum!
Here you go - don't tell me later that I didn't warn you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_13_02.text:
What did I tell you?
Being stubborn will only get you broken teeth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_13_03.text: Have a taste of these instead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_14_01.text: I whipped them up as an afternoon snack.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_14_02.text:
They're not meant for sale,
but they'll do to stave off the first pangs of hunger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_15_01.text: A-are you sure you can give me something so precious?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_15_02.text: Precious? I'm only giving you food that's actually edible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_15_03.text:
They aren't very good by anyone's standards,
but they'll at least taste better than nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_17_01.text:
How many times do I have to tell you -
these tteok aren't meant to be edible! Go find another shop to bother!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_18_02.text: That tiger... He's grown thinner since the last time I saw him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_18_03.text: No tiger should go starving under my rule...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_18_04.text: Now, let's see. What kind of ingredients would taste good to a tiger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_19_01.text: Was she being considerate when she pretended not to know him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_19_02.text:
Sometimes people may be closer friends than they seem.
Much closer, in fact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_19_03.text: Do you have a friend like that, {PLAYER_NAME}?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_2_01.text: Hey! I've been standing in line at this very spot since yesterday!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_2_02.text: Who do you think you are, cutting in line like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_3_01.text:
You're lying! I've been camping here for two days
and I know for a fact that you just arrived here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_3_02.text:
I've closed my store to get my hands on this tteok.
I'm not going to give up my chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_3_03.text:
You think I have time to waste?
Stand in line like the rest of us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_5_02.text: Making all this fuss from the brink of dawn!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_5_04.text:
Act like an uncivilized mob one more time
and I'll kick you off my property!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_7_01.text:
Yes! I can't believe I finally got my hands
on the famous tteok bullets!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_9_01.text:
Young master, this isn't a real tteok shop.
Well, they aren't meant to be edible, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_46_9_02.text: You seem like you stood in line for a long time... Tough luck, kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_10_01.text:
... If that book is so wonderful as you claim it to be,
why are you browsing these dusty shelves?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_10_02.text: You must have already obtained the knowledge you need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_11_02.text:
As it's not every day you meet someone with good taste,
I'll tell you my story.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_12_02.text:
I mean, even my most powerful potions won't help you
if you insist on ruining things for yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_12_03.text:
He was having an affair. His relationship was going to end
regardless of whether or not he bought my love potions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_13_01.text: Anyway, ever since I was wrongfully branded a fraud...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_13_02.text:
I couldn't settle down anywhere, so I set out on a
journey to find the author of this book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_13_03.text:
I thought if I searched libraries, I could find another
book written in a similar style...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_13_04.text:
... or dealing a relevant subject, and so get more
information on this mysterious alchemist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_13_05.text: But I haven't been so lucky yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_14_01.text:
… From what I've heard, your reasons for roaming don't
explain your search for the author of the book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_14_02.text: What will you do once you find them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_14_03.text:
Do you truly need to go through so much suffering
for the sake of someone you may or may not meet?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_01.text:
Oh. Well... I haven't thought about it like that.
Not in such detail, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_02.text: ... I have no family, no relatives that I know of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_03.text:
All my life I've depended on this book
to make a living and find my place in the world.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_04.text:
That's why the author hardly feels like a stranger. They
almost feel like... family to me. My closest friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_05.text:
I've never met whoever wrote this book,
but they're the only teacher I've ever had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_15_06.text:
I guess I just wanted to thank them for everything
that they taught me. Show them how I grew up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_16_01.text:
Is that so? ... Then perhaps I can spare some time
to look over your notes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_16_02.text:
What?
Wait, those are trade secrets - !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_17_01.text:
A recipe that temporarily maximizes the vitality of the
user through a combination of different potions...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_17_02.text: A creative, if unorthodox approach. However, this ingredient...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_17_03.text:
Wild cactus roots of the Southwest Desert must be cleansed
before usage. Remove their root caps as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_17_04.text:
Depending on one's expertise, the potion can be excessive
and be poisonous to the taker, or not be effective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_17_05.text:
You seem to comprehend most of the recipes quite well...
But I can see some mistakes here and there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_18_01.text:
Wait. You're an alchemist, too? I've been wondering about
all those rare ingredients hanging from your back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_18_02.text:
... An alchemist I may be, but my knowledge is not great.
I have some tricks up my sleeve that are useful to others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_18_03.text:
But I've never met another alchemist before! Do you know
other alchemists? Is there a club I can join?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_18_04.text: Wait, does this mean that you know the author of this book -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_19_01.text:
G-guards?!
I didn't expect for them to discover me so soon!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_19_02.text:
Ugh, I have SO many questions I want to ask you, but...
Your name was Faust, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_19_03.text:
Your name sounds familiar, for some reason.
Anyway! I was never here, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_19_04.text: Bye~! Hope I can see you again someday!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_1_01.text:
Couldn't you conduct one last search of the area? I've
followed her trail for a long time, and it ends here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_20_01.text: Hmm? I thought I heard you conversating with another person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_20_02.text:
... You heard wrong.
What brings you back so soon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_20_03.text:
Oh, yes.
I've some good news for you, Master Faust!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_20_04.text:
The fruit vendor saw a woman fitting the description walking
toward the sea beyond the country borders this morning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_20_06.text:
Apparently, she was muttering the word 'darkness' many times.
You should go now if you want to catch up with her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_21_02.text:
A grand title for a fool
who can't even protect his own family.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_22_01.text:
I will never let you go this time.
... Please wait for me, Sien.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_23_01.text:
Those who travel far and wander long often miss
the very thing they seek right before their eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_23_02.text: I hope they both find what they are looking for, someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_2_01.text:
If anyone in such an unusual attire was wandering around,
we would have already received a report.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_2_02.text:
I'm sorry. There is only so much we can do. We can't
dedicate our entire schedule to ground searches.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_2_03.text:
We'll search the area once more,
but you have to understand that this is the last time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_3_01.text: Sien... Where have you gone this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_3_02.text:
... I cannot rest in this state.
I must distract myself for the time being...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_4_01.text:
... Let's see, now.
What new books are there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_4_02.text:
Ugh. This book's style is too different...
And that book is too shallow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_4_03.text:
Can it be...?!
... '100 Magical Recipes for the Perfect Date'?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_4_04.text:
... Wait, this is a cookbook!
Wow, the title sure is misleading.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_5_02.text:
I've been to over thirty libraries.
How can there not be a single book similar to mine?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_6_01.text: Alright, the next relevant subject to browse through...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_6_02.text:
Spells and herbs of the Eastern Kingdoms.
Okay. I hope this doesn't take too long...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_8_01.text:
You surprised me!
I don't remember hearing any footsteps.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_8_03.text:
That book doesn't belong to the library.
Where did you get it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_8_04.text:
Oh, this?
Hee hee, you have a good eye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_9_01.text:
Well, without my book, I would have no life! I've been
through thick and thin with this trusty volume!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_9_02.text:
It's full of secret spells by this genius, complemented
by my footnotes that I added after my own experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_9_03.text: It's a treasure trove of knowledge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_47_9_04.text:
The quantity and quality of the information contained
in this book is second to no other.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_10_01.text:
We shook them off. Let's hurry.
The reinforcements will come soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_11_01.text:
We shook them off.
Now we just need to wait for her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_12_01.text:
... I was confused, so I ended up here.
Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_12_02.text:
A pagan and a demon…
You dared to enter a cathedral?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_13_01.text:
What is he talking about?
Is this the time to be saying that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_13_02.text:
Isn't it obvious?
You knocked down my brothers and sisters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_13_03.text:
You think I will just follow some servants of the 
darkness because I want to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_13_04.text:
Those… brothers and sisters were trying  
to kill you, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_13_05.text: And you still call them brothers and sisters?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_01.text:
Fredrick, was it?
Didn't you also hear and see what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_02.text:
The things that the Order of the Goddess does under
that name… and the pain that those things cause.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_03.text: You are also a victim who has been used by them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_04.text:
You were thrown out of the Order and 
still follow the teachings…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_05.text:
Even if you keep that faith, what awaits you is... 
Useless death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_06.text:
... Hmph. Still. You want me to beg for my life
to some evil pagans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_07.text: I'm not sure what you are up to, but I refuse to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_08.text:
If they hid the truth from me, 
and have used me, all in the name of the goddess…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_14_09.text: As the container of light, I must accept it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_15_01.text:
Ugh, unbelievable!
Do they really have to brainwash kids like him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_15_02.text: Those Goddess scumbags, they are as terrible as ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_15_04.text: That's what I want to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_01.text:
Even if you are a demon... I can't believe I
met a little girl that has become so corrupted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_02.text:
If you have been tricked by the evil pagans, 
it's not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_03.text: Instead of using such a terrible power…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_04.text:
It would be better if you play with some cute dolls 
in a warm house.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_01.text:
What...
I thought you were stuck up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_02.text:
You are actually pretty okay.
Don't you agree, Melissa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_03.text: Demona… This really isn't the time for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_01.text: Hmph, thanks for thinking of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_02.text:
We didn't come here because 
we wanted to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_03.text: Someone begged to help you, so that's why I came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_19_02.text:
That's... Not something we can tell you.
They should be joining us soon…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_01.text: Why are you doing this, Brother?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_03.text:
Fredrick, my brother.
I have always been fond of you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_04.text: But it is now time to end this tragedy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_05.text:
You have done your duty, 
as a servant of the goddesses, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_06.text: I've been hiding something from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_01.text:
There you are, Francesca. 
And the escape route?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_02.text:
… No issues. 
I took care of anything that might get in the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_03.text:
Glad to hear that.
Let's hurry, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_04.text:
Yea, you might have taken care of the ones on the way, 
but there might be more of them coming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_05.text:
…They just keep on coming.
Now what. A corrupted apostle from your side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_21_02.text:
Don't come close.
The energy of darkness is pulsing everywhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_22_03.text:
…We came here to save you.
You are not alone now, so we can do it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_01.text:
…I don't understand what you are talking about.
How can I just trust you and follow you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_02.text:
And...
Regardless of that demon and pagan over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_03.text: You really are absolute darkness itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_04.text: And who are you saying you want to save?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_01.text:
…Why do you want to stay here?
You saw how they treated you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_02.text:
I must choose between those who have been by my side 
all my life, and some corrupted strangers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_03.text: Is that so hard to choose from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_05.text:
You know about the things they have done… They are
too evil and unethical to be for the goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_06.text:
…If that's what the goddess wants, then
what is the Road of Light that they believe in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_08.text: ... How much, do you not remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_09.text:
Don't you remember how many children
died in those experiments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_10.text:
…What? How do you know,
…Ugh! My head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_25_01.text:
…A-are you okay?
I'm sorry. I reminded you of a painful memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_25_02.text:
Ugh... What... 
…What was that just now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_01.text:
... But, it's the truth. 
They used you, and now that they don't need you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_02.text:
They are trying to get rid of you, 
like the other subjects of their experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_03.text: I… cannot let that happen. I can't just stand and watch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_04.text: I will not let that happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_06.text:
I'm sure it must be hard to go against the faith
that was imposed on you, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_08.text:
…I know it sounds ridiculous. 
But let me help you. Fredrick.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_27_01.text:
Over there!!
There! The traitor and the pagans!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_28_01.text:
Hey, it's nice and all, seeing siblings meeting again. 
But I don't think this is the time for that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_28_02.text:
Demona is right. 
We really don't have time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_29_03.text:
Even if you don't remember, and your body can't
be reached… As family, I'll protect you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_2_01.text:
Because of your existence, 
part of this world is being tainted by evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_2_02.text:
Fredrick, do you know why you are able
to wholly exist as the container of light…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_30_03.text:
It's hard for you if I'm near you. 
…You feel the energy of darkness pulsing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_31_01.text: It's okay. I'll keep my distance behind you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_31_02.text:
Okay.
…You told me to trust you, so you better come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_32_02.text: We'll make you pay for making us suffer all this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_3_02.text:
Wrong. In order for you
to be born as the container of absolute light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_3_03.text:
There was a little girl who 
received the darkness you had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_03.text:
The stigmata on your forehead, 
was used to transfer your darkness to her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_04.text:
As you reborn as the container for absolute light, your 
sister became the container for absolute darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_05.text:
One that corrupts everything... 
A servant of the wicked darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_06.text: A twin? I know nothing about this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_07.text:
If I had family, 
How could I not remember all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_01.text:
What is strange about that? Your memory
is not complete. Of course you don't remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_02.text:
What… are you saying...
My memory is not complete?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_03.text:
How could someone who hasn't purified his own memory 
be called the container of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_05.text:
As long as you exist, evil will engulf this world...
And will corrupt innocent people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_06.text:
…Now, Fredrick. It is now time
for you to step up to the altar of offerings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_07.text:
For this world... 
For the goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_08.text:
Just as we sacrificed everything
so far for you,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_09.text: now is your turn to step up to the altar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_6_02.text:
Your life will remain
a part of the path for the great goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_6_03.text: Then, may you rest in eternal peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_01.text:
The Black Order…?!
How did you enter…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_02.text: What do you mean by "how"? Through the door, of course!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_03.text: We are not late. What a relief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_04.text:
W-who are you guys...
And that appearance... Demons?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_05.text:
You must be confused, but we don't have time. 
We have to get you out of here now…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_8_01.text: How dare you evil pagans step inside a cathedral!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_8_02.text:
They never change, do they?
Words don't get through them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_02.text:
The festival is well underway, and the place is crowded
with people who share an interest and love of plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_03.text:
I thought it would be fun to participate. As you can
see, I'm running a plant consultation booth here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_04.text:
A lot of the locals have been visiting to consult their
plant-related problems. I've been quite popular...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_05.text:
... to the point that I'm finding it difficult to keep up with
them. I'm not sure why you came to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_06.text:
But if you help me today, I'll see what I can do to
alleviate your troubles, whatever they may be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_01.text:
W-what do you mean?
I never said anything about needing your help...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_02.text: Oh, I see I was mistaken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_03.text:
... Okay, okay. I'll do as you say...
But you have to keep your promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_04.text:
Okay, great!
Then let's do this! Next!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_12_01.text:
Hello, Professor! I found this flower at the
Girl Scout camping grounds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_12_02.text:
Isn't it pretty? I'm going to plant it in a pot. What
should I prepare if I want to grow this kind of flower?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_01.text: Hmm... Do you have a cat or a dog in your family?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_02.text: Oh, how did you know? I have a two-year-old kitten!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_03.text: Yes, I thought I saw cat hair on your uniform!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_04.text: I recommend that you don't grow this flower if you have a cat…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_05.text:
This narcissus is a bulb plant.
It can be poisonous to cats!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_06.text:
Oh, I didn't know that!
Whew, I'm glad I asked you first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_07.text:
If you want a new plant companion, I recommend
the 'braid tree' or the 'starflower grass.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_08.text:
Even if your cat decides to nibble on them,
it'll be perfectly safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_10.text: Good luck with your new plant! Next~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_01.text:
Hello, Ms. Botanist. I recently succeeded in developing
a new variety of flower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_02.text:
I've prepared to sell this new species at the festival:
I've given it water, the best fertilizer on the market...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_03.text:
But it only continues to wilt, regardless of how much
care I give it. Could you see what the problem is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_01.text:
You've given your plants too much fertilizer! The excess
of nutrients is what's slowly killing your plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_03.text: Now, as for this new variety of yours...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_04.text:
You should have only watered it slightly… The roots
may have rotted due to the excessive hydration.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_17_01.text:
Oh, no... W-what should I do?
This year's profits depend on this one flower!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_17_02.text:
Don't worry!
We have an expert who'll help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_01.text:
N-no! I don't want to. He killed off his flower with his
greed. Why should I help him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_02.text:
Oh, don't be so harsh.
You promised to help, didn't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_03.text:
I know you can save them...
Both the flower, and this gardener's yearly profits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_19_02.text:
If I fail to save my flower before the festival ends...
My yearly income will suffer greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_19_03.text:
He desperately needs your help.
Why don't we give him a hand, just this one time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_1_02.text:
She said she was going to study a gigantic plant rumored
to have been recently discovered somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_1_03.text:
I haven't seen her since. Has it been, what, a week?
Maybe two weeks since I last saw her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_20_01.text:
... Ugh.
Fine, fine. Give me that pot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_01.text:
Oh... Ooh...! My flower! It's revived!
And it's more beautiful than ever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_02.text:
Thank you, Professors!
I won't ever forget your kindness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_03.text:
I... I don't care. Just don't kill off your plants again.
They don't deserve that kind of treatment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_22_01.text: ... Isn't that why you're here, Éfendére?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_23_02.text:
I'm talking about your forest, of course. Aren't you
here because you're in doubt of your own powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_24_02.text:
If an Elf like you - proud, conservative, and all-too-willing
to stay home - came all the way to meet me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_01.text:
And seeing that you came to find me in time of need,
your opinion of me must be higher than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_02.text: I'm a little happy for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_04.text:
You were right all along.
My forest is dying, and it's all my fault.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_05.text: I only wanted to keep my forest beautiful...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_06.text:
Now I'm being punished for being greedy.
It's all my fault.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_07.text:
... I'm no different from that stupid gardener...
No, I'm actually worse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_26_01.text:
Stop blaming yourself, Éfendére. Self-pity does
nothing to help revitalize your forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_01.text:
Does that mean... that you're going to help me?
But my forest... Nothing grows there anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_03.text:
Don't worry!
An academic's strongest suit is their tenacity!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_04.text:
This is my first research attempting to save an entire
forest. It will be a great opportunity for me as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_05.text: Hehe. This is so exciting! I can't wait to see how things turn out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_28_01.text:
... Thank you.
I'm sorry for how I treated you back then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_28_03.text:
Shall we go now?
To save your forest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_29_01.text:
Gardening may seem simple,
but it requires delicate skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_29_02.text:
As for me,
even a cactus provides a challenge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_01.text:
A gigantic plant?
I heard that some Hero took care of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_02.text:
There was another Elf who came this way last week.
She seemed very interested in plants, just like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_05.text:
Well... I do recall
that she mentioned heading towards Hero Town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_01.text:
Pant... Pant...
I missed her... Again?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_02.text:
Linné...
How can you travel so quickly? And why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_03.text:
... I'm too tired to search any longer.
I'll rest in this village for tonight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_04.text:
Come visit our Spring Festival~! Fresh fruit, home-grown
vegetables, snacks and attractions galore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_05.text:
Greet the flowering new season at the annual Spring Festival,
where everyone is welcome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_01.text:
Spring Festival...? Maybe I can spare some time take
a look around...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_02.text:
But then again, what do humans know about
handling the true power of the earth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_03.text:
All they're interested in
is making money off plants...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_01.text:
... And I watered it according to the manual,
but it continues to wilt. I don't know what to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_02.text: Should I give them more fertilizer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_03.text:
Oh, this plant should bloom very soon!
It needs much more water than usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_04.text:
Soak them in water once or twice every day,
and it will freshen up in no time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_7_01.text:
I-I found you at last!
Linné!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_7_02.text:
Please stand in line!
I'll get to everybody in time if you -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_01.text:
It's been a long time! What brings you out of your forest?
You usually insist on staying at home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_02.text:
And at a festival like this! Who would've thought
we'd meet here, out of all places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_03.text:
That's what I should be saying!
It took me forever to find you here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_04.text: The world is wide and full of plants to meet and study!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_9_01.text:
Hmm... Tell me later, if you want.
Anyway...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_9_02.text:
You're well versed in botany, Éfendére.
Won't you give me a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_10_01.text:
Did you really expect me to not recognize you, even
if it has been years since our last meeting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_10_02.text:
You're still embarrassed of your name, aren't you, Barnie?
Is that why you pretended you were a stranger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_01.text: ... Ugh... Couldn't you just have pretended not to know me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_02.text:
But how could I ignore my childhood friend?
You're cruel, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_03.text:
It's the first time I'm seeing you since you left to 'see the
world.' Our cute little baby of the group, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_04.text:
S-stop calling me that!
I'm not Barnie anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_05.text:
I go by Basquiat now. I finally have a name that
sounds like an artist's!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_06.text:
Basquiat?
Huh, I've heard that name before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_02.text:
The head of the artists
rebelling against Road Industry, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_05.text:
So stop calling me Barnie.
I told you, it's lame.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_07.text:
But I didn't know you still painted.
I remember you were good at art, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_08.text: Hadn't you given it up to earn a living?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_01.text:
... I had, but I discovered that you can't stop your
heart from getting what it wants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_02.text:
That's how I've been living: painting the streets
with members of my crew...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_03.text:
... when mercenaries, hired by those big companies,
started kidnapping my friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_04.text:
I've yet to find out what they're up to, but I know for sure
that it can't be good. But nobody seems to care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_06.text:
The conglomerates of this nation are using human beings
as tools in the name of 'the advancement of science.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_07.text: It's a tragedy that must be stopped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_08.text: Yeah. We can't remain blind to their crimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_09.text:
I had to speak up,
if only for the sake of my friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_10.text: This led to that, and now... I'm here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_01.text:
Anyway. Weren't those soldiers back there
mercenaries hired by Rapture Science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_02.text: I thought they were here for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_03.text:
Why are you on the run?
And what's that strange bow you have there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_05.text: Give me the short version, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_06.text:
I'm a wanted criminal.
If they catch me, I'm dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_15_01.text: ... Okay, a little longer than that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_01.text:
Alright... I'm currently working for
the Neth Empire Interim Government.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_02.text: The Scrappy Gang disbanded after the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_03.text:
I joined the Revolutionary Army to fight against
corrupted soldiers, developing my own arrows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_04.text:
After a few clashes with mechanized troops
belonging to Rapture Science...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_05.text: I found that I had a bounty on my head. And so here I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_01.text:
Whoa... You've been living the hard life, too.
... I guess we're both aiming for the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_03.text:
I mean, who in their right mind would ever tolerate
such evil? And right under our noses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_04.text:
Those companies will sacrifice their own humanity
if it means they can develop some new technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_05.text:
... It's highly likely that your friends were kidnapped
to be used as test subjects for their experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_01.text:
Isn't it obvious why they're kidnapping so many people? They
need cheap batteries filled with mana to experiment...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_02.text:
... which they can take by the dozen from the back
alleys or slums, no trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_03.text:
I thought they were only interested in foreign wizards,
but if even the people of Neth were kidnapped...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_01.text:
A-are they insane?
And what do they do that for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_02.text:
I thought mad scientists only existed in TV shows.
Are they really experimenting on humans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_03.text:
Yes. For what they call technological advancements…
For power. They're using human beings as mere tools.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_04.text: That's... I don't know what to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_05.text:
I just thought that they were forcing kidnapped people
to work in an underground mine or something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_1_02.text:
All that's left is the back alley of 5th Avenue… and the
walls of 2nd Street... And today's work is done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_1_03.text:
You there, vandalizing the streets!
Halt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_01.text:
People have been keeping quiet about what's going on,
even when they knew the truth. It's time to change.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_02.text:
Yeah. I refuse to live in a country
that oppresses its own helpless citizens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_03.text: We gotta fight, if no one else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_21_02.text:
We may have a chance to cooperate in the future. Until
then, let's do our best in our respective places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_21_03.text:
Did you hear that?
It must be the intruders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_22_01.text: Looks like we wasted too much time here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_22_02.text:
We've gotta run.
Come on, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_23_01.text: I told you to call me Basquiat!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_01.text:
Barnie... That's adorable - and easy to remember.
Why he was so embarrassed of his old name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_02.text:
Actually, changing my name could bring a fresh breath
of air. How about... Pandy? Dora? Dorie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_03.text:
...
Fine, you don't have to look at me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_2_01.text:
Oh, crap!
They must be hired mercenaries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_3_02.text:
Shh.
Be quiet for a sec.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_4_01.text:
Which way did he go? He can't have gone too far.
This is the last time he'll get away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_4_02.text:
I'll search this direction.
You go the other way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_5_01.text:
... Looks like they left.
Sorry about that just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_5_02.text:
You can't just run in here like that!
The spray hasn't dried yet - ... huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_6_01.text:
Wait... Do you know me?
You seem strangely familiar...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_6_02.text:
N-no! We don't know each other!
I mistook you for someone else. Haha...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_01.text:
... We're both on the run. We don't have time for chit-chat.
Go that way; there's an escape hatch there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_02.text:
Hmm? The only people who know about that hatch
are members of the Scrappy Gang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_03.text:
Yes... Your face... your voice… Everything about
you points to one person I know very well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_01.text:
I-it's not Barnie! Do I look like a Barnie to you?
Do I look like a cute four-year-old kid?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_02.text:
I am the great artist and rebel Basquiat, sworn to fight
against the crimes of the conglomerates of Neth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_03.text:
That strange dislike of the name 'Barnie'… How he
reacted... It certainly seems like the Barnie I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_05.text:
I don't know who you think I am,
but I'm not it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_06.text:
Then let's make sure.
Take off your mask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_07.text:
I told you, I don't -
Ack! My mask! Give it back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_01.text:
Quaxo what?
... I knew it. You're insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_02.text:
'Quaxolotl.'
The great god who leads our tribe -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_03.text:
Sigh... Fine, fine.
Then why have you come all the way out here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_04.text:
Your tribe refused to venture out of the jungle
for years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_05.text:
As I said before,
we were blessed by the great god Quaxolotl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_06.text:
That is why we don't have to
hide in the jungle anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_07.text:
It's about time we come out back into the open
