The folly of one man is the fortune of another, as the saying goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_01.text:
Hey, everyone! It's been a long time!
How've you been?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_02.text:
Thanks for attending the first-ever 'Chrona Heroes Reunion'!
Well... Everyone except Goddess Chronos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_03.text:
Goddess Chronos is busy with imperial affairs at Impalis.
She told me to send her regards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_04.text:
And also Goddess Elanuma, who - as you all know...
erm, died in the last battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_05.text:
Oh, stop ruining the mood.
It's not like all of us gathered often in our past lives.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_06.text:
I - I'm not Goddess Elanuma herself, but as I've inherited
her memory and powers, I will do my best to alleviate her absence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_1_07.text:
Yes... The war... I remember... Back then it was common for a comrade
to be standing by your side one day... Buried in the ground the other...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_01.text:
Oh, lighten up, everyone.
And Kuhilim, this is not the time nor place for sorrowful reminiscences!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_02.text:
I apologize.
It hasn't been long since I recovered my former memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_03.text:
Anyway, Oren.
Oh, is it 'Leon' now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_04.text:
You haven't aged a day since we last saw you.
Or rather, you seem to have grown younger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_07.text:
Oh, really? It seems I'm the older one in this life.
Huhuhu... Why don't you try calling me 'Elder Sister'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_2_09.text:
Why? She isn't wrong;
you should treat your seniors with some respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_01.text:
It still feels like a dream to be laughing and enjoying ourselves like this.
Is our duty to the Goddess finally complete?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_02.text: Since, you know, all Apostles in Hasla have been defeated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_03.text:
No, there are still those who remain corrupted
under the Apostles' influence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_04.text: Hasla still needs us, the Chrona Heroes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_05.text:
Archana is right.
Our journey is only beginning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_06.text:
Yeah! As a team, nothing will stop us!
We'll get through every obstacle and battle - together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_3_07.text:
Except that final battle with Detalos, which my faithful crystal sword
'Danan' and I won. Single-handedly. So - together most of the time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_01.text:
... You might have dealt the finishing blow,
but we did most of the work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_02.text:
Without Dalton and me,
you would have been dead before ever facing Destalos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_03.text:
Yes. You'd do well to remember that the crack in Destalos's armor
through which you pierced your sword... was made by my bullet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_04.text:
... And we would have never faced the actual battle
if the rest of us hadn't fought the endlessly charging monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_05.text:
Yes. All those monsters from all over Hasla...
They still appear in my nightmares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_06.text:
Had it not been for Goddess Chronos, we would have all died
then and there. And we would have never reincarnated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_07.text:
'Reincarnated'... Wasn't it me, not Goddess Chronos, who cast
the most reincarnation spells in battle? You're all indebted to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_08.text:
Wait... All of you, stop.
Today is supposed to be a reunion. A day of comradeship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_09.text:
All of you are heroes of legend, praised by the people of Hasla.
And you still manage to fight over such a trivial thing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_4_10.text: I can feel Goddess Elanuma disapproving inside me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_01.text:
... This war would have never been possible
had it not been for the Goddess's blessing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_02.text:
It is no use arguing over each other's accomplishments...
They are all equal before the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_5_03.text:
Hey! Don't think you can trick us into believing something like that!
You're not even Goddess Elanuma herself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_01.text:
Sigh... There is one way to find out
who made the most contributions to the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_02.text: Have you ever heard of the #Library of Dimensions#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_04.text:
Yes. Legend has it that the Library of Dimensions holds
all the records of Hasla's past and present, and perhaps even its future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_05.text:
We could ask the librarian #Pandora#
for the true account of things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_07.text:
Why the sudden lack of faith?
Are you afraid that the truth may not be what you claimed it to be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_APFOOL_HYW_OP_6_08.text:
I - I never thought that!
Let's go right away! To the Library of Dimensions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SHOP_COMPLE.text:
Do you need anything else? The shop will close after the
event period, so make sure you spend all your Coins!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SHOP_DEFAUL.text:
I'll exchange the Bakery Coins you've earned
for items you need from my shop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_CHOCOLA_SHOP_LOCK.text:
The shop isn't ready yet.
Will you help run the bakery first?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_4_LOOP_2_END.text: Thank you for the help back there, {PLAYER_NAME}, but…

As much as I ponder over it, I still do not know whether
I am worthy of the great title that has been offered me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_1_1.text:
What can this be?
It seems a letter addressed to us, straight from the Empire…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_1_2.text: Oh! It's an invitation to the Empire's annual Celebration Ball.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_1.text:
Ah, this must be your first time to the Celebration Ball,
{PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_2.text:
The Celebration Ball is one of the biggest festivals held in Grancia.
It is held over quite the period of time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_3.text:
During the festival, a royal ball is held in the Palace.
Only those directly invited by His Majesty can attend...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_4.text:
... and it seems that this letter is that very invitation.
This is a great honor, bestowed only to those most highly regarded.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_5.text:
It's no surprise you were invited, {PLAYER_NAME},
but I had never imagined I too would receive such an honor…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_6.text:
This invitation is a rare opportunity and an occasion of great importance.
We should prepare our attire accordingly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_OP_2_7.text:
Luckily the day of the ball is still far away,
so we should have some time to make the proper arrangements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ10_PANDORA.text:
Long time no see, {PLAYER_NAME}.
What a dumb look you have on your face right now, hee hee.

What happened to her later down, you ask...?
... I'll leave that to your imagination.

But don't worry,
I'll turn back your time this 'time' as well.

This will only affect the time within the story.
Your other Heroes will be fine, don't worry.

Hmm~ Since it's a little boring like this, 
let me try copying a certain Goddess of your world!

Now... Have your thoughts changed
from the first time you witnessed this dull tragedy?

Hey, I can't hear you. You didn't answer out loud, right?
Separate dimensions, remember? ... Then again, maybe next time...

Okay, okay. I'll stop with the dimensional teasing.
I'm not the one you should be angry at.

As you know I shouldn't be involved in this world...
But we're seeing a story that we shouldn't be seeing again.

Thanks to a certain somebody's bad decision-making,
a tragedy was born. Bravo~.

Yes, {PLAYER_NAME}. You chose this story as your fate.
And hers. In this timeline, you will never see her again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ11_ENDING_.text:
'You discover a letter.
It seems to be a letter from Lednas:'
'Dear Captain, I will be waiting in the forest near the town.'

{PLAYER_NAME}. Do you remember our conversation at the Ball?
I said I would teach you how to dance.
This... is the last thing I must teach you before I leave.

It is admittedly a little late to be dancing outside, but...
The starlight is oddly bright tonight.
Now, take my hand.
Yes, one step after the other.

Very well done. Keep this rhythm...
And follow my lead.
I am surprised. You are a quick learner.

If I had known you would learn so quickly,
I would have taught you at the Ball there and then.

{PLAYER_NAME}.
Do you remember the day of our first meeting?
Yet after some time, I started to grow worried once more.
What would happen if you became disappointed with me?

What if you decided to leave - to pursue greater adventures?
I... Every day the questions tortured me.

I tried to act accordingly and carefully. 
Yet I fear I unwittingly hurt you many times with my mistakes.

I apologize,
and I will continue apologizing from the bottom of my heart.

And yet... Thank you. Thank you for staying by my side.
Thank you for choosing to remain, despite all my mistakes and flaws.
I…really…
I am very thankful that we met.

And I... For a long time I couldn't make up my mind
whether to leave Hero Town.

Many questions ran through my head that day:
Who would be coming to this town? What would they be like?
But I really...

I really like being with you, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I really like our adventures, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Despite all my flaws, what I really wish is...

To continue walking the path we have chosen to take,
beside each other, together.
So…
With me…no, with all of us.
Won't you go on another adventure with us?
It was not mere curiosity that filled my heart, but anticipation.

It was not long before we finally met
and I discovered a new and rather confused captain before me.

At first, I was worried whether you would adapt well.
Whether... you would learn to love it here.

My worries proved useless as you did well - better than well. 
You became a far greater hero than I could ever be.
And as I stood behind you, watching you on your path,

I knew that if it were together with you, I could...
We could go on this adventure for a long time.

For a long time after realizing this,
I was so happy I couldn't fall asleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_CHOICE_1.text:
Yes... I know Miss Chocolat often visits the Palace
as even His Majesty himself is fond of her baking, but...

A-are you offering to help me?
And for... for -free-, as well?

W-w-e-e-ll, it does go against my - ahem! - "business principles",
but then again, you've helped me out a lot. So only this time!
There you go!
T-thank you, Miss Bridget.

Okie dokie! Now for the design of the dress. What to do
for a social fledgling whose wardrobe only consists of breastplates...?

If it were completely up to me, -I- would make the most luxurious dress
out of the finest silk and beautiful jewels... Something to be envied...
U-um, Miss Bridget...
Aww, fine, fine. A simple design it is.

BUT! You could help me out by gathering the necessary
cloth and materials. You can handle that part, right?

Now, now! {PLAYER_NAME}, don't just stand there.
Help Lednas out!

She does not seem too, ah, 'fashion-oriented,' if you will excuse me.
Seeing that she always wears the same uniform even on holidays...

There's no time to lose, you two.
We want to finish this dress before the Ball!

Haha... I-if it's not too much of a bother...
C-could you help me this one time?
I am not sure asking her for advice is the best option.

{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas!
How are your preparations for the Ball going?
Miss Bridget? What brings you here?
Oh. Well, you see...

I heard about a certain lady knight
who STILL hasn't decided what to wear to her first important party!
So you knew…

Silly Lednas, of course Bridget knows everything to know around here! 
Now, stand still. I need your measurements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_CHOICE_2.text:
Yes... Miss Bridget would know a lot about ballroom dresses,
as many of her customers are nobles of the Empire.
So you knew…

Silly Lednas, of course Bridget knows everything to know around here! 
Now, stand still. I need your measurements.

A-are you offering to help me?
And for... for -free-, as well?

W-w-e-e-ll, it does go against my - ahem! - "business principles",
but then again, you've helped me out a lot. So only this time!
There you go!
T-thank you, Miss Bridget.

Okie dokie! Now for the design of the dress. What to do
for a social fledgling whose wardrobe only consists of breastplates...?

If it were completely up to me, -I- would make the most luxurious dress
out of the finest silk and beautiful jewels... Something to be envied...
U-um, Miss Bridget...
Aww, fine, fine. A simple design it is.

But... knowing her, she will ask for a hefty price.
Gold or something equivalent to its value...

BUT! You could help me out by gathering the necessary
cloth and materials. You can handle that part, right?

Now, now! {PLAYER_NAME}, don't just stand there.
Help Lednas out!

There's no time to lose, you two.
We want to finish this dress before the Ball!

Haha... I-if it's not too much of a bother...
C-could you help me this one time?
Should I really ask her for help...?

{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas!
How are your preparations for the Ball going?
Miss Bridget?!

Huh? What's that look on your face?
... Were you two talking behind my back?

N-no, not at all. 
What brings you all the way here?
Oh. Well, you see...

I heard about a certain lady knight
who STILL hasn't decided what to wear to her first important party!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_CHOICE_3.text: ... You must understand I think most highly of Master Fergus.

A-are you offering to help me?
And for... for -free-, as well?

W-w-e-e-ll, it does go against my - ahem! - "business principles",
but then again, you've helped me out a lot. So only this time!
There you go!
T-thank you, Miss Bridget.

Okie dokie! Now for the design of the dress. What to do
for a social fledgling whose wardrobe only consists of breastplates...?

If it were completely up to me, -I- would make the most luxurious dress
out of the finest silk and beautiful jewels... Something to be envied...
U-um, Miss Bridget...
Aww, fine, fine. A simple design it is.

BUT! You could help me out by gathering the necessary
cloth and materials. You can handle that part, right?

Now, now! {PLAYER_NAME}, don't just stand there.
Help Lednas out!

But it is also highly evident that he would know nothing about
fine ballroom dresses. No, it is simply not possible.

There's no time to lose, you two.
We want to finish this dress before the Ball!

Haha... I-if it's not too much of a bother...
C-could you help me this one time?
Sigh... Who can I ask for help...?

{PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas!
How are your preparations for the Ball going?
Miss Bridget? What brings you all the way here?
Oh. Well, you see...

I heard about a certain lady knight
who STILL hasn't decided what to wear to her first important party!
So you knew…

Silly Lednas, of course Bridget knows everything to know around here! 
Now, stand still. I need your measurements.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_END_1_1.text:
Let's see...
Good! You got everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_END_1_2.text:
Then I should get started right away.
Don't worry, the best tailors in the Empire will be helping me out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ1_START_1_.text: Hmm... I really should ask the Captain for some advice...

Oh? Ask other people in town for advice?
Well, it is a little embarrassing, but there's no time to be embarrassed.
I wonder who I could ask…

Mmm, I shouldn't waste {PLAYER_NAME}'s time
with such petty matters…

Yet, I don't know what to wear...
Maria, why must you send me such strange outfits at a time like this?
... Did you hear everything I just said?

Truth be told, I have not yet decided what I should wear to the
Celebration Ball. I-I do not usually attend ceremonies like this, you see.
I sent a letter to Maria asking her for advice, but…

She only responded by sending me... ill-fitting... outfits
usually only worn by celebrities such as Cano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ2_CHOICE_1.text:
Maria... The Saintess and I have known each other for a long time.
She is... one of the few people I can truly confide in.

Our respective business usually keeps us from
seeing each other often, but...

It was thanks to you, {PLAYER_NAME}, that I could share
some time with her as I had not for a long while.

Now, the Celebration Ball is far from over.
Let us enjoy it together while it lasts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ2_CHOICE_2.text:
I-I apologize, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I had not realized that so much time has passed.
I must have been caught up in the conversation.

But the Celebration Ball is far from over.
Let us at least enjoy together the time left us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ2_START_1_.text:
How strange everything seems...
To be preparing for a festival as a guest and not a knight.

You look beautiful in everything as always, dear Lednas,
but what about the dresses I so painstakingly sent you?

Maria, you must have realized by now
that I am a knight, and not a... pop star.
But still, Lednas -
Saintess Maria! Where have you disappeared off to?!
Oh, dear. That seems to be for me.

Come with me, Lednas! I have many things I wish to hear from you,
and many things I wish to tell you as well.
But... Maria, your knight is looking for you.

It shall be quick~
Dear Lednas, I'd thought you treasured our friendship more than this!
Of course - but -

{PLAYER_NAME},
can I borrow my dear Lednas for just a while?

I only hope today shall pass by uneventfully,
with no further surpri-
See, Lednas? Even {PLAYER_NAME} has given us the green light.

... Nobody refuses you, Maria.
But! It will be only for a little while.

Then {PLAYER_NAME},
I'll be back very soon.
Many Hours Later
I'm sorry I'm late, {PLAYER_NAME}...

Oh, Lednas~
Where have you been?
Sigh... It seems my wish shall never come true.

Hee hee! Hullo there, {PLAYER_NAME}!
It really has been a while! How have you been?

Maria! Are you out alone again?
Where is your knight?
It's okay~ it's just for a little while~
Your knight sure works hard, Maria.

Oh, you know how it is, Lednas!
Anyway, I see you have a new dress I've never seen before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_CHOICE_1.text: Ah, by the way, His Majesty had summoned us.

He sounded as if he had something important to say.
We should seek an audience with him shortly after the Ball.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_CHOICE_2.text:
Hmm hmm, I see.
Perhaps I can teach you how to dance later.
Ah, by the way, His Majesty had summoned us.

He sounded as if he had something important to say.
We should seek an audience with him shortly after the Ball.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_END_1_1.text:
I now see why Maria called the Ball the crown of the festival.
It was truly beautiful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_END_1_2.text:
Now that the Royal Ball is over,
let us go seek His Majesty's audience.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_LOOP_2_C.text:
Hmm hmm, I see.
Perhaps I can teach you how to dance later.
Ah, by the way, His Majesty had summoned us.

He sounded as if he had something important to say.
We should seek an audience with him shortly after the Ball.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_LOOP_2_E.text:
I now see why Maria called the Ball the crown of the festival.
It was truly beautiful.

Now that the Royal Ball is over,
let us go seek His Majesty's audience.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ3_START_1_.text:
I am curious to see it -
Maria called the Royal Ball the crown of the festives.

...And... I also heard that it is customary for guests of the Ball
to share a dance with their partners as a symbol of trust and friendship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_CHOICE_1.text:
Haha, even {PLAYER_NAME} agrees!
Hero Town cannot always keep you to itself.
... Could I ask for some time to think over the matter, sire?

Of course. But you must give me an answer
before the next Council meeting, mind you.

Yes, sire.
Then we ask your leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_CHOICE_2.text:
... I see.
If you say so, {PLAYER_NAME}...

Haha, {PLAYER_NAME} cannot forever keep you to themselves.
The Empire calls you, Lednas.

A matter of such importance must be given some thought, sire.
Could I ask for some time to think over the matter?

Of course. But you must give me an answer
before the next Council meeting, mind you.

Yes, sire.
Then we ask your leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_END_1_1.text:
As much as I ponder over it, I still do not know whether
I am worthy of the great title that has been offered me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_LOOP_2_C.text:
Haha, {PLAYER_NAME} is right. I do not mean for you to
decide here and now. Such is why I have given you some time.

Yet time does not wait forever, Lednas.
You must give me an answer before the next Council meeting.

The night grows old. We shall continue on some other day.
As {PLAYER_NAME} has said, give my words some thought.
Yes, you shall have my decision by then, sire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ4_START_1_.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}, Lednas!
You both look especially splendid tonight.

Haha... Of course, you have.
In fact, you did far better than all my expectations - and more.

Such is the reason I wish to recommend you at the next council 
meeting as the next 'Galahad' of Grancia. Nobody should oppose.

... It... This is a great honor, sire.
Yet I fear it is also rather abrupt.

I fear I have not the skill nor the valor
befitting the great name of Galahad...

Haha, the Lady Knight is humble!
I do not mean for you to become the next Galahad for some time.

The current Galahad shall guide you for a few years.
For the time being, you shall become... Yes, his student.

Even so, sire, I still have duties at Hero Town
and a responsibility to aid {PLAYER_NAME}...
It is an honor, Your Majesty.

As you two have much business to attend to,
I shall not keep you for long.

Lednas. Long have you served me in Hero Town.
It is time for you to pack up and return to the Palace.

Do you remember when I first sent you to Hero Town?
Everyone thought I had gone mad, for a while. Great potential, wasted.

Yet it was you, my dear Lady Lednas, who spoke thus:
that you would go to the ends of the world if it were my bidding.

Ah, your courage, your noble soul! A true knight of Grancia indeed.
From that day onwards my expectations for you grew,  Lady Knight.
Sire... Have I not met... your expectations...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_CHOICE_1.text: Sigh... I suppose it can't be helped.

Lednas, sighing isn't good for you!
I noticed you have been doing it a lot recently.
Yes, thanks to a certain someone...

Someone? Oh, dear. I wonder whoever that could be~!
What a terrible person!
Oh, Maria. Come on, let us head out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_CHOICE_2.text: Mind you, it may be more dangerous than usual.

I'm sure we'll be alright! After all, Lednas shall protect me.
Isn't that so, Lednas? My trusty knight in shining armor.
Sigh... I suppose it can't be helped.

Lednas, sighing isn't good for you!
I noticed you have been doing it a lot recently.
Yes, thanks to a certain someone...

Someone? Oh, dear. I wonder whoever that could be~!
What a terrible person!
Oh, Maria. Come on, let us head out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_END_1_2.text:
Haha, come find me anytime 
you have something on your mind, Lednas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_END_1_5.text: ... Do not be afraid... to do what you truly wish to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ5_START_1_.text: 'A week has passed by since that night...'

Lednas, as much as I love hearing you out,
why don't you try asking for other people's advice too?

Someone such as…
Perhaps, a very close companion?
That's why I am talking to you, Maria.

No, not me, darling.
Of course, we are the best of friends, Lednas…

But surely there are those who have closely shared
everyday life with you, and care about you, too?

Hee hee, that's the end of my counseling session!
Please escort me on the way back, Lednas.

It is late, Maria.
You'd best return in the morning.

No, no - I must return by morning.
A lot of people are waiting for me, tee hee~

'And yet each passing day does not offer me any clearer thought,
but rather more dread of the decision I cannot make.'
Do you think I have the right to carry the name of Galahad, Maria…?

And I still think I have much to do...
Here, in Hero Town.

Hehe, this isn't like you Lednas.
It's quite endearing to see you this flustered.

Oh no, no, no! I'm just happy to see little Lednas
figure out what she truly wants in her life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_CHOICE_1.text: Huh? Lednas, is anything the matter?
No... I had always thought you as the epitome of greed.

I had never known you to be so kind and compassionate.
It seems my prejudice had blinded me to your true self.

Don't worry, this is an investment.
I'm going to get everything I deserve AFTER you become famous!

Don't worry about it~
Let's get going! There's no time to lose!

Lednas! You know this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
You know it better than anyone!

Ugh, I should have known
when you grew all shy about your dress...

Don't apologize, just go start preparing!
We have a LOT to do.
Hey, you can apologize later, okay?

Oh, and if you need anything, just tell me.
I'm not going to charge you - not for this, at least!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_CHOICE_2.text:
Galahad?! Isn't that the name of the legendary knight?
His apprentice! That's great, Lednas!

I started to look for things that I could do around the town.
After that, it was easy to find my place in my new home.

That's why I continue to bake in this village...
Because people here need me.
Oh, I guess I rambled a bit there, hee hee.
No, my mind feels clearer. Thank you.

Then that's a relief! Oh! Since you're here, 
do you want any freshly baked bread by any chance?

Ah, no, thank you. Perhaps next time.
I have something I must do now.

But I am not sure if I am worthy enough
to accept the offer.
And whether if it really is my true calling...
I had the same problem when I first came to Hero Town.

I had just followed my father to a strange new village,
and for some time I just felt like the new girl, unable to fit in.

And to make matters worse, my father left for his training
before I had found an answer to all my questions.

I was scared that I would never belong. Everything seemed out of place,
and I wondered to myself whether I should go back 'home.'

But soon afterwards, I realized something that made me stay:
the people needed me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_CHOICE_3.text:
Master Fergus...
Did you know that I would be facing such a problem...?

No. Only... I once knew a hero long ago
who shared the same dilemma you have now.
I only gave the same advice.
I will leave that to your imagination.

However - if you think about it from another perspective,
it isn't too hard a problem.

Let me ask you a question in turn.
What is it that you want to do?

No, no. I won't force you for an answer. Your expression says it all.
It is no simple task to force yourself down that difficult road.

You are a knight, and surely you have your own code of life.
There is no correct way to be a knight.

The path you choose is the path of a knight.
Don't worry. You already know what to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_END_1_1.text: 'My head feels clearer thanks to the advice I received.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_END_1_2.text: 'Without a doubt, what I really want is...'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ6_START_1_.text: You must have some close companions in your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_CHOICE_1.text:
Jeez!!! You can be REALLY stubborn,
you know that, {PLAYER_NAME}?

Ah~ I don't know anymore~
You can persuade Lady Schula yourself, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_CHOICE_2.text: Sigh... Sometimes you can be really stubborn, {PLAYER_NAME}.

Ah~ I don't know anymore~
You can persuade Lady Schula yourself, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_END_1_2.text:
Oh? N-nothing. Nothing happened.
I'm just worn out from organizing my belongings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_END_1_4.text: Did you say... my new sword...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_END_1_5.text: N-no. Not at all... I'm just...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_END_1_6.text:
I'm just... so...
Very happy, so much that my heart... It rather hurts...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_END_1_7.text: Thank you. Thank you most sincerely, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ7_START_1_.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, there you are.
I have something to tell you...

Who, you ask? The best blacksmith in the Empire: Lady Schula!
Only she could be make the best weapon fit for our best knight!

But, you will need to gather and bring the materials yourself.
Due to our limited time, this is the only way.

Let's see, we should need iron... And fragments of Danan, of course.
Oh! And you should never forget an Old Weapon!

And…you should probably tell Lednas and see Lady Schula 
together to discuss Lednas's new weapon.
I may not know a lot about swords or swordsmanship...

But all blacksmiths say that they must meet the future owner
in person in order to forge the best weapon.

'Miss Bridget? She looks serious. What is she discussing?
It's hard to hear from this distance...'
'New captain? Hmm, I can't quite hear...'

'Continue position? ... No...
It must be a misunderstanding. I should get closer to hear better...'

As soon as possible? Don't worry.
I know just the person you'd like, {PLAYER_NAME}!
As soon as possible... I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_CHOICE_1.text:
I - I know that!
Stop throwing stupid sayings at me!

I... I'm quite alright.
There shouldn't be a reason to be so sad.

Now, we do not have much time.
I have many things to teach you before my departure.

W-what's going on?
Why is Miss Chocolat crying..?
Waaah!! Please don't forget me when you're gone!

Of course I won't forget you, Miss Chocolat.
Now, now... Don't cry. It's okay.

Sob... Okay...
And... Here's some bread I baked for you.

Now that you're here...
I'll go back... to the bakery...

Sigh... Miss Bridget was like this as well.
And now Miss Chocolat...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_CHOICE_2.text:
Uh, why did Miss Chocolat just run out crying?
Did something happen?
... If you insist it is nothing...

If you are feeling better, let's go on to the next item on our checklist.
I have many things to teach you before my departure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_1.text:
If you ever get confused about what I have told you today,
I have left you a guide that you can reference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_10.text: 'Truth be told, I intended to not tell you until the end,'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_11.text:
'but I feared I would be betraying our... trust
if I wasn't truthful with you, even after my departure.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_12.text:
'Thank you for everything, {PLAYER_NAME}. I did my best,
but it seems I was not enough to meet your expectations.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_13.text:
'In this state, I shall never be enough to accept the name of Galahad.
So, I have decided to become a wandering knight for the time being.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_14.text:
'I shall roam the continent and help those in need. Perhaps our time
together... shall become a fond memory when we meet again.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_15.text:
'Thank you... for everything.
May the Goddess protect you wherever you go.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_16.text:
'And with this letter,
I never saw Lednas again.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_3.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Have you… have you ever disliked me during my time here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_4.text: What? If you ask me what I mean…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_5.text:
... No, never mind.
Please forget what I just said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_6.text:
Thank you for your hard work today, {PLAYER_NAME}.
Rest well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_8.text:
'You discover a letter.
It seems to be a letter from Lednas:'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_END_1_9.text:
'By the time you read this letter,
I will have long left town.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_LOOP_2_C.text:
Right?! You don't want Lednas to leave either,
right, {PLAYER_NAME}?

But I can't stop her from leaving...
Goodbyes should be cheerful so that Lednas doesn't worry.

Okie, I know what to do! I'll give a special farewell present
just like you and Bridget did:

maybe a special oven, 
so that Lednas can eat bread even when I'm not around!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_LOOP_2_E.text:
If you ever get confused about what I have told you today,
I have left you a guide that you can reference.
Yes, I shall see you soon.

Looking back... We have gone through a lot together, have we not?
It seems time has truly flown.
Now... I have told you everything I need to tell you.

I am certain that you shall do well without me.
I know you will, {PLAYER_NAME}. I know you will.
Oh. There is... one last thing I must teach you.

I'm sorry but, in a little bit,
would you... would you come visit my chambers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_FOURTH_SQ8_START_1_.text:
When a new Hero arrives,
you just need to guide them to the place on this map.

Oh, she's off doing another task?
She sounds super busy…

What about you, {PLAYER_NAME}?
You look really tired.

You're tired from using your brainpower?
Well, I have just the thing, then! Reeeallly sweet bread!

Trust me, you need some sugar.
Come on, let's eat it together!
Anyway… I can't believe Lednas is already leaving tomorrow.

I feel like her absence will be so big.
She'll really be missed by everyone.

To be honest I wanted to tell her not to leave,
but I didn't want to get in the path of her decision.

I-I know it won't be like we can never see her again,
but... But... Waah!!

Sob... I know my tears are making the bread salty!
But - I'm just… I'm just so sad!!

Aren't you - aren't you even a little upset that she's leaving,
{PLAYER_NAME}?!

Now you must learn how to manage the town inventory.
This is a complicated process, so please focus.

Haha, it is alright to be a little confused.
I too made many mistakes for the first few weeks.
You will get used to it soon.

Hmm... Should we rest a little before we continue?
You look rather tired.

Please rest for a while.
I will go check another facility in the meantime.

How are you two doing?
Huh? Where's Lednas?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_MAZE_SHOPBUY_01.text: Please stop by whenever you need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_01.text:
You've waited long for this moment, ladies and gentlemen!
Welcome to the Third Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_02.text:
Before enjoying the passionate stages of skilled musicians
from all corners of the continent, let's meet the judges of the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_03.text:
The former backing vocalist of Cano☆Revolution and our latest star,
she sings with a celestial voice! It's Meri!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_05.text:
Excuse me, my manager never told me I'd be judging.
I thought this was Cano's solo show. Can I go now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_06.text:
Ha... Haha, erm. What a - heart-warming display
of friendship and respect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_07.text:
Next up is the magical popstar who fights evil:
a rising supernova, Yuna!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_08.text: Hey, guys! It's me, Yuna, your favorite idol star!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_09.text:
Don't be so nervous, 'kay?
There's nothing more important than enjoying ourselves! Love you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_1_11.text:
... You just laughed at me, didn't you?
You newb, I'll make you regret everything you did before -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_2_01.text:
Psst! Calm down, please!
We're on air!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_2_04.text:
Sigh... And last but not least, our final judge:
Hasla's hope and light of the night,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_2_05.text:
the official mascot of the Night Witches, the pride of Grancia,
the leader of the chart-topper Cano☆Revolution...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_2_06.text: It's your one and only legendary popstar, Cano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_3_01.text:
Music is love! And I'll be your song!
It's me, Cano, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_3_02.text:
Hasla Music Festival... It brings back so many memories.
I'm participating as a judge this time, but I'm more passionate than ever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_4_01.text:
A lovely greeting from Hasla's perfect popstar!
Now, let's officially begin the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_4_02.text:
Here are the talented stars
of the monumental first stage of the Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_4_03.text:
One's a pure-hearted soul who seeks to confess his love,
and the other's an angel of affection who has come to help him!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_02.text:
Isn't that the Captain of the Cobalt Knights...?
Or is it someone who just resembles him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_03.text:
Oh, Sir Caeneus!
W-what are you doing here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_04.text:
I've been preparing for this day.
Is it not marvelous?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_05.text:
Huhu... As expected of you, Sir Caeneus...
Your pure heart is worth the long journey from Roman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_06.text:
Orfeo, my old friend!
You have my sincerest thanks for your encouragement!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_07.text:
Erm, each to his own, I guess.
Then let's go on to the next contestant!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_08.text:
Hmm... This duo introduces themselves as a 'metal monster' reborn
under a new name... 'Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye,' and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_5_09.text:
... a rising super rookie, {PLAYER_NAME}!
Introducing 'Jeomrye and Captain'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_6_01.text:
I've finally returned, Hasla Music Festival!
Cano, long time no see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_6_03.text:
Sigh... That name is dead to me, Cano.
I am reborn as... #Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_6_04.text:
You better be nervous.
Your title as Hasla's greatest musician... is mine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_7_02.text:
Breaking news! It's revealed that Ludwig Metal Bach Jeomrye
is none other than the former member of Cano☆Revolution, Miyu!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_7_03.text:
But before we dig deeper into their history,
the two teams are ready to compete!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_1_7_04.text:
The first round of the festival is officially underway
with 'Lover Boy' and 'Jeomrye and Captain'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_01.text:
Emerging victorious from the first round
of the Hasla Music Festival is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_03.text:
What... How... Why...
Didn't you feel my passion?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_04.text: Hmm... Shall we hear the judges' comments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_01.text:
... hear me? Can you hear me?
Levine Ludovico, I need you to respond.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_02.text:
Yes, I hear you loud and clear, Caroline Ludovico.
I thought you'd be calling soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_03.text:
You've finally left that country town
for the Music Festival, yes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_05.text: And I take it that Cano's letter was your doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_06.text: Huhuhu, of course. It must be working properly, then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_07.text:
What's working properly?
... Did you do something without my knowledge?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_08.text: Oh, you'll see. You're in for a treat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_09.text:
If you've forgotten, we're the same, #you# and #me#.
And you know that we hate surprises.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_1_11.text:
Ahem. Isn't {PLAYER_NAME} nearby?
Let's not test our luck by talking too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_01.text:
Greetings, everyone!
Welcome to the #4th# Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_02.text:
Before we begin the fierce competition of talented musicians
from all over Hasla, the judges will first introduce themselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_03.text:
First, one of the most popular musicians of the day:
#Starlit Voice# Meri!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_05.text:
This is horrible...
If only Cano was here with me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_06.text: I hope Yuna bursts her appendix.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_07.text:
A-appendix?! And here I was trying to be nice for the day!
You started th-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_09.text:
Psst! We're on air -
as I've told you before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_10.text:
And as she has taken the pains to introduce herself,
let's go on to our next judge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_11.text:
The idol who, despite clear evidence of assault, battery, and
other offenses, refuses to stop punishing criminals herself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_12.text:
(which is against the law, ladies and gentlemen)
the voracious vigilante, the ravager: Magic Girl Yuna!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_13.text: ... I don't like your tone there, reporter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_14.text:
Sigh... Whatever.
I'm nice enough to let it go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_15.text:
Hello, everyone~!
Here's your stellar popstar, Yuna! I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_18.text: - the champion of the 3rd Hasla Music Festival:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_19.text:
the super rookie who surprised the whole continent with
her soulful heavy metal: Ludovich Metal Bach Jeomrye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_2_21.text:
Thanks for all your love and support!
I'll be judging this year's competition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_01.text:
Your favorite judges aren't the only thing special about
this year's Hasla Music Festival, ladies and gentlemen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_02.text:
Thanks to our collaboration with the Neth Empire,
the festival is now available for streaming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_03.text:
You can now stream the festival from anywhere in Hasla
as long as you have a device!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_04.text:
Of course, if you're hearing this,
I'm guessing you already know!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_05.text: But how is this possible, you ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_3_06.text:
We have a special guest who will answer our questions.
Give it up for Levine Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_01.text:
Hello, hello, members of the ill-educated public!
It's me, Levine Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_02.text:
Wait. I recognize her. She's a wanted criminal! Guards,
time to prove that your paychecks aren't going to waste!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_03.text:
What are you talking about, Yuna?
You shouldn't be so rude to the hero of Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_05.text:
Well, you heard wrong. Chasing after all those criminals
made you susceptible to fake rumors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_08.text:
Previously, live broadcasts were known
to be impossible outside the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_09.text:
Can you explain the technology that allows today'
 broadcast to be transmitted throughout the continent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_10.text:
The real question is, even if I explain the whole mechanism,
would you understand it? Stop asking useless questions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_11.text: Now, shut up and get on with the event!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_12.text:
Neth Empire's celebrated scientist said I have just asked
a useless question! She exudes intelligence AND charisma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_4_13.text: Just between you and me, she seems a bit of a nutcase.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_01.text:
Now that introductions are over, we'll meet the contestants
who will compete in the first round of the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_02.text:
Introducing the pinnacle of Neth Empire's high technology,
the first android group in the history of Hasla:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_5_03.text: Team #Do Androids Dream of Electric Pop Stars?#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_01.text:
Ooh! R-0, look!
I've seen them on TV before!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_02.text: They look so different in real life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_03.text: I admit I cannot see the difference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_04.text:
Can it be alikened to the difference between viewing an
image through the camera lens and on screen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_06.text: We're also excited to see you in person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_07.text:
Curious what these androids, said to be capable of taking
out entire brigades on the battlefield, will sing? Stay tuned!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_09.text:
Oh,
we already know who they are!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_6_10.text:
It's {PLAYER_NAME}, former partner of Jeomrye! And
their new parter, Caroline from Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_02.text:
(And those androids!
Were they the 'pleasant surprise' she mentioned?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_06.text:
Haha, you seem nervous! I understand! I asked how you
feel about your first time participating in the Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_07.text:
Oh. Erm... Hmm...
I'll give it my best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_08.text:
Yes, that's the spirit! Our new rookie answers confidently
in the manner of the previous champion, Jeomrye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_09.text:
We saw you practicing for the contest, Caroline, and
decided to enter ourselves. We had nothing to do, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_10.text:
This should be the battle of the century: your human vocal
cords against our superior, latest version vocal system!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_11.text:
You have grown much better at lying, V. I remember
your CPU usage peaking since several days ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_12.text: Hey! I said that in confidence!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_13.text: Oh... Haha. I'm glad to see you, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_7_14.text:
Is everyone already acquainted?
What an interesting turn of events!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_1_8_01.text:
Now, let's turn the sound up to Team #Ride Zero# and Team
#Do Androids Dream of Electric Pop Stars?#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_01.text:
It was sweet.
To the point that all my teeth almost fell out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_02.text:
I don't know how to feel about your costume...
I deducted some points; it felt too, er, couture.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_03.text:
Caeneus, I love love, and your song was lovely.
But at the end of the day, my vote goes to Jeomrye and Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_06.text:
Do not despair, beautiful Caeneus.
Life holds many more opportunities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_07.text:
You will have a chance to show your lady
your noble heart of love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_08.text:
Sigh... Alright.
I accept defeat and will withdraw from the tournament.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_01.text: The victors of the 1st round of the Hasla Music Festival are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_03.text:
What! Are you all malfunctioning?
Our performance was flawless!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_1_04.text:
Hmm... Well,
let's see what the judges have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_01.text: I liked the song in itself, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_02.text:
You just played it on the speaker in your neck!
You can't call that singing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_03.text: You could have at least pretended to lip sync.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_05.text:
I thought humans' different renditions of the same song
indicated poor performance... I see I was mistaken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_06.text:
How old are you two? Not more than ten, right? You two
androids are too young to know anything about real music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_07.text:
Come back AFTER you study at least the difference
between heavy metal and R&B, kiddos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_2_09.text:
Grr... Grr...!
Just you wait, you stupid humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_01.text:
Congratulations on your first victory!
How do you feel about winning the first round?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_02.text:
Hmm...
I'm not sure whether to call that a real victory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_03.text:
Oh, luck is a skill.
Don't be so humble!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_04.text:
If you want 'real' competition,
then our next contestants will give a good fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_05.text:
What do machines and musical instruments have in
common? They both require a delicate hand!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_06.text:
And graduate students and soldiers? They follow their
superiors! Here are the two you never expected to team up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_07.text:
It's Stanya and Spiny
of Team #Spatynyany#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_3_08.text: ... Hmm? Is this really your team name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_01.text:
Yes, ma'am! It is! We just couldn't think of any better team
name than mashing up our own names together!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_02.text:
... No, I disagreed. I still feel like we could have come up
with something better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_03.text:
Stanya, Spiny… I didn't know you were competing in
the Festival as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_04.text:
Something is off. Where are the real musicians?
Levine - ...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_4_05.text: Wait a minute! What are you doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_01.text:
What? O-oh, we're old acquaintances,
and I wanted to ask whether -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_02.text:
Levine Ludovico is a national hero of the Neth Empire!
She deserves your utmost respect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_03.text: Lack of manners... I'll have to factor that into your score...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_04.text:
Yeah. From now on, any disrespect towards Levine
Ludovico will be considered an attack on me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_05.text:
Curioser and curioser. Why is everyone so
emotionally attached to you, Levine?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_06.text:
Yes, my own popularity astounds me. Still, it's a music
festival. Hence, we should compete with music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_08.text:
As expected of the gracious Levine Ludovico! A razor-sharp
intelligence, a gracious heart that holds no grudge...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_2_5_09.text:
She's a paragon to be upheld by all!
And with her wise words, we begin Round 2!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_01.text:
Congratulations on your first win!
How do you feel right now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_02.text:
Hrrmph, of course I won! I refuse to waste my time
on people who don't deserve it. Let's get on with it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_03.text:
Oh... Now that's confidence!
Then, without further ado...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_04.text:
Oh! Our next contestant
is reported to be the very subject of Caeneus's love song!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_05.text:
She's the Captain of the Central Knights and Grancia's beloved hero,
but today she's the leader of...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_01.text:
Aaaand the winners of the second round
of the 4th Hasla Music Festival are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_02.text:
... the rather unamiable but highly talented
Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_05.text:
Dead men tell no tales.
Get off my stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_1_06.text:
I couldn't have phrased it better myself!
Team #Spatynyany#, please step off the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_01.text:
Huh. Shouldn't there be more... formalities, considering
that this is the biggest music festival in Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_02.text:
Oh, is Caroline upset
over the fast and efficient pace of events?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_03.text:
Should we have ended with something like: the results for
the round of the century! Will be revealed in ONE! MINUTE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_04.text:
Oh, let's speed things up.
Even the interviews were getting a bit repetitive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_06.text:
She's a small giant with the entire Neth Army resting on her
shoulders, but she used to dream of joining an idol group!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_07.text:
With a real idol pop star by her side, is she one step
closer to realizing her childhood dream?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_2_08.text:
Give it up to Commander Yuria of the Neth Army and top
pop star Cano of Team #Even Commanders Can Be Stars#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_01.text:
Music is love!
Cano's here, everyone!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_02.text:
G-Greetings, soldiers. I am Commander Yuria of the
Neth Army. My hobby is bullseye shooting, and my major…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_03.text:
Haha, Commander Yuria!
There's no need to be so nervous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_3_04.text:
Cano, Commander Yuria...
Everyone here played a part in my past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_4_01.text:
It's about time you give me a proper explanation.
What are you up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_4_02.text:
Huhuhu... Still in the dark, Caroline?
I'm almost disappointed in you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_01.text:
The ultrasonic weapon Ms. Ludovico invented, when set
to a particular frequency, was found to cause

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_02.text:
an unexpected side effect:
mind control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_03.text:
Everyone on stage
is already under mind control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_04.text:
Including the camera crew. We're currently on a
commercial break, though, so don't worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_05.text:
Even the oh-so-mighty {PLAYER_NAME} is under my
control now. Isn't it great?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_06.text: This is complete travesty. I-I don't believe this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_07.text:
I agree; my level of genius IS truly hard to believe. Who
knew my invention could be used as a mind control device?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_08.text: So, what do you think of my surprise gift? Mesmerized?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_09.text:
Now, play your part and win the competition.
Remember, we're using D-CAT to conquer Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_10.text:
During the finals, with all of Hasla watching the broadcast,
I will play the recording of D-CAT...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_11.text:
... and just like that, Hasla will fall into our hands,
and we'll no longer have to continue this silly charade.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_13.text:
Yes, yes, I understand your disbelief.
Or is it disappointment? TOO easy, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_3_5_14.text:
Well, that's the way of the world.
Now, do your part and go compete!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_01.text: I see you were done for, Sir Caeneus...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_02.text:
It's not surprising,
as he's the weakest among us, the musicians of Grancia...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_03.text: It's still dishonorable for a knight to lose to a bassist!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_04.text:
Don't be too harsh on him. He fought well, considering the penalty
of the most ridiculous costume I've seen in my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_05.text: Are you sure they're on his side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_01.text:
Yay~ That was a great performance, Caroline!
You win!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_02.text:
I... I don't know.
Cano and Yuria's performance seemed better...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_1_03.text:
Well, I wouldn't know; I don't waste my time listening to
music. Judges, have you reached a decision?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_01.text:
OF COURSE Team #Ride Zero# wins the round!
We all agree with you, Ms. Levine Ludovico!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_03.text:
And Yuria? Pfft! She's a nurse-turned-commander!
What does SHE know about music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_04.text:
Yes… They both know... nothing about music…
Never did...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_06.text:
Oh, great. We broke Meri.
... Do you really need our commentary?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_07.text:
No, if everyone agrees
that victory goes to our Caroline.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_2_08.text:
Now, now!
Losers, get off the stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_01.text:
What's your problem, Caroline?
Everything is going as planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_03.text:
I  wanted to compete fair and square, with my own songs...
I wanted to be judged for the musician that I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_04.text:
Your own songs? I don't think so. If it hadn't been for my
intervention, you would have never reached the finals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_05.text:
You're me, and I'm you. And we both know that among
our many talents, music isn't one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_07.text:
But what?! Wake up, Caroline! Tsk, this is the reason
I wanted to keep you from going to Hero Town.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_08.text:
Never mind. I'll listen to all your silly talk of dreams and
whatnot later. Help me tie up {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_3_09.text: I hate to think what could happen if they wake up now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_4_01.text:
W-wait a minute.
What was that? Did they just... move?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_02.text:
No human has ever broken free of
my ultrasonic weapon's brainwashing sound waves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
You're unlike any other person I've ever met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_04.text:
With you by my side, I feel that I can finally become
what I've always wanted to be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_05.text: What? What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_06.text:
I'm sorry, Levine, but meeting {PLAYER_NAME}
reminded me of my long forgotten dream.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_07.text:
I...
I've always wanted to start my own rock band!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_08.text:
And who said you couldn't?! You can start a hundred
rock bands AFTER you conquer Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_09.text:
No, I no longer wish to live
a life of violence and destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_10.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} and I am going to defeat you, once
and for all, and free everyone from under your control.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_11.text:
Did you forget that D-CAT is useless against me?
Fine, have it your way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_12.text:
Everyone and everything on stage is on my side.
It's time for you to exit, stage left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_4_5_13.text:
Yes. For daring to rebel against our national hero, I'll make
sure you spend the rest of your lives in social death!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_01.text:
Jeomrye, wasn't it? I enjoyed your music.
Caeneus's defeat was understandable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_02.text:
We, the 'Grancia Imperial Band,' are of different class altogether.
Why don't you see for yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_01.text:
N-No... No!
I-I was on the verge of dominating the world...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_02.text:
... only to be stopped by a complacent idiot who claims
she wants to be a musician, of all things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_03.text:
An idiot?
Levine, a person who dreams can never be an idiot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_04.text:
Realizing one's dreams...
requires willpower... and physical force!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_05.text:
... ...
You know what? I don't even feel like trying anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_1_06.text:
Send me back to prison.
Do whatever you want. I surrender.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_01.text:
Hmm...?
Why does it feel like I've been sleeping standing up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_02.text:
Ugh... I had a very, very bad nightmare. A pink-haired
woman was controlling my every action...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_03.text:
Yeah, someone who looks just like… Huh? Levine
Ludovico? Isn't that person a wanted criminal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_04.text:
... Cano isn't old news.
She's still the best popstar in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_05.text:
Stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it,
stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_07.text:
O-okay, okay! I'll stop whatever it is you want me to!
J-just - stop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_08.text:
I see everyone has broken free of Levine's mind control
and come to their senses. I was worried for a moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_10.text:
It was Levine Ludovico
who used her sonic weapon to control you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_11.text:
I too... originally assisted her in her plans
as an accomplice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_12.text:
Not any longer. {PLAYER_NAME} helped me see the
error of my ways, and we defeated Levine together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_13.text:
I-I don't remember anything...
which is rather terrifying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_14.text:
Then what happens to the festival?
It seems the finals are already over and done with...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_15.text: S-should we skip ahead to the award ceremony?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_2_16.text:
No, we should start over - from the preliminary rounds.
This trophy means nothing if it isn't won fairly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_3_01.text: Oh, no... This can't be good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_01.text:
What's activating the teleporter? It shouldn't work without
my biometric authentication!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_03.text:
Oh, foolish, foolish Caroline.
All art and science are born of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_04.text: And I am the very essence of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_4_05.text:
Did you truly believe that I would be ignorant
of the petty tricks you call science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_5_01.text:
Bow down to your lord, your master, the great captain of
all monsters, the harbinger of doom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_01.text:
Why did you betray me?
And I expected so much more of you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_02.text:
Had you completed this mission, I would've rewarded you
with all the riches and glory your heart could desire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_03.text:
I've seen the treatment your loyal underlings get when you
tire of them: banishment beyond the dimensional portal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_6_04.text:
You won't fool me any longer. I'll help {PLAYER_NAME}
defeat you, and then pursue my dreams. My true dreams.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_01.text:
... How disappointing. So you prove yourself no different
from any other human, hurrying your own death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_02.text:
Ha, what? What are you going to do now? Even you can't
fight both me and {PLAYER_NAME} at the same time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_03.text: ... I am never so imprudent as to act on conviction alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_04.text:
I admit that {PLAYER_NAME} is strong enough
to be considered a true #ordeal#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_05.text:
However... Do you truly wish to risk the damage that will be
caused by our battle? The inevitable casualties?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_7_07.text:
That is why I propose a battle in the spirit of the Music
Festival: a competition on this very stage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_02.text:
Did you not hear what I just said?
All art and science are born of darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_03.text: Let me show you the true diabolic power of music.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_04.text:
Oh, look! Team #Ride Zero# has been challenged by
the Ent from the dimension beyond!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_05.text:
I... have no idea what's actually going on, but it seems that
the fate of the entire world rests on this round!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_5_8_06.text:
Which team shall emerge victorious?
Tune in for never-before-seen musical madness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_01.text:
T-the Chaotic Apocalypse Ent...
Where did he go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_02.text:
Ugh. Please tell me that this is the LAST time that we're
knocked unconscious. I'm getting too old for this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_10_04.text: ... My ears hurt, for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_01.text:
I knew it! {PLAYER_NAME} and Caroline!
You were the ones who defeated the music monster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_03.text:
Cha... Apo...
Whatever it called itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_11_04.text:
Odd that I can't recall how he went away.
Maybe he got bored and left?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_01.text:
Yes, I'm not sure about that part, either. I vaguely
remember someone singing away the monster...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_02.text:
That wasn't you?
Was it {PLAYER_NAME}, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_03.text:
Yeah, I remember bits and pieces of the melody...
It resembled the song of Team #Ride Zero#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_12_04.text:
Yes! It must be! I knew you were the true heroes of the 
Festival! You saved everyone here - everyone in Hasla!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_01.text: So... That's it? We're not double-checking what happened?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_02.text:
What use is there for double-checking?
Who else would have accomplished such a feat?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_04.text:
D-did we?
Well... If you say so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_05.text:
Now, then. It looks like the winners
of the 4th Hasla Music Festival have been decided!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_13_06.text:
The winners are... Caroline and {PLAYER_NAME}
of Team #Ride Zero#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_01.text:
Fine, I'll accept the trophy - this time.
I still refuse to believe that I won fairly, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
This is only the beginning for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_14_03.text:
At the next Hasla Music Festival,
I'll show everyone that I have real music in me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_01.text:
Huhuhu... What is the matter?
Can you bear it no longer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_02.text:
Ugh... This can't be...
I'm the composer of D-CAT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_03.text:
This version... is even more dreadful,
and I didn't know that to be possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_04.text:
Caroline, you were useful for a mere human… but you
cannot and shall not know the true resonance of D-CAT.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_1_05.text:
Even this is not the 'original' song of dread. I too am merely
repeating the echoes from behind the dimensions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_01.text:
E-even that... was mere 'echoes'?
That terrifying performance you just rendered?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_02.text:
Yes. Nothing is known about
the demonic voice who first sung that song...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_03.text:
... but they must indeed be
a monstrous god of both terror and beauty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_04.text:
Even I, the lord of all darkness of Hasla,
have no wish to meet that horrible deity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_06.text:
Has she passed out? Whew… The first and original Hasla…
has finally fallen into my hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_2_08.text: I can hear voices... Is somebody out there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_3_01.text:
Oh, finally! I've been looking everywhere for someone who's
awake. Everyone else was passed out... It was scary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_3_02.text:
But where am I? Is this a broadcasting station?
Looks like there's a festival of some sort.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_01.text:
What... are you?
How can you still be awake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_02.text:
I played D-CAT myself. It should have resonated
throughout the entire building.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_04.text:
Is this the first time you're seeing an Ent?
But enough of that. Answer me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_05.text:
Erm... I don't know what D-CAT is. All I did was follow this
familiar tune... and I found myself here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_06.text:
Familiar tune? Tsk, tsk...
A hearing impaired human, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_07.text:
Unfortunately, the vibrations of D-CAT can affect
even the deaf at so close a distance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_4_08.text: Curse your own foolishness as you submit to your fate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_01.text:
Oh, so I wasn't wrong.
I thought I heard the #Donut Cat# melody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_02.text: I've always wanted another friend to harmonize the chords.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_5_03.text:
Alright, then...
Do-do-do-do-do~ Do do do~ Do~nut cat~!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_01.text:
Ahem, ahem!
It's been awhile, so I need to warm up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_02.text:
Those piercing high notes...
Y-you must be... the owner of 'the voice'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_6_03.text:
Ah. Mic test! Ahem.
Have a sip of blueberry so~da!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_01.text:
Well, that was rude. You shouldn't scream to other
people's singing, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_02.text:
Yes... This is pure evil
that shakes the very foundations of one's soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_03.text:
O Terrible Creator,
the One Who Sings the 'Donut Cat'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_04.text:
Ever since the very first note of your song crossed my ears,
questions have been relentlessly tormenting my soul...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_05.text:
Why... How... WHAT do donuts and cats have to do with
each other? What do the lyrics mean? Why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_06.text:
And what does the ghost donut with legs mean?
Why is the soda blueberry-flavored?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_07.text:
And the fish bones that suddenly burst through the surface
of the earth? Tell me! I must know the secret meaning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_08.text:
What secret meaning? The lyrics are pure nonsense.
They aren't supposed to mean anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_10.text: I didn't write the lyrics, you know. I just sung them, because they told me to. The things I do for a paycheck...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_7_11.text:
Because they... told you to...? A paycheck...?
Haha... Hahahaha...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_8_01.text:
The song that completely transformed my existence into
what I am now... was but a simple whim of a foolish mortal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_8_02.text:
This is... I... You know what? I've had enough. I don't
understand any of this, and I don't want to. I'm done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_9_01.text:
Huh? Wait, what is this?
Something's dragging me away -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_END_9_03.text: I-it's been so long since I've been out of my dungeon… Let me at least get the bread I bought from - NOOOOO!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_03.text:
... that I'm still serious about this competition,
even if I'm your second choice to Jeomrye!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_04.text: Don't think for a moment that I won't give it my all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_10_05.text: Got it? Good! Then let's go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_1_01.text:
The time has finally come...
for the annual Hasla Music Festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
Ready to rock the stage with me one more time?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_01.text:
Good, good!
Time to start our special training!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_02.text:
I've already planned our schedule. First, we should
meditate under the local waterfall so that -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_2_03.text:
Jeomrye, there you are.
I've been looking everywhere for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_02.text: A letter has arrived, addressed to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_03.text:
It's from...
Huh, the Hasla Music Festival Secretariat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_3_04.text:
Ooh, maybe I'm being asked to deliver the speech
for the opening ceremony as the last festival's champion!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, I'm sorry,
but I can't be your partner this year.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_03.text:
Why? For what reason?
You couldn't have been banned from entering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_04.text:
Oh, it's nothing like that!
This letter is from Cano.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_05.text:
Seems like she has some business to attend to
and can't judge this year's Hasla Music Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_06.text:
And without Cano,
they're short of one judge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_08.text:
Yup, there's no musician more worthy than me
to judge THE Hasla Music Festival.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_4_09.text:
Anyway... That's why you'll need to go find another partner,
{PLAYER_NAME}. Sorry about the last minute timing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_01.text:
Oh, you're in a predicament. There's only a few days
left until registration is closed...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_03.text:
As this year's festival is being held in the Neth Empire,
I have quite a lot of free time on my hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_04.text:
I will bravely enter the competition
as your partner this year, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_5_05.text:
I knew that my time would come one day.
I've been practicing my guitar solo.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_01.text: What do you think? I poured my heart and soul into -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_02.text: ... What? What do you mean, I have no sense of rhythm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_03.text:
My soldiers all said
that my performance was divine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_04.text:
That's because you're their superior, Lednas.
They were only being polite.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_6_05.text:
Ugh, all that rigid discipline
is the exact reason why I never cared for the army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_02.text:
I met Jeomrye at the town gates
and she told me the news.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_03.text:
You're looking for a partner
for the Hasla Music Festival, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_7_04.text:
I don't have a partner, you don't have a partner… The
solution to both our problems is self-evident, don't you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_8_03.text:
What's unbelievable is your complete lack of musical talent, Lednas.
Do you even know what a beat is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_01.text:
But... Seeing that {PLAYER_NAME} agrees,
I have no choice but to admit defeat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_02.text:
Huhu, I'll bring back souvenirs and local treats.
Neth Empire has some great dessert cafes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_2_OP_9_03.text:
I hope the patisseries I knew in my dimension
still exist in yours...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_01.text: The winner of the second round of the Hasla Music Festival...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_02.text:
... is, once again, 'Jeomrye and Captain'!
What an amazing performance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_03.text:
I don't understand! We were perfect, as we always are!
This is unacceptable - losing to a street musician with no background!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_05.text:
I never knew the Ode to Alexander
had four verses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_1_06.text:
I think your repertoire lacks a little appeal
to people who are, erm, not from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_01.text:
As I thought... We should have included the 'Nyan Cat' song 
to our medley to cater to the viewers' tastes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_02.text: I'm not sure that would have made a difference, Lady Victoria!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_03.text:
Ahem, if you don't mind,
please get off the stage so that the next team can prepare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_2_04.text: I will reclaim my honor... Someday...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_01.text:
You easily won the second round,
but will the third time be the charm? Are you ready?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_02.text:
I was born ready.
The next opponents better be as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_03.text:
Huhuhu... Then you'll be pleased with the next round.
Introducing the next contestants!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_04.text:
They'll chase you to the ends of hell!
The thrill of the hunt is their entire life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_3_05.text:
Their leader endlessly burns in the fires of metaphorical hell:
Dullahan's #Marauders#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_02.text:
Mr. Dullahan! Could you give us a comment?
What did you think of 'Jeomrye and Captain's music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_05.text:
Big Brother Dullahan... doesn't speak.
He has a speech disability.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_06.text: If you have any questions, toss them to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_07.text:
Ah, then Mr. Wilhelm.
What did you think of your opponent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_08.text:
I didn't think anything.
I only think of... 'you know who.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_09.text: Oh, I see... Er, 'you know who' as in the wizard...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_10.text:
NO! I mean the one who stole my left eye!
Grr, the phantom pain is too much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_11.text:
... Okay. Let's go meet the other contestants.
Oh? Here we have Shasha, the Witch of Fire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_13.text:
You seem to be on a different plane than the other two contestants.
What do you seek in your music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_4_14.text:
Hmm... My message to the world, I guess?
Gonna be the world's flyest hipster, yo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_01.text:
Huh, I'm not sure I understood all that, but...
You're the only one who properly answered my question.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_02.text: Are you sure they can perform on stage?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_3_5_03.text:
Rude.
I'll enjoy dealing with you before 'you know who.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_EVENT_RHYTHM_4_1_01.text:
The 'Marauders' dazzles the stage with their performance,
but the judges vote in favor of 'Jeomrye and Captain'!
