Sworden. We are not your enemies. Secret agents of
Chen have infiltrated this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_03.text:
R-right! They caused the forest fires and installed
stakes! That's why the patron saints turned violent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_04.text:
I don't listen to beasts.
Enough of the excuses. Surrender yourselves!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_05.text:
Hey, come on. Stop being so stuck up, and trust me!
You love the tteok I make, don't you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_06.text:
…I don't care if you are the owner of my favorite shop.
I'll arrest you all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_07.text: L-look at this bastard! How dare you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_04_08.text: Ugh, ! Stop already and just move away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_02.text:
Wow, you really defeated the First Sword of Han!
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_03.text:
… Yes. It was unexpected,
but nothing changes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_04.text:
Even if I fall, my men surrounding these mountains
will arrest you all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_05_05.text:
Oh, everyone is so energetic.
What brings you all to these deep mountains?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_06_07.text:
…Hanee Baram, it's me, Halla.
You couldn't recognize me because I'm small?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_01.text:
Oh, yes. Halla. Of course I remember you.
I'm glad you are safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_03.text: …Who is it? She has an aura.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_04.text:
She's the rabbit patron saint, #Hanee Baram#.
She's the head patron saint of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_05.text:
She has wanderlust, so he goes all around Hasla.
She's never in her place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_06.text:
I see. An Elard and {PLAYER_NAME} were here too.
How is Lesdna doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_07_08.text:
Hm? Lednas? Was that the name?
Hmm, anyway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_01.text: I asked how my old friends were on the way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_02.text: Human, where are all the patron saints you captured?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_03.text: …I don’t know what you are talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_04.text:
I know what happened.
Don't even think about evading me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_05.text:
The squirrels and sparrows have told me that
everyone was arrested by one man.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_08_06.text:
A man with a dark and dreary face.
You.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_01.text:
And I heard that you are the one who ordered for these
stakes to be installed in the veins of this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_03.text:
Sworden! Is this true?
That's what the envoy of Chen brought!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_09_05.text:
…I move for the greater good. It's how I've been,
and how I will be forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_01.text:
I know that secret agents of Chen are here.
But they also have their reasons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_02.text:
They are looking for the General's daughter, who
went missing after the #Eastern Unification War#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_03.text:
The General's daughter... You mean War Princess
Rebecca? Why are they looking for her in Han?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_10_04.text:
... The one who kidnapped her is Moon Shadow 
Altair. You should know him well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_01.text:
A-Altair… That guy? I saw he looked to be out of his
mind after the war, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_02.text: Yes, he was out of his mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_11_03.text:
He was so infatuated with a woman that gave an
enemy nation an excuse for war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_12_01.text:
But... What does that have to do with capturing
patron saints?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_12_03.text:
The envoy from Chen asked to capture patron saints
in exchange for stopping the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_03.text:
You really think the palace wouldn't know about what
you were up to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_04.text: It has been revealed through a secret inspection!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_05.text:
You used your position to corrupt the land
and harm the patron saints...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_07.text:
Ashamed? You don't understand! We are at the
brink of war in the borders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_08.text:
We protected our land during the Unification war thanks
to General Mundeok, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_09.text:
We don't have the strength to go through another
war!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_10.text:
But if we can keep the peace by handing over some
beasts, isn't that the obvious solution?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_11.text: Even if I must stain my name...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_12.text: I'm ready to accept the darkness to protect this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_13.text: Are you determined like me? Mondrian!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_14.text:
You… always talked about darkness this and that
since a young age…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_16.text: H-hey! Stop talking nonsense and open your eyes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_17.text: Nonsense? Did I say something wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_18.text:
If we don't carry out the request from the envoy,
will you go find the general's daughter?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_19.text: Hmm... I'm sorry for interrupting your conversation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_13_20.text:
So if we bring her, will you stop handing over the
patron saints to Chen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_01.text:
What do you mean?
How would you...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_02.text: ... We have Altair and Rebecca under our custody.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_05.text: Did all this happen because of Altair?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_06.text:
It's the ones who are trying to use this situation
to their advantage. Am I correct?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_07.text: He probably never thought it would get this serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_08.text: That's why he's not able to step up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_09.text:
...
So... What do you suggest we do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_10.text: Well, as you know, Altair is our fellow classmate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_12.text:
Don't say that. Did you know that he's a third 
generation only son of the Minister of War?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_14.text:
You had a drink with him, too.
You must have a memory like a sieve.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_15.text: What does that have to do with this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_16.text: The point is, Altair is an important figure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_17.text: So if he takes Rebecca to Chen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_18.text:
And takes the head of patron saints, Hanee Baram,
to offer him, wouldn't that be a nice picture?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_19.text:
Hanee Baram… You will sacrifice yourself for this
country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_14_20.text: Of course. I was moved by your patriotism.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_02.text:
Mondrian, Hanee Baram.
You will have to take responsibility for your words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_03.text: I'll let you free, so do what you must.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_04.text: But... If this was all a lie to get out of this,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_05.text:
I will arrest you again and make you regret
you extended your life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_15_06.text:
Come on, black sesame tteok lad!
Stop saying dumb things and get going your way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_02.text: ... I don't understand what is going on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_03.text:
I can somewhat understand the patron saint that 
appeared out of nowhere, but who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_04.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't introduce myself.
My name is #Mondrian#...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_05.text:
It's embarrassing, but I'm in the lowest seat of the
Office of the Inspector General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_06.text:
Mondrian! You are the one who captured that
magistrate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_07.text:
Your exploits were the talk of the town amongst the
Hwarangs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_08.text:
Oh, it's nothing compared to your exploits, Full Moon,
who shot at the moon to make it fall.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_09.text: Oh, and the Inspector General sends his regards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_10.text:
He said he is sorry he couldn't help you in the city
because there were too many eyes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_11.text: The Inspector General! What an honor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_12.text:
Must be someone in a high position.
S-so are we all good now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_13.text: Of course. Sworden actually trusts me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_14.text: I came up with a solution, so he is going along.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_15.text:
He stole a friend's girl, but he's a good guy.
You can trust him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_16.text:
…So the rumor was true?
You have a strong will, more so than what I heard...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_17.text:
Anyway, thank you.
I don't know how I should repay you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_18.text:
Haha, I just did what I was supposed to do.
Don't worry about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_19.text:
If you are that grateful, we can have a drink with
Altair in the city once everything is over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_21.text:
…I feel like I'm witnessing the corporatism of
government.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_16_22.text: Haha... Fair is fair after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_01.text:
You like to mess with things, like always.
But thanks to you, we dodged a bullet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_02.text: But… Why did you offer yourself to be the sacrifice?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_04.text:
You said it yourself.
That you are going to Chen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_05.text:
Oh, that? Well, to hunt a tiger, you must go to the
tiger's cave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_06.text: If I want to wreak havoc, I have to go find them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_09.text: The reason why you guys came to this land...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_10.text:
Must be to find the reason behind the strange energy
circling around this land.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_11.text:
My good old friends were captured,
so I'm not in a good mood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_13.text:
We must find the whereabouts of the patron saints,
and reveal the scheme of those Taoists...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_14.text: Will you go to Chen with us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_17_15.text:
Is that even a question?
I actually hope you don't mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH1_ST6_18_02.text:
Altair and Rebecca should be near the border
by now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_01.text:
How strange. You don't seem to be lying.
You really didn't kidnap Princess Rebecca?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_02.text:
…Stop making me repeat myself.
We've never detailed the Princess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_04.text:
Aren't you the one trying to start a war by using
the Princess?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_06.text:
We only came to rescue her after hearing that she was
kidnapped by a ruffian.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_08.text:
Who was kidnapped?
I came on my own two feet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_09.text:
…Yes. After bombarding the house of the
Chief General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_10.text:
And she disappeared after leaving a note saying
to not look for her. How could we not worry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_12.text:
Well…If this was all a misunderstanding, please take
the Princess and go back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_14.text:
You used all kinds of dirty tricks on the battlefield.
How can I trust your words!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_15.text: You will attack us the moment we turn around!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_16.text:
Mengqi, come on. Curb your temper, please. 
Aren't you embarrassed? You already lost once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_17.text:
That's right! How dare a rookie talk like that to
General Mundeok?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_18.text:
What did you just say!
If you weren't the Chief General's daughter...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_19.text:
You know how ridiculed I was because you disappeared
after making a scene in the trilateral meeting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_20.text:
Sure, I don't get scared of someone weaker than me
yelling at me like that, okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_01_21.text:
Rebecca. Even if that is the truth, it's not nice to
insult someone like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_01.text:
Ah! Hey! I can't stand this!
Let's fight!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_02.text:
You are spitting on your own face.
Stop!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_04.text:
Just think of it as a good thing.
Innocent lives don't need to be sacrificed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_05.text: Innocent lives don't need to be sacrificed, huh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_06.text:
So you agree with the envoys of Chen, in that patron
saints are not human, is it? I'm disappointed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_02_07.text: ...? Chen's envoys? What do you mean, Mundeok?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_02.text:
Hanee Baram! I was worried you were late.
Who are they?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_03.text: Hm, you've heard of {PLAYER_NAME}, haven't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_04.text:
I helped them get out from Sworden's patron saint
hunting situation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_05.text:
Oh... {PLAYER_NAME}! I've heard of you.
You've distinguished yourself at such a young age.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_06.text: What brings such a hero to the outskirts of the East?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_07.text:
…We came to find out what weakened the veins of
Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_08.text:
And... We found out that 'Kalard' is behind the envoys
of Chen to scheme this incident.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_09.text:
Kalard? I've never heard that name...
And what do you mean by envoys of our country?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_03_10.text:
This is a personal issue, so it's just the two of us
here… Do you know anything about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_01.text:
They said that I'm not good with words, and you are
not able to see, so it will be hard to negotiate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_02.text: So they did send some guard with us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_03.text:
They asked for the patron saints of Han as a pretext
for war, and the Five Tiger Generals don't know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_04.text:
Nonsense! General Hansheng!
We don't even need to listen to them!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_05.text:
Mengqi. I also can't believe the envoys of Chen
would do such a thing. But…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_06.text:
General Mundeok wouldn't tell lies. What he just said
is probably all true.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_08.text: It looks like we were all played by someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_09.text:
…I do have an idea. I will take matters into my 
hands… But before that…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_10.text:
We must pay for our mistakes on this land.
Is there anything we can help you with?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_11.text:
... Then can you help us investigate the traces of
Kalard if we go to Chen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_04_12.text:
You would be fighting against the authority of the
imperial family, which you are loyal to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_01.text:
Of course. As His Majesty's subject, I should speak
without reserve if he's headed the wrong way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_02.text:
General Hansheng, will you be alright?
The atmosphere at the palace is not that great...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_03.text:
…That happened ever since #Da Ji# and her Taoists
settled down in the palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_04.text:
The brutalities they committed can't even be counted.
They know His Majesty is favoring them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_05.text: They must be the ones planned this hoax as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_06.text:
If they don't have an acceptable answer… They will
pay for deceiving a Five Tiger General.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_07.text:
Hm, what an interesting human.
Alright! I'm glad we are of the same opinion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_08.text:
I thought about giving you some rabbit ears to make
you lead us there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_05_09.text:
Hanee Baram… You did that to that human Ar-something
not long ago, too…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_01.text: Are we all going to Chen, then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_02.text:
No, you go with General Mundeok to the capital to
announce the Chen army's withdrawal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_03.text: You are tiny now, so you won't be of help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_06.text:
Hm, I'm not going to die there.
Don't look so serious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_07.text:
Don't worry. If anything, I can leave it to
{PLAYER_NAME} and run away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_06_08.text:
…I'm not sure if she's humorous or brazen...
The patron saints of Han are all strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_01.text: How strange, we are at the center of the city…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_02.text:
But there's no one on the street. Isn't it strange, even
if it is night time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_03.text:
I know. It's very empty for the nightscape of
a big city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_04.text:
Recently, there has been a rumor about a suspicious
monster appearing at night to kidnap people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_05.text: There have been a lot of people missing, too...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_07_06.text:
And because of that, His Majesty has imposed
a curfew for the safety of our people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_01.text:
What? What kind of law is that?! I wanted to
get some tteok skewers in the night market!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_02.text:
R-Rebecca. Calm down.
There are monsters coming out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_03.text:
Tsk. There's no way monsters would appear in the
center of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_04.text:
This is all because of the Taoists who follow
Da Ji's orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_05.text:
Aren't Taoists… people who leave the secular world
in order to train and become Ethereals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_06.text:
Hmph. That's all in the past. They don't go to the
mountains to train like hermits anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_07.text:
There are many who think that they are the ones
behind the people gone missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_08.text:
What kind of person is that woman called Da Ji?
You seem to be very dissatisfied with her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_09.text:
She appeared out of nowhere a few years ago, and
became His Majesty's new concubine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_10.text:
His Majesty was a smart man, but ever since she
came, he became a completely different person.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_11.text:
…Now that I think about it, I'm suspicious of why no
one thought that was strange.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_12.text:
I'm sorry to interrupt, but isn't it too quiet
here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_14.text:
But it is very strange that we can't see a single
mouse or cat around here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_08_15.text:
Hahaha... So as the head of the mountain patron saints
you have an outstanding sense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_09_02.text:
Good job, Five Tiger General Hansheng, Mengqi.
You've rescued Princess Rebecca.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_09_03.text:
Are the rabbit patron saint and the criminals of Grancia
a surprise gift for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_09_04.text:
It looks like you are not even trying to hide your
intentions. Why are you doing this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_09_05.text:
I'm just following His Majesty's intentions.
Well, will you hand them over now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_01.text: Well, I'm sorry, but I can't see too well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_02.text:
I need to hear His Majesty's voice to hear
his opinion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_03.text:
…His Majesty is not feeling well lately.
He won't be able to see you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_04.text:
Just hand them over.
Will you go against His Majesty's orders?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_05.text: I can't let you continue, you wicked witch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_06.text:
You think we wouldn't know you are trying to satisfy your
own desires by making up His Majesty's intentions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_07.text:
How funny... General Mengqi, I cannot accept
such slander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_08.text:
What, speaking the truth is called slandering now?
I had no idea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_09.text:
... You need some time to cool down.
Alright. I'll leave you guys to the Phantom Army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_10.text:
Hmph, you think night guards can stop me?
I'm Five Tiger General Mengqi!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_11.text:
That's right! I'm War Princess Rebecca!
Give me back my tteok skewer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST1_10_13.text:
Sigh... This is a mess.
{PLAYER_NAME}, you will have to help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_01_01.text:
Huff… Huff...
W-were these guys this good?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_01_02.text: It looks like they have better equipment than us too…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_01_03.text:
…Mengqi, of course the Phantom Army that guards the
capital is made up of skilled men.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_01_04.text:
By the way, {PLAYER_NAME}.
What are you looking at?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_02_01.text:
Y-you defeated the Phantom Army...
Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_02_02.text:
Who are YOU?
Your outfit looks like that of a Taoist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_03_01.text:
Huh?! No, I'm not! Who says I'm
that person's subordinate?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_03_02.text:
I'm Han Xiangzi.
I'm an apprentice… Taoist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_03_04.text:
No, well… Those guys are bad Taoists...
And I'm a nice Taoist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_03_05.text:
What are you talking about.
You want to get slapped?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_03.text:
General Hansheng, did you really acquire inner sight,
in exchange for your sight?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_04.text:
…How many years have you been by my side,
to believe that nonsense?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_05.text:
It's simple.
I've heard from He Xiangu before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_06.text:
That he took on a student named Han Xiangzi,
and that he's a headache to be around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_07.text: M-my master talked about me like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_08.text:
He Xiangu… She's one of the 'Luhe' half saints.
If he's her student, we can trust him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_09.text:
Alright, 'nice Taoist' Han Xiangzi. Why did you come
to a city occupied by the 'bad Taoists'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_10.text:
If you know my master, then I can get to the point.
Please help me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_11.text:
The palace Taoists took my master and Brother
Lu Dongbin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_13.text:
No way. 'Luhe' didn't remain half saints because
of a lack of skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_04_14.text: How did ordinary Taoists get her...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_05_01.text:
I was wondering where the rats ran off to.
You were talking with those goners.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_05_04.text:
How could you not recognize who is in control,
and go against His Majesty's orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_05_05.text:
Wouldn't it be better if you retire before experiencing
any further disgrace?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_06_02.text:
So you are {PLAYER_NAME}?
You do have a unique energy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_06_03.text:
Alright, should be a little different from patron saints
and stupid half saints.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_01.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, the evil energy emanating from
this guy… it's mixed up with everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_02.text:
Wait... So the reason the Taoists of Chen
took the patron saints of Han is because…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_03.text: …I have an idea of what is going on now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_04.text:
We must interrogate this idiot that knows nothing and
find out the whereabouts of those who were taken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_05.text:
My Flower of Ten Thousand Roots is perfect for that!
Please leave it to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_06.text:
Those who are stabbed with this on a toe will spit out
even their base.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_07.text:
... That sounds terrifying.
I'm counting on you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_07_08.text:
W-what's that! What's that terrifying iron mace?
D-don't come near me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_08_02.text:
Han Xiangzi? How did you come here...
Were you captured as well?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_08_03.text:
Yes, I was captu... Who do you think I am!
Of course I came to save you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_08_04.text:
Oh, Hansheng, Mengqi.
You must have helped out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_08_06.text:
Of course. I didn't think this kid would be able
to come here on his own.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_09_02.text:
Hmm… We are okay.
This is embarrassing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_09_04.text:
I'm #He Xiangu#. And this is my pupil
#Lu Dongbin#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_01.text:
I see. You have a gentle energy unlike
ordinary humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_02.text:
You are… a mountain patron saint.
And you've lived for quite a long time...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_03.text:
Hm. Call me Hanee Baram.
But...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_04.text:
If you have that kind of power, how were you
captured by the Taoists?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_05.text:
It's just as you say. We don't like competing
with our powers…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_06.text:
But it's true that those Taoists haven't studied
as much as us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_07.text:
But… One day, a woman called Da Ji came
and everything changed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_08.text:
She ordered a type of training to Taoists who lacked
training…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_09.text:
And we were chased by those Taoists who suddenly
got stronger. We had to escape the mountains.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_10.text: Don't tell me that training method is…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_11.text:
Yes. It was to steal the pure energy from patron
saints.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_12.text:
...! You took my friends...
Because of that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_13.text:
…I'm sorry.
We tried to stop them, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_14.text:
Some strange item took our powers away,
and we were captured easily.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_10_15.text:
It was a piece of iron that had a strange energy that
is not one of humans nor monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_01.text: The iron stakes with Kalard's energy...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_02.text: So… Da Ji is in contact with the Kalard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_03.text:
S-so the envoys that followed us to the rescue mission
were also Taoists?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_04.text:
Yes. In order to capture patron saints from Han.
They made an excuse to cause confusion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_05.text:
Since they found an easy way to get stronger, they
have no qualms about their actions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_11_06.text:
Taoists think that patron saints are just beasts that
learned the language by living long amongst humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_12_01.text:
Beasts... That Sword-something guy also said the
same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_12_03.text:
If patron saints like us who guard the energy of the
veins disappear…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_12_04.text:
that will end up in a catastrophe for all Three
Eastern Countries. Do they not know that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_12_05.text:
It is our fault that Taoists and patron saints
have split..

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_12_06.text: I should have listened better to the master Taoists...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_01.text:
We will go find the Master Ethereal and ask
for help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_02.text: You will all go find Da Ji, correct?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_03.text: Yes. We have some debt to collect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_04.text:
Be careful. Da Ji has gained control of most of
Chen's army.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_05.text:
When you arrive at the palace, His Majesty's army
might stop you guys.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_06.text: Haha, their leader is my dad, so don't worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_07.text: And we have two of the Five Tiger Generals with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_10.text:
Stop talking nonsense and focus. We must face the
Phantom Army before heading to the palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_11.text:
…We must get going.
Han Xiangzi, you come along too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_12.text:
May I go to the palace with
{PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_13.text:
You think that's possible? You will get in the way.
Stop talking nonsense and come with us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_13_15.text:
Then, please be safe.
I hope to meet you again someday…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_01.text:
The cause of all this is that girl named Da Ji… When I
first saw her, I was taken aback so I let her go,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_02.text:
but there's no way I will let a human who has angered
me this much return in one piece.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_03.text:
... If I see her again, I shall put a pig's nose on her
face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_05.text:
Maybe a rat's tooth instead?
Hmm… What should I do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_06.text: I have time to think about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST3_14_07.text:
What are you doing, {PLAYER_NAME}?
You have to get going?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_02.text:
Gapgwi, how could a good lad like yourself follow
the orders of a wicked woman.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_03.text:
I only follow His Majesty's orders. I'm different from
traitors like yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_04.text:
Who is the traitor? You are being used by Da Ji.
Come to your senses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_05.text:
Hmph. How would you understand what a great
person she is.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_06.text:
Da Ji promised us that the defense forces of the capital
will ride cows instead of horses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_01_07.text:
Your shabby donkeys and infantry will fall behind
the times!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_02_01.text:
Bastard, how dare you insult someone else's
companion animals!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_02_02.text: Fierce Dragon! Don't listen to that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_02_03.text:
Tsk… Making a frantic last-ditch effort.
Accept it, it's the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_02_04.text:
The Cow Army led by me and Ochu will
come true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_03_03.text:
What, did something appear?!
I've never heard such an atrocious roar!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_03_04.text:
A tiger with wings...?
Don't tell me that is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_04_03.text:
Taebaek...! You like traveling as much as I do,
so I thought you were just away,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_04_04.text:
but even the half-witted Halla is fine, so how could
you be here...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_05_02.text:
Taebaek! Come to your senses!
How could you show such an atrocious look!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_05_03.text:
Hanee Baram, please calm down!
You must not go further!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_01.text:
Oh, long time no see.
Five Tiger General Mengqi!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_02.text:
How have you been? Though it's not a
good situation right now...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_03.text:
Seeing you like this reminds me of our conversation
in the palace just as if it was yesterday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_05.text:
Abusing your body at a young age can come back
to bite you when you get older.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_06.text:
The doctor I recommended to you should have made
you some good medicine. Did you go see him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_07.text:
Well, it can be solved easily if you just enjoy your
leisure time. But it's not easy as it sounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_08.text:
I'm sure you feel the pressure of being a Five Tiger
General…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_09.text:
Oh, I didn't tell you why I stepped down from my
position, did I? Sorry about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_10.text:
If I told you, you'd know why I went to see His Majesty
that day, and you'd know more about me as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_11.text:
That incident about 40 years ago… So some
monsters appeared in the village…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_07_12.text:
Argh! S-stop!
This isn't the time for this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_01.text: You still talk too much, Shuwen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_02.text: Mr. Hansheng. Long time no see!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_03.text:
Well. There are two Five Tiger Generals.
Maybe I should have stayed out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_04.text:
No, good timing. Where have you been all this
time, though?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_05.text: Oh. Remember I went to see His Majesty a while back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_06.text:
In the end, I didn't get to see him… But when I returned
home, an unexpected guest came to find me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_07.text:
It was Five Tiger General Zhao Yun. I think nowadays
he is called Zilong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_08.text:
He said there is another reason why His Majesty
is confining himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_09.text:
He said His Majesty fell for a woman named Da Ji or
something like that. Did you know about that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_10.text:
He's so infatuated, that he doesn't listen to anyone
else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_11.text:
How could I just stand and watch after hearing that?
I was going to go and say something to him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_12.text:
But on the way there, this big cat appeared and
blocked my way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_13.text:
It looked so violent so I was stopping it, but then it
started running away, so I went after it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_08_14.text: And ran into you guys. So…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_09_01.text:
Now. {PLAYER_NAME}, everyone!
Escape while the monster is blocking Shuwen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_09_02.text:
M-Mr. Hansheng! You can't just leave like that!
We have a lot to talk about...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH2_ST6_09_03.text: Be careful! The emperor in the palace now is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_01.text:
Whew... It seems that we've successfully gotten away.
Good riddance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_02.text:
... I do have a question, however.
The man just now - wasn't he trying to help us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_03.text: Why did we need to run away from him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_04.text:
You don't know Shuwen's loquacity, miss.
Once he begins... He just won't stop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_05.text:
To make things worse, he's absurdly fast on his feet. 
We were lucky that that monster distracted him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_07.text:
What is it, Mengqi?
You seem restless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_08.text:
... It is too dark, too silent,
even for a night such as this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_09.text:
The palace should be full of servants working through
the night… Yet the silence is deafening.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_10.text:
Yes... I expected the Palace to be more glamorous than this,
considering it's the home of the Emperor of Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_01_11.text:
I've seen sunken ships at the bottom of the sea
livelier than this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_02_01.text:
... You are right; it is too silent.
Where is #Zilong#? He should be guarding the front gates.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_02_02.text:
He must be slacking off somewhere. I've been wanting to
settle the question of who is the strongest Tiger General...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_02_03.text:
Oh, did I not tell you?
The lad...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_02_04.text: You've arrived at last, General Hansheng, General Mengqi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_01.text:
As for the others... Welcome to the Kingdom of Chen.
I am #Zilong#, one of the Five Tiger Generals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_02.text:
I fear the Palace is in no good condition to receive guests
at the present moment. For that, I apologize.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_03.text:
H-How dare you attempt an ambush!
Stand back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_04.text:
Ambush? What do you mean? I don't understand,
Mengqi. Have I offended you in any way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_05.text:
You...
don't think of us as the enemy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_06.text:
... As I was saying, I had forgotten amidst the chaos
to notify everyone that Zilong is on our side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_07.text:
Zilong and I have suspected Ethereals of the Palace of unknown
treachery. We have been inspecting the matter together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_08.text:
A blind man can only do so much,
and Zilong has proven to be a capable companion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_10.text: ... You yourself know that you cannot keep a secret.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_11.text:
Uncle Zilong!
Where's Father? Where did everyone else go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_12.text:
Ah, Rebecca. It is a relief to see that you are well.
However...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_13.text:
Sky Tiger General and most of the other loyal servants have
been imprisoned in their homes or the Palace dungeons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_15.text:
His Majesty has grown very suspicious of late and no longer
trusts his servants. They breathed poison into his head.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_03_16.text:
The only people left in the Palace are the Five Tiger 
Generals and some dozen troops of the Elite Guards.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_01.text:
So these noises...
can't be human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_02.text:
Some 'things' are crawling above our heads and below our feet
in every nook and cranny... Sinister and cruel beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_04.text:
... Corrupted mountain saints - or what remains of them.
The Palace has been turned into one giant nest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_05.text: It must be Da Ji and the Ethereals' doing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_06.text:
Yes. They banished the loyal vassals who were brave enough
to state the truth, and instead brought monsters into the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_07.text:
I kept silent before their treachery,
waiting for Master Hansheng to return...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_08.text:
... but I could no longer stand the Palace
being defiled by those evil beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_09.text:
Yes, you've done well, Zilong. I only regret that my suspicions
were not merely an old man's delusion.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_10.text:
As things have come to this,
we, as the Five Tiger Generals, must fulfill our duty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST1_04_11.text: Now, then... Zilong, will you lead the way?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_01.text:
My friends...
We will meet again in the mountain peaks of our home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_02.text:
... I am sorry for your loss...
I am sure you will meet again in the next life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_03.text:
Next life? No, mountain saints do not die from such wounds.
They merely dissolve and return to their spirit forms...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_04.text:
... and return to their home in the mountains,
where they are reborn in a new body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_05.text: Oh? Is that how things are?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_06.text:
However, they still need to gather enough energy to wield power
over their mountain if they wish to become sentient beings again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_07.text:
If they fail to do so during their reincarnations, or surrender to
their animal instincts for too long... That's when they truly die.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_08.text:
That is why connections are so important in Han.
A friend can protect you while you're small and weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_09.text:
I-I see. I hadn't thought to connect mountain saints to
the culture of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_01_10.text:
The boundary between life and death is decided by the spirit's
continuity, rather than the body… How profound.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_02_01.text:
Aubrey... You're unusually quiet.
What are you thinking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_01.text:
On our way here, I've been attempting to purify
the defeated mountain saints...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_02.text:
Despite having lost much of their soul energy
and twisted beyond recognition…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_03.text:
They are not truly corrupted,
not in the way that I can purify them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_04.text:
Their darkness is of another nature,
as with Umrat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_05.text:
The mountain saints' appearance depends on the balance of light
and darkness within their souls. That balance seems to have broken

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_03_06.text:
Their current forms, too, are their own.
It's only natural that they cannot be purified.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_01.text:
I told you, they'll revive back home.
There is no need to worry whatsoever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_02.text:
Let's not waste any more time now, shall we?
We must go find Da Ji.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_03.text:
Yes, I agree.
Zilong, are we far from our destination?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_06.text:
That's strange... We should have reached the main hall
after turning right at that corridor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_07.text: Zilong! What are you muttering under your breath?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_08.text:
Ah, M-Master Hansheng...
I apologize. I seem... to have lost my way...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_04_10.text:
Hahahaha! Oh, Zilong.
Aren't you a little young to be forgetting things?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_05_01.text:
... This is hardly the time, Mengqi. Don't you feel it? A sinister
trigram has been laid out somewhere within the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_05_02.text:
A trigram?
The Ethereals must be behind this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_05_03.text:
No, there is one Five Tiger General who is quite skilled at
such magic. She is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_05_04.text:
Oh, did you finally notice us,
Uncle Zilong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_01.text:
Yin Ping! So this was your doing - the power of your 
Green Dragon Orb!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_02.text:
You're slow on the uptake, General Zilong.
Were we on the battlefield, you would already be dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_05.text:
The last members of the Five Tiger Generals:
#Guan Yin Ping# and #Zhang Bao#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_06.text:
Yin Ping is the daughter of #Yunchang#, Zhang Bao the son of
#Yide# - children of two former Generals who went missing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_07.text:
Both of them left the capital to train some years ago and
returned only recently, when they earned their current titles.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_06_08.text:
Which means - they're only fledglings on the battlefield.
Where are your manners, Zhang Bao?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_01.text:
You know better than to insult your Uncle Mengqi!
Shame on you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_02.text:
And you too, Yin Ping! You should have done something
before the Palace fell into such chaos!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_04.text:
YOU collaborated with the enemy!
You should be ashamed - not nag at us like an old grandma!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_05.text:
W-what! I'm at a loss for words! Zhang Bao, you're a good 
kid! You don't say stuff like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_06.text:
It is the duty of the subject
to follow their emperor’s decree.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_07.text:
First you fail to obey Her Majesty’s commands,
now you invade the Imperial Palace without authority.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_08.text:
Do you mean to start a rebellion,
Generals?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_09.text:
Yin Ping. Do you truly believe that the atrocities being committed
in Chen are what His Majesty desires?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_10.text:
Da Ji - that witch is tricking you
into doing her bidding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_11.text:
A subject’s true duty is to aid their emperor follow the
righteous path and lead the empire with wisdom and strength!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_13.text:
Why do you insult Her Majesty by using Her Majesty’s name?
Have you lost all your allegiance to the throne?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_14.text:
I return the same question to you.
When have I ever insulted His Majesty?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_07_15.text:
Did you not just dare to call #Empress Da Ji#,
the sole daughter of the skies of Chen, a witch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_08_01.text:
That's strange... Didn't you say that Da Ji was the consort of
the Emperor, not the Emperor of Chen himself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_08_02.text:
Of course! His Majesty himself graced the departure of my
expedition with his honorable presence! How could I forget -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_08_03.text:
W-wait, Mengqi.
Do you... remember His Majesty's name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_08_04.text:
I wished to refute such foolish claims,
but for some strange reason, I seem to have forgotten it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_08_05.text: Huh? Of course I rememb-... Huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_09_02.text:
... I-I seem to have forgotten His Majesty's face as well...
Wait. Was it Her Majesty?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_09_03.text:
Let's not panic. 'His' Majesty, at least, will recognize us. I
frequented the sauna together with His Majesty in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_09_04.text:
... A senile old man shouldn’t hold onto the title of a
Tiger General. I won’t allow it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_09_05.text:
You’ve drawn out your life too long as it is. I’ll put an end to
your pathetic existence right here and right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST3_09_06.text:
... Let’s test our memories after we stop those two,
shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_01.text:
Sigh... They both take after their fathers. With good guidance,
they shall become the greatest warriors in Chen...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_02.text:
Hrrmph. That Zhang Bao should learn how to keep his temper
AND treat his elders with more respect.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_03.text: ... Are you sure you are the one who should be saying that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_04.text:
As Guan Yin Ping has fallen,
the trigram should have broken and lost its power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_05.text:
Let’s hurry to the Throne Room, 
where Empress Da Ji should be waiting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_01_07.text:
You're contradicting yourselves. I clearly remember you
mentioning a consort by the name of Da Ji.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_02_01.text:
Consort...?
What are you talking about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_02_02.text:
Da Ji is the name of the Empress of Chen.
Why would Her Majesty take a consort with the same name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_02_04.text:
Don't you remember? We came here to capture a woman
named Da Ji and is manipulating the Emperor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_02_05.text:
No, you're mistaken. We're clearly trying to overthrow
Ethereals who have been corrupted with evil magic... W-wait.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_02_06.text:
... What is this memory?
Places and people I've never seen before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_03_01.text:
What is wrong with everyone?
Have you all been enchanted by a dokkaebi?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_03_02.text:
... I understand now why everything felt out of place ever
since we arrived in Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_03_03.text:
Why everyone seems to forget what should not be lost
and instead chases after absurd lies and uncanny deceit.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_03_04.text: The one whom we are chasing... Da Ji.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_03_05.text:
No... The Kalard behind her, lending her their powers....
can meddle with people's memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_01.text: Memories... Do you mean that they can control people?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_02.text:
I'm not sure, but I don't think so. The people we met on the way
didn't exactly seem to be brainwashed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_03.text:
However, fabricating or erasing a person's memory
could indirectly manipulate them into acting a certain way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_04.text:
That would explain why the people of Han
failed to remember the Oracle of Water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_05.text:
And why the Ethereals forgot everything about the mountain
saints and hunted them down like beasts, hungry for their power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_06.text:
And why I repeatedly lose my way
AND my belongings everywhere!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_08.text:
Then would our belief that Her Majesty -
no... Da Ji is the Emperor of Chen be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_04_09.text:
Yes. Da Ji aims to become the new Empress, and it seems that
her new power has allowed her to do so without bloodshed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_05_01.text:
I won't allow it!
Empress Da Ji becoming Emperor - I - I mean...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_05_02.text:
... Huh. This is a strange feeling... To remember memories so
clearly and yet know that they are but lies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_05_03.text:
We can only hope to overthrow Da Ji as quickly as possible.
Come, let us hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_01.text:
General Hansheng. What urgent business brings you
before me at so late an hour?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_02.text:
Attempt no more of your vile trickery, Da Ji.
We remember the truth now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_04.text:
Well... I was warned to keep wary of the Elards
and a Hero Captain by the name of {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_05.text:
I still had not expected for you to defeat the Army of the
Armored Ghosts and the Tiger Generals.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_06.text: That means... You're one of the Kalard's underlings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_07.text:
Did they command you to create chaos
in the Eastern Kingdoms?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_08.text: No... The Great Lady commanded nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_06_09.text:
She only told me...
to do 'what I truly wanted.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_07_02.text:
Yes. I wished to have all of Chen - no! All of the world at
my beck and call.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_07_03.text:
Can you see me as the lowly consort I once was, who had to beg for
a scrap at the table of life? Look at me and what I have accomplished!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_07_04.text:
Have I not succeeded in pulling down an emperor from his throne?
Am I not commanding the invincible Tiger Generals as my personal guards?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_07_05.text:
With this power, I will be able to conquer all of the East and crush
Roman for good... and confront Alexander of Grancia at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_01.text:
Stop spouting the cliched delusions of a tacky villain
and tell us the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_02.text:
Where is His Majesty?
The true Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_03.text:
Oh, General Mengqi...
Did you not guess, after everything I told you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_04.text:
I disposed of the old imbecile
a long time ago. He proved to be of no use to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_06.text:
I had him buried in the courtyard.
If you wish, I will reserve a place for you there as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_01.text:
You confess to evil without cause or justification.
Your wickedness astounds me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_02.text:
Did you truly believe you could make the world suffer
if it meant fulfilling your pride?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_03.text: It is the most important thing in the world to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_04.text:
That hardly justifies your actions.
Nor can you be forgiven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_05.text:
As long as we know the truth,
we must stop you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_06.text:
Do as you will - it will change nothing. I have many other
soldiers who will gladly give up their lives at my command.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_01.text: All bark and no bite, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_02.text:
Did your 'Lady' only bestow you the gift
of jealousy and deceit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_03.text:
No - no! That absolute power - that godly strength - I know
it was real, I - !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_04.text: It's coming out... It's leaving me...! No...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_01.text:
... Sigh... I wondered why my strength was suddenly being
drained. {PLAYER_NAME}... We meet again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_02.text:
Our last encounter in Nosgard forced me to slumber and heal
my wounds. And you dare to appear before me again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_03.text:
You are very persistent.
I can now understand Arart's disgust now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_04.text:
W-who are you?
Why - how did you come out of... me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_05.text:
Oh? Your ego remains. But then again, Da Ji, you were
always an 'egocentric' child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_06.text:
You should still understand, however,
that I didn't 'come out of you'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_09.text:
It's perfectly natural that you don't remember.
However... I devoured the real 'you' years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_10.text:
You are nothing but a husk I have been controlling
to acquire power over Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_11.text: N-no...! Everything I did, I did by my own will -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_12.text:
If it pleases you to believe that lie,
then I have nothing more to say to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_13.text:
However... I have no further use for you,
and maintaining your form only tires me. Return to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_14.text:
N-no! I-I never asked for this!
Please don't -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_01.text:
What... was that just now?
Has Da Ji been hiding her true identity all along?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_02.text:
That Kalard has the ability to steal others' appearance at will, 
to the extent that it is impossible to discern

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_03.text:
Da Ji was not the Kalard's minion...
She was the Kalard herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} has faced her in battle before,
in Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_06.text:
Yes. I know you.
You are the Elard Aubrey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_07.text:
I had been hoping
that we wouldn't cross paths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_08.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME} told me that you claim
to be fulfilling the 'true will of Cora.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_09.text:
Yet all that you have done is
create hatred and wage a meaningless war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_10.text: Is this truly the path of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_13_01.text:
I remember—that stupidly strong Daughter of Cora
said the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_13_02.text:
Treachery under the name of Cora?
Meaningless hatred and war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_01.text:
It was all your own doing: the humans of Hasla are so easily tempted
by the darkness within their souls. One little push, and down you all go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_02.text:
Do you truly believe yourselves worthy
of this holy land where Cora will finally descend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_03.text:
You humans are already impure. Destroy yourselves
in your mindless wars - only then can the path of light be reached.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_04.text:
Accept your fate as a single cornerstone of the world as our vision.
Let paradise on earth come into being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_15_01.text:
I should have realized sooner
that you would prove the greatest hindrance to our plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_15_02.text:
I will no longer let you rouse those beasts
who refuse the true guidance of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_16_01.text:
I will sacrifice everything if need be.
Your road ends here... in the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_17_01.text:
Despite having sacrificed everything...
I still failed to defeat you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_02.text:
L-Lethe!
You must not come out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_03.text:
Did you not promise the rest of us that you would never
reveal yourself in front of {PLAYER_NAME}...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_04.text:
Arart worries too much for her own good.
I am in no danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_05.text:
I only wished...
to see {PLAYER_NAME} with my own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_02.text:
‘In no danger,’ huh?
Are you so confident of yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_03.text:
You must be stronger than your comrade over there,
passed out on the ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_04.text:
No, I am no stronger
than the average human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_06.text:
Can it be... the 'Great Lady' Da Ji mentioned
before her ego dissolved away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_07.text:
Da Ji could fabricate memories,
but Gullveig displayed no such ability.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_01.text:
Ooh, you're right! 
You are indeed clever, Oracle of Water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_02.text:
Yes, I am Lethe, the #Kalard of Oblivion#. All who come under
my power remember and forget as I will it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_03.text:
As well as the one you seek...
The cause behind everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_04.text:
The Kalard of... Oblivion?
Behind everything? You?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_05.text:
Yes. I've been trying to design the second War of the Eastern
Kingdoms and oppress Roman and Trista in the process...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_07.text: However... I'll admit that you amused me greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_08.text:
I have never met anyone else
who has so keenly detected my presence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_10.text: Have you never thought it strange?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_11.text:
Why the humans of Hasla can never remember the history
before the Apostles War, one hundred years ago:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_12.text:
the lost Desert Kingdom of the Three Kings
and the forgotten Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_13.text:
Elder Edda, the old capital of Nosgard, abandoned by King Snorri's
decision for his kingdom, and the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_14.text:
The Oracle of Water who guards the mystical seas,
and her master, Habaek the White Dragon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_15.text:
I have erased such history from the face of this world:
the lost history of these lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_16.text:
N-no. That can't be.
Such things couldn't have happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_17.text:
And even if you speak the truth,
why are you telling us everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_18.text:
Oh, you see...
I can do this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_19.text:
#You will forget everything that I said#
#since we met.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_01.text:
I expected more from the one who had given you much trouble.
Are you hurt, Gullveig?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_02.text: ... Your abilities never fail to amaze me, Lethe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_03.text:
To manipulate the mind of 
a formidable being like {PLAYER_NAME} is a great feat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_04.text:
I am not strong like you and the others.
I only hold mastery over the realm of memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_05.text:
I have already confirmed that I can erase even the memories of 
#Chronos#, one of the three Daughters of Cora, through direct contact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_06.text:
Indeed... 
Now, what will you do with that one?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_07.text:
Sigh... That is the problem.
I had other plans for them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_08.text:
But I cannot risk any more setbacks to the great plan.
Their story ends here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_09.text: Won't you give me a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_23_01.text:
How can it be...?
Why haven't you succumbed to my power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_01.text:
You were the Champion of Hasla.
No... It can't be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_02.text:
A mere human of a remote dimension, hero or otherwise,
should not be able to match Goddess Cora in power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_03.text:
Lethe! What are you doing?
You can't -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_03.text: Lethe... You are needed for the plans ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_04.text:
We cannot let you die here.
Go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_05.text: Wait! There must be a way-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_26_02.text:
Even if you discover the truth of this world...
Only death and darkness await you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_26_03.text:
Outside... Beyond your understanding… You will see that…
it would have been better to accept your fate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_27_02.text:
What just happened?
When did we defeat Gullveig?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_01.text:
Ah, my head...
I seem to be remembering many things at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_03.text:
Gullveig's defeat must have broken
the Kalard's hold over our memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_04.text:
This is...
All of our proper memories are returning to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_06.text:
How could have I forgotten... such tragedies
happening in places I hadn't known...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_01.text:
The shadow of the Kalard have lifted from the Eastern Kingdoms.
It is painful to remember the wounds of the past and present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_02.text:
However... Hope of the future 
also shines amidst the memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_03.text:
I can see it now. Gullveig's iron stakes, infused with her
energy, have lost all their power. The land is healing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_04.text: I only hope that soon - oh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_01.text:
Haerang... That new aura about you.
Have your powers as the Oracle of Water returned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_02.text:
Habaek has returned -
our old promise has been renewed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_03.text:
Let's go outside, everyone.
We must greet him properly - he is coming our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_32_02.text:
The mystical seas are at the eastern end of the world.
He must move quickly indeed for him to arrive so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_32_03.text:
Habaek travels across the ley lines that spread throughout Hasla.
He is swifter than lightning, at least in the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_01.text: It seems he hasn't arrived yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_02.text:
... Thunder rolls from afar.
The earth quakes....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_03.text:
Something comes...
I can feel it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_01.text:
I call you, my master, who amidst the endless waiting of long years
still hold close to his heart the threads of fate between human and earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_02.text:
Your oracle, ever standing between the human world and that of the
ancient guardian deities, request your presence from the mystical seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_03.text:
I invoke our eternal promise, 
here in these lands where old memories lie unforgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_03.text:
It is not often that I wish for the light of my eyes to return,
but this stately presence...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_04.text:
Such beauty and grace...
I haven't seen him for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_06.text: ... It has been some time, Haerang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_08.text:
I failed you... I failed to follow the guidance of the water,
and could not find you for more than a hundred years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_09.text:
The sands of time fall slowly for those who have seen the first dawn.
Do not reproach yourself so, child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_10.text:
I must thank you instead for overcoming the Kalard's schemes
and keeping me from fading into the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_11.text:
I didn't do it on my own. Without {PLAYER_NAME}, it would
have been an impossible journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_12.text:
Yes... {PLAYER_NAME}. I know you - the one chosen by
our Goddess for the sake of this earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_13.text:
The tales of your feats are whispered even by the mermaids 
and creatures who frequent the depths of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_14.text:
Thank you for freeing my siblings,
#Galatea# and #Loki#, from the clutches of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_15.text:
We #Ancient Sacred Beings#
were born to protect Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_16.text:
We were born with much power, far greater, perhaps, than what we
must have had... Thus I feared to interfere in the lives of smaller beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_17.text:
For long years I pondered, until I decided to appoint one wise human 
the  #Oracle of Water#, who would guide the usage of my powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_18.text:
I would thus grant human beings wisdom and strength, unlike
my siblings who viewed them with either #mischief# or #pity#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_19.text:
That means... You were trapped in the Sanctuary of the
Deep Seas for all these years, by your own doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_02.text:
He believes in the integrity of human beings… or at the very least,
the Oracle of Water, and entrusts her with his powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_03.text: No, I was just a little surprised.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_04.text: Habaek's decision, however, will lead to the turn of the tide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_05.text:
As Habaek had been sealed within the Sanctuary of the Deep Sea,
the corruption of the Kalard would not have reached him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_06.text:
Yes, you are right.
Now that I have returned...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_07.text:
I, Habaek, lord of the mystical seas of Hasla,
shall heal the wounds of these lands and console the grief of my people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_09.text:
... The Kalard are strong. To remain an observer in these circumstances
would aid their cause. It is time to rouse from slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_10.text:
As for the humans of the Eastern Kingdoms, you will elect
representatives of each country to form a new #Eastern Alliance#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_11.text:
In the meantime, I will prepare to rouse
#the last Ancient Sacred Being# from their slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_12.text:
The last Sacred Being...?
So there was one more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_13.text: What are they in charge of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_15.text:
If you ever require my aid,
call for Haerang, and I will come. This I vow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_16.text: Until the day we meet again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_01.text:
I apologize for the poor hospitality.
I must ask for your patience, considering the circumstances.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_02.text:
You must remain hidden
if we are to avoid Dionne's keen eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_03.text:
Do you realize what you have done? You are mad.
I should have known that you were planning such things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_04.text: I am perfectly aware of the consequences of my actions, Chancellor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_05.text:
Before I was asleep; now I am awake.
No longer do petty ideals cloud my judgement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_06.text: I've come back from my mission, milord!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_01.text: You are quick to return, Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_02.text:
... We came across {PLAYER_NAME} and their company
in Edenberg, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}?
Hmm. Were they not last spotted in Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_04.text:
Then again, they were always quick on their feet.
And what happened then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_05.text:
We failed to recruit new soldiers
due to an unexpected interruption, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_06.text:
Interruption? Neth should not have the strength
to oppose you, the one who has inherited the Flame of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_07.text:
#Galatea# was there:
the being that Arart the Traitor had been researching.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_08.text:
It's unclear how, but she had acquired a new physical
body and regained her powers as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_09.text:
I only failed to capture her because the Elard Bella
and the Neth soldiers continued attacking from both sides.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_10.text: I will defeat her properly next time, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_01.text: ... So they rise, one by one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_02.text:
While I had expected there would be other variables
outside {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_03.text:
I admit, it is not pleasant to see more and more
potential enemies of Grancia coming into power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_04.text:
Do you not see the folly of your own ways?
You yourself are creating more enemies against your empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_05.text:
If you continue like this, the antipathy of all countries in Hasla
towards Grancia will only increase.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_06.text:
The alliance you formed three years ago to oppose the Apostles
will turn their blade against you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_07.text:
That is exactly what I intend for them to do. The disturbances in Nosgard
and Neth... The bounty on {PLAYER_NAME}'s head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_08.text:
Everything is coming into place. The great war will start soon - and erase
all other coutries off the face of Hasla, leaving Grancia the sole victor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_04_01.text:
... Alexander.
What did the Kalard promise you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_04_02.text:
Is it worth the bloodshed that will ravage the continent of Hasla?
Is it worth the newfound peace of the people?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_05_01.text:
I am merely following the true path of light.
The only path to eternal peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_05_02.text:
Attention! Your Majesty,
I come bearing an urgent report!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_06_01.text:
What is it? Did I not forbid anyone from entering this room
except for the most urgent of affairs?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_06_02.text:
I beg your forgiveness, Your Majesty! But a #white dragon# has been
spotted in the skies over the capital of Chen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_02.text:
No, Your Majesty!
The dragon was seen to communicate with other humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_03.text:
It called itself #Habaek#,
lord of the mystical seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_04.text: ... The lord of the mystical seas... That can't be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_01.text:
Leon, prepare to set out at once. Our time has come,
much more quickly than I had expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_04.text:
#Utgard Loki# of Elder Edda.
#Galatea# of Heaven...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_05.text:
And now, #Habaek# of the mystical seas to the east. They
are rousing the 'Ancient Sacred Beings# from slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_06.text:
Their next destination is clear: the #Primal Volcano#.
Take the other Chrona Heroes with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_07.text: Yes, Your Majesty! I won't let you down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_01.text:
... Tell me...
Tell me one last thing, Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_02.text:
Where is...
Where is Sera? Where are you keeping her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_03.text: There is no knowing what the #Execeutioner# thinks or intends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_04.text:
Why don't you pray for her sake?
Isn't that what you Elard do best?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_05.text:
Who knows -
your Goddess Cora may answer your prayers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_01.text: Thank you for gathering here today, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_02.text:
Although we haven't succeeded in contacting
the king of Han and the shogun of Ryu...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_03.text:
We have gathered today to discuss
the direction that the new #Eastern Alliance# must take.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_04.text:
... Is there need for discussion?
Only you can communicate with the ancient guardian of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_05.text:
I dared not voice my stance as a subject of Chen before 'Lord Habaek.'
Yet I must refuse to partake in this gathering if Han seeks to seize all power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_06.text:
You are mistaken.
I am not here as a representative of the Kingdom of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_07.text:
My reincarnations are not bound to a particular country… In my
past lives I have been born several times in both Chen and Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_08.text:
Several times... Reincarnation is curious business. I remember
there were several reincarnated people in Hero Town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_10.text:
I am not completely sure...
Even if I were, it would not be my place to tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_01.text:
If you say so, Oracle.
Then I shall stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_02.text:
You're more careful than usual, General.
To the point of overanalyzing everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_03.text:
Mengqi. We have failed to protect the late Emperor,
and His Majesty left no heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_04.text:
Chen is currently in a precarious position.
If any more trouble were to befall the kingdom

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_05.text:
while we Tiger Generals administer the affairs of the state...
I would never forgive myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_01.text:
That won't happen.
I promise you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_02.text: Then let's hear what you have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_03.text:
I still think it is too early to decide on an alliance
that hasn't even been formed yet. Why the hurry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_04.text:
The Kalard we fought are directly associated with
the political turmoil among the nations of the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_01.text:
As you may know, {PLAYER_NAME} and I come from Hero Town,
a small village in Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_02.text:
Three years ago... When darkness first befell Hasla,
Emperor Alexander proved himself to be a valuable ally

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_03.text:
But he has recently defected to the side of the Kalard,
and the Order of the Goddess has followed his lead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_04.text:
I don't know what brought about his sudden change of heart,
but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_05.text:
If we Eastern Kingdoms form an alliance around #Habaek#,
it is very probable that Grancia will seek to antagonize us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_02.text:
It is a losing battle. 
You underestimate the strength of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_03.text:
No, we know better than anyone what Grancia is capable of. That's
why we're will form an alliance with all of Hasla - save for Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_04.text:
... Luckily, {PLAYER_NAME} has something of a reputation, 
as well as some good friends around the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_05.text:
Your optimism borders on the absurd. A few friends will not
move the entire continent to our side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_06.text:
Well... The Eastern Kingdoms will still fight for you.
We're all in the same boat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_07.text:
Yes, I suppose so.
You would do well to show some compassion, Mengqi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_08.text: Oh? So I'm the bad guy here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_06_02.text:
Oh? So you were all gathered here!
I've been searching for you all around the Palace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_01.text:
S-Shuwen! I am glad to see you are alive and well and not
dead at all! I thought you were busy fighting that monster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_02.text:
Hmm? Hahaha! Oh, Master Hansheng!
Your mischievous jokes always get me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_03.text:
It almost sounds as if you WANT me not alive, not well,
and very much dead! Which of course I believe isn't the case!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_04.text:
Of course that isn't the case! I was jesting.
Yes, merely jesting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_05.text: Sigh... What brings you all the way here, Shuwen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_06.text:
Oh, now that's a good tale!
You see, I came to ask for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_07.text:
It has to do with that monster you mentioned. It seems no small 
business, and I wanted your opinion, Master Hansheng.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_08.text:
Because whom else can I trust more than you, Master Hansheng?
You're the only man in the world I would give my back on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_09.text:
That night... After you all ran to the Palace, not heeding my warning
thank you very much, the monster and I fought to the death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_10.text:
Well, almost to the death, as both of us are still pretty much alive.
But I can promise you that that was the fiercest fight I ever fought

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_11.text:
