the fragment to El Thalnos. You can’t say I failed.

Oh, and I saw the Skill Lab on my way back.
There was a young mage transferring skills.

I’m... glad.
That Lab meant everything to me back then.

Before we point fingers and criticize,
I want to thank you.
For helping me with skill research back then...

It was nice talking to you, a walk down memory lane.
I’ll be going now, there are things I want to see.
{player_name}, you are truly a miracle to Pandora.

...Is it okay for you to point fingers and criticize now?
Uhm...

Wait, come sit, {player_name}.
Let’s talk more. {player_name}? Hello?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_189_STA.text:
Oh? Long time no see, {player_name}.
What’s with that expression? Seen a ghost?

...Look above my head?
The past? Elandia? El Thalnos?

Yeah, many things happened in the past.
But let’s put the past behind us.

You never know who you’ll run into.
It’s a pleasant surprise meeting you here.

There are the living dead in the desert.
I also gave you glasses that can see spirits.

This is evidence that the dead can be brought back.
The twisted dimensions might be the cause.

Whatever the case may be, the world sure is mysterious.
It might actually be a great research topic.

I’ve been doing okay. The afterlife isn’t a bad place.
I had fried chicken last night, it was delicious.
I was thinking everything was fine..

But seeing and talking to you, {player_name}
makes me reminisce on the past.

I miss the old days. Walk with me, will you?
Let’s visit Elandia and have a nice chat.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_190_END.text:
...We’re almost done.
It would’ve taken me ages to do it alone.

Did you read some stories?
Doesn’t it remind you of old memories?

It might feel strange reading something you already know.
But there are people that enjoy that.

To once again feel the emotion that they had felt.
To relive the excitement of the past.

Each individual has a different reason for reminiscing.
...Perhaps it’s because we lived a good past.

I sometimes stop and look back, too.
I get emotional whenever I read about our past.

I might sound a bit greedy here, but...
I wanted to record more of your adventures.

...We’re done reorganizing the books.
Thank you, {player_name}.

I’ve been watching over the dimensions for so long.
But the times we spent together seemed the longest.

I’ve been watching over you and Hasla.
Your stories were always so interesting.

...Whatever the ending might be.
As long as you’re here, the story never ends.

...You have a great story, {player_name}.
What do you think?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_SUB_Q_S2_190_STA.text:
...{player_name}. You look bored.
Can you help me if that’s the case?

I need to examine and organize the books. It’s a
necessary procedure, but it’s hard doing it alone.

Think about all the books and recordings the Library has!
It’s impossible to organize them alone.

When I’m tasked with the job, I barely finish on time.
It’s quite ridiculous.
...I spend 365 days a year organizing them...

I’ve been working like this for years.
Being a librarian isn’t easy.

The stories of every dimension are recorded here.
Every recent event as well.

And, {player_name}.
#Your stories# make up the majority of the library.
...But there’s too much for me to handle now.

Recent events alerted me to the gravity of the situation.
If I leave it be, the dimensions will become twisted.

So if you have time, you should look through the books.
It’s partially your fault that we’re in this situation.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_1.text:
I finally found you!
*Yawn* I was so bored♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_2.text:
I wanted to see who placed a bounty on my head,
and it was you! You are so slow♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_3.text:
You are a fool to come looking for me.
Well, I guess you saved me the trouble of finding you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_4.text:
Since I came to you, you’re gonna pay me the bounty!
Haha♡ How nice! Free money!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_5.text:
You have no class. Such a rude kid.
I can’t see why so many people lost to you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_6.text:
Class? Haha! The boss of a gang came for a child♡
Let’s see how you fare in a fight, loser♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_1_7.text:
...
I can’t let this kid disrupt the peace of our land.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_1.text:
Hmm!
I thought you were a complete loser♡ But you can fight!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_10.text:
Hmm? Are you trying to shoot me? I’m♡So♡Scared!
You want to make a child cry? You Brute♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_11.text: S-stop Milady! Let my tea friend go!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_12.text:
I never thought I’d make a new friend at my ripe old age!
Please show her mercy and let her go.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_13.text:
D-don’t! Keep her here!
Have her make delicious food for me...!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_14.text:
The food she makes is out of this world...
She needs to become a chef!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_15.text:
Ugh, losers♡ No one can keep me in one place.
How disgusting♡ Leave me alone, will you?♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_16.text:
I change my mind. I’m out of here♡
I hate clingy people♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_17.text:
NO! Don’t go please! Make me food!
Just tell me where you’re going, I’ll follow!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_18.text:
You’re going to leave me? Why! Don’t go!
I need your advice to improve my tea!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_19.text:
Whatever! Look at how clingy you all are♡
Don’t stalk me! Hope to never see you again! Bye losers♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_2.text:
You are pretty good.
Or maybe, it’s not you, maybe it’s {player_name}!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_22.text:
Otis, Athos, good job.
I’ll split the bounty and give it to you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_23.text:
What worked? I don’t care about money!
I want my friend back!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_25.text:
...? What’s gotten into them?
{PLAYER_NAME}, do you know?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_26.text:
Better for me if they don’t want this money.
Come, Captain. Let’s have an expensive steak dinner.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_4.text:
Look at you getting angwy♡
No one likes grumpy people silly♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_6.text: Your face gets even wrinklier when angry♡ Haha♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_7.text:
Since you lost the duel, leave the Wastelands.
You disrupt our land’s order.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_8.text:
Nope♡
I’ll leave when I want to leave. It’s fun here♡

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_10_2_9.text:
Why you...! You leave me no choice.
A bullet is faster than the law...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_1.text:
You’ve arrived.
I thought you’d come this way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_2.text:
You said you’ll be going after the wanted crook.
Why were you waiting for me?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_3.text:
I did. I went after the bounty, but she was too strong.
I almost died while trying to earn a few coins.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_4.text:
So you came to me to tell me you failed?
You don’t have to report your incompetence to me...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_6.text:
She told me if I bring her the person who placed
the bounty, she’d give me double what you offered.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_1_7.text:
You look weaker than her, Milady.
I have to stay alive until I find my brother.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_2.text: Sherff Maxi? Why are you here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_3.text:
The money you sent me... You tried buying me off!
How dare you insult me like that! You’re under arrest!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_1_4.text: Hmm... I can’t let you do that.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_1.text:
Oh, wait! I didn’t send you enough!
A person of your caliber need more money!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_2.text:
Please excuse me, where were my manners?
I will order my men to donate an even bigger sum.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_3.text:
B-bigger sum? More than before?
Hmm... by how much?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_4.text:
N-No, wait!
You’re doing the same thing, again!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_5.text:
If that’s what you really want, I guess I will comply...
But the two horses and your new office. Give’em back.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_2_6.text: Wait...! All of that? G-give me a second to think.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_3_2.text:
I change my mind!
You weren’t bribing me! You simply donated!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_2_3_3.text:
You are no longer arrested!
Have a good day!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_1.text:
Hey, big shot.
Us bounty hunters live by a code. We have rules.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_2.text:
If you, the client, hunts for the bounty,
how would a hunter like me make money?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_3.text: This is unfair, don’t you think so?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_3_4.text:
If you worked diligently and competently, I wouldn’t
have to. Get out of my way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_4.text: What the... this guy has food all over his mouth.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_5.text:
You can’t pass... I never had porridge that delicious...
The taste was heavenly...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_6.text:
If you get rid of her,
I’ll never get to taste her leftovers, ever again...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_7.text: What in the world did he eat?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_8.text: Heaven... one more time... I want to eat...

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_4_9.text: He’s insane. Speaking to him won’t do anything.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_1.text:
This is my territory. MINE.
You are brave to come here without your men.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_2.text:
This is the fastest path.
Can you make way?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_3.text:
No. I never really liked you.
You buy people’s favor with money and blackmail them.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_5_4.text:
It looks like you already have Maxi on your side.
That won’t work on me.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_6_1.text:
Milady, please don't! Why are you
trying to catch this talented individual?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_6_2.text:
I almost persuaded her to sign this contract here...
When she heard you were coming she changed her mind.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_1.text:
You were on my good side, since you brought peace to
the Wastelands. But I think you’re going too far.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_10.text: There are two of you. I needed to make it even.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_2.text:
You’re making such a mess, to simply go after 1 person?
Your game of tag is destroying the land!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_3.text:
I almost have her. Why are you making a fuss?
Just mind your own business.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_4.text:
We can’t let you off.
I heard you hurt Athos.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_6.text: Oh? Is that why you’re here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_7.text:
So what? You are going to gang up on me
just because I bonked your brother?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_8.text:
Messing with one of us, is messing with us all.
We will show no mercy.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_7_9.text: But wait. Why is Captain {PLAYER_NAME} here?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_2.text:
Old man? Why are you here?
I thought I told you to stay at your shop.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_3.text:
That’s not it. Soon after you left, the kid came to my
shop again! I found out there was a misunderstanding.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_4.text:
She tried helping me with my tea research.
She was actually very knowledgeable about tea.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_5.text: She actually seemed more like an adult than most adults.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_6.text: Let’s cancel that bounty, shall we?

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_8_8.text: No take backs. Get out of my way.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_1.text: You know who wiped out the 9th Division of the Falcons.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_2.text: Tell me who it is, or I’m not moving.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_9_3.text: Get out of my way, I’m busy.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_1.text:
Milady, did you catch that #rude kid# yet?
I placed such a big bounty on her, go get her!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_10.text:
I’ve never felt such humiliation before!
Maybe I should come out of retirement!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_11.text: Water that stops flowing eventually becomes dirty.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_12.text:
What? I, “Bloody Sunset” Otis is still alive and kicking!
I will teach that kid a lesson myself!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_13.text:
Just hold on. If you leave the Hideout
unattended, outsiders will trash our land.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_14.text:
I’ll take care of it.
I also have a useful #mercenary# that I hired.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_15.text:
Hmm... fine. But wait, why are you talking about to me?
Do you find me old and weak, too?!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_2.text:
I’ve sent my men after her.
Please wait a while longer old man.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_3.text:
You want me to wait longer?
I’ve waited for 4 days!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_4.text:
She called my tea #Loser♡# and left!
I want her dead!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_5.text: Loser... Loser... Loser... Loser Loser Loser Loser!!!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_6.text:
The smirk on her face...
I can’t get it out of my head!

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_7.text:
There were many outsiders that visited you and your
shop, Hideout.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_8.text:
But #none walked out in one piece# after you
bonked them with your bottle.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_1_9.text:
But this one left without a scratch,
while further insulting you.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_2.text:
I’m surprised you’re here on time,
since you are always so clumsy and careless.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_4.text: I have someone I need to “take care” of.

TEXT_TALKJSON_DIALOGUES_WEST_OP_2_5.text:
You? Just follow me and support me.
Loot will fall all over the place, so pick’em up for yourself.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D001.text: Hi! You finally read the message!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D003.text: A new way to talk with others!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D004.text: It’s an invention that will connect everyone from around the continent!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D005.text: Let’s see... where do I start.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D006.text: Oztalk is different from your traditional letters.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D007.text: You can start a conversation with anyone at any time.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D008.text: Do you know how to send a message?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D010.text: That’s it! Good job. That’s how you do it.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D012.text: You have a lot of friends.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D013.text: I’m expecting you to spread the word of Oztalk!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D014.text: You want me to promote Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D015.text: Yeah, there aren’t a lot of users yet.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D016.text: But if you, the famous captain, uses it...!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D017.text: People will catch on and start using it, too!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D018.text: I do want to help you...

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D019.text: But I don’t know anyone that uses Oztalk.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D020.text: I don’t even know how to add someone on this.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D021.text: Adding a friend to Oztalk is easy!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D022.text: First, you’ll have to have the hero [contracted and in your hero pool].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D024.text: Then you’re ready to gain friendship with that hero!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D025.text: It’s as if you’re explaining a game to me.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D027.text: It was the easiest way to explain the system.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D028.text: Oh! Remember that you can only accumulate friendship [with a select number of heroes].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D029.text: I said this before, but Oztalk isn’t available to everyone yet.

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D030.text: How do I know who has access to Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D031.text: You can check at the [Oztalk Friends List]!

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D032.text: I’ll make it simple: [Recruit heroes in the Oztalk Friends List and promote them to 6 stars].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D034.text: Then I need to accumulate [Friendship] with those heroes?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D036.text: [You will receive more messages from heroes with high friendship.]

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D037.text: You can probably gain [Friendship] by buying them [Meat].

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D039.text: So I can raise friendship by playing [Scenarios], [Dungeons], and [Challenges] with those heroes?

TEXT_TALK_000_1_D041.text: I’ll probably also use Oztalk! So I’m expecting some delicious meat from you!

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D001.text:
[Web] (Ad) ☆★^@Need JOb?§○★100% joBGuaranteed^
☆Looking 4 ppl who want 2 wOr K*Gr8 treAtment, all rAces&GeNdErs

TEXT_TALK_001_1_D002.text:
